cards.name: Aragorn
cards.text: Sentinel. Response: After Aragorn commits to a quest, spend 1 resource from his resource pool to ready him.
cards.flavor:
"I am Aragorn son of Arathorn; and if by life or death I can save you, I will."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/001 - Aragorn.jpg

cards.name: Theodred
cards.text: Response: After Théodred commits to a quest, choose a hero committed to that quest. Add 1 resource to that hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor:
"Not all is dark. Take courage, Lord of the Mark..."
<cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/002 - Theodred.jpg

cards.name: Gloin
cards.text: Response: After Glóin suffers damage, add 1 resource to his resource pool for each point of damage he just suffered.
cards.flavor:
His beard, very long and forked, was white, nearly as white as the snow-white cloth of his garments.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/003 - Gloin.jpg

cards.name: Gimli
cards.text: Gimli gets +1 [attack] for each damage token on him.
cards.flavor: "Men need many words before deeds. My axe is restless in my hands." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/004 - Gimli.jpg

cards.name: Legolas
cards.text: Ranged. Response: After Legolas participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, place 2 progress tokens on the current quest.
cards.flavor:
"I can walk this path, but others have not this skill."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/005 - Legolas.jpg

cards.name: Thalin
cards.text: While Thalin is committed to a quest, deal 1 damage to each enemy as it is revealed by the encounter deck.

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/006 - Thalin.jpg

cards.name: Eowyn
cards.text: Action: Discard 1 card from your hand to give Éowyn +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase. This effect may be triggered by each player once each round.
cards.flavor:
Slender and tall she was in her white robe girt with silver; but strong she seemed and stern as steel, a daughter of kings.
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/007 - Eowyn.jpg

cards.name: Eleanor
cards.text: Response: Exhaust Eleanor to cancel the "when revealed" effects of a treachery card just revealed by the encounter deck. Then, discard that card, and replace it with the next card from the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
"Gondor wanes, you say. But Gondor stands, and even the end of its strength is very strong."
<cite>Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/008 - Eleanor.jpg

cards.name: Dunhere
cards.text: Dúnhere can target enemies in the staging area when he attacks alone. When doing so, he gets +1 [attack].
cards.flavor:
Captains rode to meet him at the ford, bearing messages from Gandalf. Dúnhere, chieftain of the folk of Harrowdale, was at their head.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/009 - Dunhere.jpg

cards.name: Denethor
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Denethor to look at the top card of the encounter deck. You may move that card to the bottom of the deck.
cards.flavor:
"And the lord Denethor is unlike other men: he sees far."
<cite>Beregond, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/010 - Denethor.jpg

cards.name: Glorfindel
cards.text: Action: Pay 1 resource from Glorfindel's pool to heal 1 damage on any character. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
"You saw him for a moment as he is upon the other side: one of the mighty of the firstborn."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/011 - Glorfindel.jpg

cards.name: Beravor
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Beravor to choose a player. That player draws 2 cards. Limit once per round.
cards.flavor:
But in the wild lands beyond Bree there were mysterious wanderers. The Bree-folk called them Rangers, and knew nothing of their origin.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/012 - Beravor (errata).jpg
01 - Core Set/Player/012 - Beravor.jpg

cards.name: Guard of the Citadel
cards.flavor:
"But the Lords of Minas Tirith still fight on, defying our enemies, keeping the passage of the River from Argonath to the Sea."
<cite>Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/013 - Guard of the Citadel.jpg

cards.name: Faramir
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Faramir to choose a player. Each character controlled by that player gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
"He leads now in all perilous ventures. But his life is charmed, or fate spares him for some other end."
<cite>Mablung, Ranger of Ithilien,
The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/014 - Faramir.jpg

cards.name: Son of Arnor
cards.text: Response: After Son of Arnor enters play, choose an enemy card in the staging area or currently engaged with another player. Engage that enemy.
cards.flavor:
...and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor above the mouths of Anduin.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/015 - Son of Arnor.jpg

cards.name: Snowbourn Scout
cards.text: Response: After Snowbourn Scout enters play, choose a location. Place 1 progress token on that location.
cards.flavor:
...he saw not a shadow, nor a blur, but the small figures of horsemen, many horsemen, and the glint of morning on the tips of their spears was like the twinkle of minute stars beyond the edge of mortal sight.
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/016 - Snowbourn Scout.jpg

cards.name: Silverlode Archer
cards.text: Ranged.
cards.flavor:
"We have been keeping watch on the rivers, ever since we saw a great troop of Orcs going north towards Moria, along the skirts of the mountains, many days ago."
<cite>Haldir of Lórien, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/017 - Silverlode Archer.jpg

cards.name: Longbeard Orc Slayer
cards.text: Response: After Longbeard Orc Slayer enters play, deal 1 damage to each Orc enemy in play.
cards.flavor:
Five dead Orcs lay there. They had been hewn with many cruel strokes, and two had been beheaded. The ground was wet with their dark blood.
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/018 - Longbeard Orc Slayer.jpg

cards.name: Brok Ironfist
cards.text: Response: After a Dwarf hero you control leaves play, put Brok Ironfist into play from your hand.
cards.flavor:
...there is no knowing what a Dwarf will not dare and do for revenge and the recovery of his own.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/019 - Brok Ironfist.jpg

cards.name: Ever Vigilant
cards.text: Action: Choose and ready 1 ally card.
cards.flavor:
"...no road looks toward safety any longer. Be vigilant!"
<cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/020 - Ever Vigilant.jpg

cards.name: Common Cause
cards.text: Action: Exhaust 1 hero you control to choose and ready a different hero.
cards.flavor:
"We will make such a chase as shall be accounted a marvel among the Three Kindreds: Elves, Dwarves, and Men."
<cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/021 - Common Cause.jpg

cards.name: For Gondor!
cards.text: Action: Until the end of the phase, all characters get +1 [attack]. All Gondor characters also get +1 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
And the tree that was withered shall be renewed,
and he shall plant it in high places,
and the City shall be blessed.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/022 - For Gondor!.jpg

cards.name: Sneak Attack
cards.text: Action: Put 1 ally card into play from your hand. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play, return it to your hand.
cards.flavor:
There is a seed of courage hidden (often deeply, it is true) in the heart of the fattest and most timid hobbit, waiting for some final and desperate danger to make it grow.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/023 - Sneak Attack.jpg

cards.name: Valiant Sacrifice
cards.text: Response: After an ally card leaves play, that card's controller draws 2 cards.
cards.flavor:
"He fell defending the Hobbits, while I was away upon the hill.
<cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/024 - Valiant Sacrifice.jpg

cards.name: Grim Resolve
cards.text: Action: Ready all character cards in play.
cards.flavor: "If there is only one way, then I must take it. What comes after must come." <cite>Frodo Baggins, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/025 - Grim Resolve.jpg

cards.name: Steward of Gondor
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the Gondor trait. Action: Exhaust Steward of Gondor to add 2 resources to attached hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor:
"It was commanded yesterday."
<cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/026 - Steward of Gondor.jpg

cards.name: Celebrian's Stone
cards.text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gains +2 [willpower]
If attached hero is Aragorn, he also gains a [spirit] resource icon.
cards.flavor:
"You needn't," said Bilbo. "As a matter of fact it was all mine. Except that Aragorn insisted on my putting in a green stone. He seemed to think it important. I don't know why."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/027 - Celebrian_s Stone.jpg

cards.name: Veteran Axehand
cards.flavor: "I am glad to have you standing nigh with your stout legs and your hard axe." <cite>Legolas, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/028 - Veteran Axehand.jpg

cards.name: Gondorian Spearman
cards.text: Sentinel. Response: After Gondorian Spearman is declared as a defender, deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy.
cards.flavor: More than a thousand were there mustered. Their spears were like a sprining wood. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/029 - Gondorian Spearman.jpg

cards.name: Horseback Archer
cards.text: Ranged.
cards.flavor: A few of the riders appeared to be bowmen, skilled at shooting from a running horse. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/030 - Horseback Archer.jpg

cards.name: Beorn
cards.text: Action: Beorn gains +5 [attack] until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase in which you trigger this effect, shuffle Beorn back into your deck. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I don't need your service, thank you...but I expect you need mine." <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/031 - Beorn.jpg

cards.name: Blade Mastery
cards.text: Action: Choose a character. Until the end of the phase, that character gains +1 [attack] and +1 [defense].
cards.flavor:
Throwing back his cloak, he laid his hand on the hilt of a sword that had hung concealed by his side. They did not dare to move.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/032 - Blade Mastery.jpg

cards.name: Rain of Arrows
cards.text: Action: Exhaust a character you control with the ranged keyword to choose a player. Deal 1 damage to each enemy engaged with that player.
cards.flavor: Arrows thick as the rain came whistling over the battlements, and fell clinking and glancing on th estones. Many found their mark. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/033 - Rain of Arrows.jpg

cards.name: Feint
cards.text: Combat Action: Choose an enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase.
cards.flavor: A few brave men were strung before them to make a feint of resistance, and many there fell before the rest drew back and fled to either side. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/034 - Feint (errata).jpg
01 - Core Set/Player/034 - Feint.jpg

cards.name: Quick Strike
cards.text: Action: Exhaust a character you control to immediately declare it as an attacker (and resolve its attack) against any eligible enemy target.
cards.flavor: "...for he that strikes the first blow, if he strikes it hard enough, may need to strike no more." <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/035 - Quick Strike.jpg

cards.name: Thicket of Spears
cards.text: You must use resources from 3 different heroes' pools to pay for this card. Action: Choose a player. That player's engaged enemies cannot attack that player this phase.
cards.flavor:
With a word or cry, suddenly, the Riders halted. A thicket of spears were pointed towards the strangers...
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/036 - Thicket of Spears (errata).jpg
01 - Core Set/Player/036 - Thicket of Spears.jpg

cards.name: Swift Strike
cards.text: Response: After a character is declared as a defender, deal 2 damage to the attacking enemy.
cards.flavor:
A swift stroke she dealt, skilled and deadly.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/037 - Swift Strike.jpg

cards.name: Stand Together
cards.text: Action: Choose a player. That player may declare any number of his eligible characters as defenders against each enemy attacking him this phase.
cards.flavor: ...and when the task was done, there they would come to an end, alone, houseless, foodless in the midst of a terrible desert. There could be no return. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/038 - Stand Together.jpg

cards.name: Blade of Gondolin
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] when attacking an Orc. Response: After attached hero attacks and destroys an enemy, place 1 progress token on the current quest.
cards.flavor:
It was rather splendid to be wearing a blade made in Gondolin for the goblin-wars of which so many songs had sung...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/039 - Blade of Gondolin.jpg

cards.name: Citadel Plate
cards.text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gets +4 Hit Points.
cards.flavor:
"Go to the armouries of the Citadel, and get you there the livery and gear of the Tower."
<cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/040 - Citadel Plate.jpg

cards.name: Dwarven Axe
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gains +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if attached hero is a Dwarf.)
cards.flavor:
"But keep your bow ready to hand, and I will keep my axe loose in my belt."
<cite>Gimli, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/041 - Dwarven Axe.jpg

cards.name: Horn of Gondor
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Response: After a character is destroyed, add 1 resource to attached hero's pool.
cards.flavor:
'Slow should you be to wind that horn again, Boromir,' said Elrond, 'until you stand once more on the borders of your land, and dire need is on you.'
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/042 - Horn of Gondor (errata).jpg
01 - Core Set/Player/042 - Horn of Gondor.jpg

cards.name: Wandering Took
cards.text: Action: Reduce your threat by 3 to give control of Wandering Took to another player. Raise that player's threat by 3. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: ...but certainly there was still something not entirely hobbit-like about them, and once in a while members of the Took-clan would go and have adventures. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/043 - Wandering Took.jpg

cards.name: Lorien Guide
cards.text: Response: After Lórien Guide commits to a quest, place 1 progress token on the active location.
cards.flavor: "Indeed deep in the wood they dwell..." <cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/044 - Lorien Guide.jpg

cards.name: Northern Tracker
cards.text: Response: After Northern Tracker commits to a quest, place 1 progress token on each location in the staging area.
cards.flavor:
"What roads would any dare to tread, what safety would there be in quiet lands, or in the homes of simple men at night, if the Dúnedain were asleep, or were all gone into the grave?"
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/045 - Northern Tracker.jpg

cards.name: The Galadhrim's Greeting
cards.text: Action: Reduce one player's threat by 6, or reduce each player's threat by 2.
cards.flavor:
"Welcome to Caras Galadhan!" he said. "Here is the city of the Galadhrim where dwell the Lord Celeborn and Galadriel the Lady of Lórien"
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/046 - The Galadhrim_s Greeting.jpg

cards.name: Strength of Will
cards.text: Response: After you travel to a location, exhaust a [spirit] character to place 2 progress tokens on that location.
cards.flavor:
Then Aragorn lead the way, and such was the strength of his will in that hour that all the Dúnedain and their horses followed him.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/047 - Strength of Will.jpg

cards.name: Hasty Stroke
cards.text: Response: Cancel a shadow effect just triggered during combat.
cards.flavor:
'The hasy stroke goes oft astray,' said Aragorn. 'We must press our Enemy, and no longer wait on him for the next move.'
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/048 - Hasty Stroke.jpg

cards.name: Will of the West
cards.text: Action: Choose a player. Shuffle that player's discard pile back into his deck. Remove Will of the West from the game.
cards.flavor:
"If Gondor has such men still in these days of fading, great must have been its glory in the days of its rising."
<cite>Legolas, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/049 - Will of the West (errata).jpg
01 - Core Set/Player/049 - Will of the West.jpg

cards.name: A Test of Will
cards.text: Response: Cancel the "when revealed" effects of a card that was just revealed from the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
"There is naught that you can do, other than to resist, with hope or without it"
<cite>Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/050 - A Test of Will.jpg

cards.name: Stand and Fight
cards.text: Action: Choose an ally with a printed cost of X in any player's discard pile. Put that ally into play under your control. (The chosen ally can belong to any sphere of influence.)
cards.flavor: "...we will fight on." <cite>Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/051 - Stand and Fight.jpg

cards.name: A Light in the Dark
cards.text: Action: Choose an enemy engaged with a player. Return that enemy to the staging area.
cards.flavor:
The light of the torches and the fire flickered about them...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/052 - A Light in the Dark.jpg

cards.name: Dwarven Tomb
cards.text: Action: Return 1 [spirit] card from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor:
The dwarves no more shall suffer wrong,
The dwarves of yore made mighty spells,
While hammers  v  fell like ringing bells
In places deep, where dark things sleep,
In hollow halls beneath the fells.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/053 - Dwarven Tomb.jpg

cards.name: Fortune or Fate
cards.text: Action: Choose a hero in any player's discard pile. Put that card into play, under its owner's control.
cards.flavor:
'Yes, fortune or fate have heped you,' said Gandalf, 'not to mention courage.'
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/054 - Fortune or Fate.jpg

cards.name: The Favor of the Lady
cards.text:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains +1 [willpower].
cards.flavor:
"You are indeed high in the favor of the Lady!"
<cite>Unnamed Elf of Lórien,
The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/055 - The Favor of the Lady.jpg

cards.name: Power in the Earth
cards.text:
Attach to a location.
Attached location gets -1 [threat].
cards.flavor:
"Power to defy our Enemy is not in him, unless shuch power is in the earth itself."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/056 - Power in the Earth.jpg

cards.name: Unexpected Courage
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust Unexpected Courage to ready attached hero.
cards.flavor:
"Here am I, naughty little fly;
you are fat and lazy.
You cannot trap me, though you try,
in your cobwebs crazy."
<cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/057 - Unexpected Courage.jpg

cards.name: Daughter of the Nimrodel
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Daughter of the Nimrodel to heal up to 2 damage on any 1 hero.
cards.flavor: "Here is Nimrodel! Of this stream the Silvan Elves made many songs long ago, and still we sing them in the North...I will bate my feet, for it is said that the water is healing to the weary." <cite>Legolas, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/058 - Daughter of the Nimrodel.jpg

cards.name: Erebor Hammersmith
cards.text: Response: After you play Erebor Hammersmith, return the topmost attachment in any player's discard pile to his hand.
cards.flavor: "In Erebor in the Kingdom of Dain there is such skill..." <cite>Aragorn, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/059 - Erebor Hammersmith.jpg

cards.name: Henamarth Riversong
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Henamarth Riversong to look at the top card of the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
"And I reckon there's Elves and Elves. They're all elvish enough, but they're not all the same."
<cite>Sam Gamgee,
The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/060 - Henamarth Riversong.jpg

cards.name: Miner of the Iron Hills
cards.text: Response: After Miner of the Iron Hills enters play, choose and discard 1 Condition attachment from play.
cards.flavor:
...while the four dwarves sat around the table, and talked about mines and gold and troubles with goblins...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/061 - Miner of the Iron Hills.jpg

cards.name: Gleowine
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Gléowine to choose a player. That player draws 1 card.
cards.flavor:
Then the Riders of the King's House upon white horses rode round about the barrow and sang together a song of Théoden Thengle's son that Gléowine his minstrel made...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/062 - Gleowine.jpg

cards.name: Lore of Imladris
cards.text: Action: Choose a character. Heal all damage from that character.
cards.flavor:
"...understanding, making and healing...These things the Elves of Middle-earth have in some measure gained, though with sorrow."
<cite>Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/063 - Lore of Imladris.jpg

cards.name: Lorien's Wealth
cards.text: Action: Choose a player. That player draws 3 cards.
cards.flavor:
"That is the fairest of all the dwellings of my people. There are no trees like the tress of that land."
<cite>Legolas, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/064 - Lorien_s Wealth.jpg

cards.name: Radagast's Cunning
cards.text: Quest Action: Choose an enemy in the staging area. Until the end of the phase, that enemy does not contribute its [threat]
cards.flavor: "Radagast is, of course, a worthy Wizard, a master of shapes and changes of hue; and he has much lore of herbs and beasts, and birds are especially his friends." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/065 - Radagast_s Cunning.jpg

cards.name: Secret Paths
cards.text: Quest Action: Choose a location in the staging area. Until the end of the phase, that location does not contribute its [threat]
cards.flavor: ...Beorn advised them to take this way; for at a place a few days' ride due north of the Carrock was the gate of a little-known pathway through Mirkwood... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/066 - Secret Paths.jpg

cards.name: Gandalf's Search
cards.text: Action: Look at the top X cards of any player's deck, add 1 of those cards to its owner's hand, and return the rest to the top of the deck in any order.
cards.flavor:
"Less welcome did the Lord Denethor show me then than of old, and grudgingly he permitted me to search among his hoarded scrolls and books."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/067 - Gandalf_s Search.jpg

cards.name: Beorn's Hospitality
cards.text: Action: Choose a player. Heal all damage on each hero controlled by that player.
cards.flavor:
"...and my house is open to you, if ever you come back this way again."
<cite>Beorn, The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/068 - Beorn_s Hospitality.jpg

cards.name: Forest Snare
keywords: Attach to an enemy engaged with a player
cards.text:
Attach to an enemy engaged with a player.
Attached enemy cannot attack.
cards.flavor:
"We shall have it like a coney in a trap. Then we shall learn what kind of thing it is."
<cite>Unidentified Man of Gondor,
The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/069 - Forest Snare.jpg

cards.name: Protector of Lorien
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Action: Discard a card from your hand to give attached hero +1 [defense] or +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase. Limit 3 times per phase.
cards.flavor:
'Speak no evil of the lady Galadriel!' said Aragorn sternly. 'There is in her and in this land no evil, unless a man bring it hither himself. Then let him beware.'
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/070 - Protector of Lorien (errata).jpg
01 - Core Set/Player/070 - Protector of Lorien.jpg

cards.name: Dark Knowledge
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets -1 [willpower] Response: Exhaust Dark Knowledge to look at 1 shadow card that was just dealt to an enemy attacking you.
cards.flavor:
'Go on then!' said Frodo. 'What do you know?'
'Too much; too many dark things,' said Strider grimly.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/071 - Dark Knowledge.jpg

cards.name: Self Preservation
cards.text: Attach to a character. Action: Exhaust Self Preservation to heal 2 points of damage from attached character.
cards.flavor:
...how much more of this would they have to endure, or could they endure?
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Player/072 - Self Preservation.jpg

cards.name: Gandalf

cards.text: When Revealed: The player with the highest threat exhausts all heroes he controls. Then, attach this card to one of that player's heroes. (Counts as a condition attachment with the text, "Each time attached hero readies, deal it 1 damage.")

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Nightmare/Passage Through Mirkwood/006 - The Spider_s Web.jpg

cards.name: Backtrack!
cards.text: When Revealed: The topmost enemy or location card in the encounter discard pile is returned to the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal and resolve the topmost Shadow effect in the encounter discard pile for this attack.

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Nightmare/Passage Through Mirkwood/007 - Backtrack!.jpg

cards.name: Abandoned Camp
cards.text: Forced: After Abandoned Camp leaves play, each player must deal 2 damage to each exhausted character he controls.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack is undefended, discard all attachment cards players control.

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Nightmare/Passage Through Mirkwood/008 - Abandoned Camp.jpg

cards.name: Glade of the Spawn
cards.text: When Glade of the Spawn is the active location, it gains: "Forced: After a Spider enemy enters play, each player must choose and exhaust 1 character he controls."

images.source: 01 - Core Set/Nightmare/Passage Through Mirkwood/009 - Glade of the Spawn.jpg

cards.name: Bilbo Baggins
cards.text: The first player draws 1 additional card in the resource phase.
cards.flavor:
"Well, my dear fellow," said Bilbo, "now you've heard the news, can't you spare me a moment? I want your help in something urgent."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Player/001 - Bilbo Baggins.jpg

cards.name: Dunedain Mark
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains +1 [attack] Action: Pay 1 resource from attached hero's pool to attach Dúnedain Mark to another hero.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Player/002 - Dunedain Mark.jpg

cards.name: Campfire Tales
cards.text: Action: Each player draws 1 card.
cards.flavor: "It is a fair tale, though it is sad, as are all the tales of Middle-earth, and yet it may lift up your hearts." <cite>Strider, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Player/003 - Campfire Tales.jpg

cards.name: Winged Guardian
cards.text: Sentinel. Winged Guardian cannot have restricted attachments. Forced: After an attack in which Winged Guardian defends resolves, pay 1 [tactics] resource or discard Winged Guardian from play.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Player/004 - Winged Guardian.jpg

cards.name: The Eagles Are Coming!
cards.text: Action: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for any number of Eagle cards and add them to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.flavor: "The Eagles! The Eagles!" <cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Player/005 - The Eagles Are Coming!.jpg

cards.name: Westfold Horse-Breaker
cards.text: Action: Discard Westfold Westfold Horse-breaker to choose and ready a hero.
cards.flavor: "Your own valour has done more, and the stout legs of the Westfold-men marching through the night." <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Player/006 - Westfold Horse-Breaker.jpg

cards.name: Mustering the Rohirim
cards.text: Action: Search the top 10 cards of your deck for any 1 Rohan ally card and add it to your hand. Then, shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.flavor: "More speed we cannot make, if the strength of Rohan is to be gathered." <cite>Éomer, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Player/007 - Mustering the Rohirim.jpg

cards.name: Rivendell Minstrel
cards.text: Response: After you play Rivendell Minstrel from your hand, search your deck for 1 Song card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: As Elrond entered and went towards the seat prepared for him, Elvish minstrels began to make sweet music. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Player/008 - Rivendell Minstrel.jpg

cards.name: Strider's Path
cards.text: Response: After a location is revealed from the encounter deck, immediately travel to that location without resolving its Travel effect. If another location is currently active, return it to the staging area.
cards.flavor: "My cuts, short or long, don't go wrong." <cite>Strider, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Player/009 - Strider_s Path.jpg

cards.name: Song of Kings
cards.text:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [leadership] resource icon.
cards.flavor:
From the ashes a fire shall be woken,
A light from the shadows shall spring:
Renewed shall be blade that was broken,
The crownless again shall be king.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Player/010 - Song of Kings.jpg

cards.name: The Hunt Begins
cards.text: Setup: Reveal 1 card per player from the encounter deck, and add it to the staging area.

back.name: The Hunt Begins
back.text: Forced: After the players quest successfully, the first player looks at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Reveal and add 1 of those cards to the staging area, and discard the other 2 cards.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Quest/011 - 1A - The Hunt Begins.jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Quest/011 - 1B - The Hunt Begins.jpg

back.name: A New Terror Abroad
back.text: Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, the first player looks at the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. Reveal and add 1 of those cards to the staging area, and discard the other.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Quest/012 - 2A - A New Terror Abroad.jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Quest/012 - 2B - A New Terror Abroad.jpg

back.name: On the Trail
back.text:
Any player who does not control a hero with at least 1 Clue objective attached cannot commit characters to this quest. If there are ever no heroes with Clue objectives attached in play, reset the quest deck to stage 2B.

If the players defeat this stage, the players have once again found a true sign of Gollum's passing, and won the game.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Quest/013 - 3A - On the Trail.jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Quest/013 - 3B - On the Trail.jpg

cards.name: Signs of Gollum
cards.text: Response: After the players quest successfully, the players may claim Signs of Gollum if it has no attached encounters. When claimed, attach Signs of Gollum to any hero committed to the quest. (Counts as a Condition attachment with: "Forced: After attached hero is damaged or leaves play, return this card to the top of the encounter deck.")

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Encounter/014 - Signs of Gollum.jpg

cards.name: The Old Ford
keywords: X is the number of ally cards in play
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard from play all allies with a printed cost lower than the number of Riverland locations in play.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Encounter/015 - The Old Ford.jpg

cards.name: The Eaves of Mirkwood
cards.text: While The Eaves of Mirkwood is the active location, encounter card effects cannot be canceled.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Encounter/016 - The Eaves of Mirkwood.jpg

cards.name: River Ninglor
cards.text: While River Ninglor is the active location, remove 1 progress token from it and from the current quest at the end of each round.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Remove 1 progress token from the current quest. (2 progress tokens instead if this attack is undefended.)

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Encounter/017 - River Ninglor (errata).jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Encounter/017 - River Ninglor.jpg

cards.name: The East Bank
cards.text: While The East Bank is the active location, ally cards cost 1 additional matching resource to play from hand.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If you do not control at least 1 hero with a Clue card attached, return this enemy to the staging area after its attack resolves.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Encounter/018 - The East Bank.jpg

cards.name: The West Bank
cards.text: While The West Bank is the active location, attachment and event cards cost 1 additional matching resource to play from hand.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If you do not control at least 1 hero with a Clue card attached, double this enemy's base Û for this attack.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Encounter/019 - The West Bank.jpg

cards.name: Goblintown Scavengers
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard the top card of each player's deck. Until the end of the phase, increase Goblintown Scavenger's $ by the total printed cost of all cards discarded in this way.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Encounter/020 - Goblintown Scavengers.jpg

cards.name: Hunters from Mordor
cards.text: Hunters from Mordor get +2 Û and +2 $ for each Clue card in play.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal 1 damage to each hero with a Clue card attached. (3 damage instead if this attack is undefended.)

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Encounter/021 - Hunters from Mordor.jpg

cards.name: False Lead
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player chooses and shuffles a card with the printed Clue trait back into the encounter deck. If there are no Clue cards in play, False Lead gains surge.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Encounter/022 - False Lead.jpg

cards.name: Flooding
cards.text: When Revealed: Remove all progress tokens from all Riverland locations.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Resolve the "when revealed" effect of this card.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Encounter/023 - Flooding.jpg

cards.name: Old Wives' Tales
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard 1 resource from each hero's resource pool, if able. Exhaust any hero that could not discard a resource from its pool.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Encounter/024 - Old Wives_ Tales.jpg

cards.name: The Hunt for Gollum
cards.text: The Quest Deck has been modified for Nightmare Mode. Flip this card over and keep it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active throughout the game, which is now ready to begin.

back.name: The Hunt for Gollum
back.text:
You are playing Nightmare mode.

Forced: At the end of the refresh phase, choose an unclaimed Clue card not attached to a Mordor enemy and attach it to a Mordor enemy, if able. (If it was guarded, detach the encounter guarding if first. The newly attached Mordor enemy is now guarding it.)

If at any point there are four or more Clue cards attached to Mordor enemies, the players lose the game.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Nightmare/001 - The Hunt for Gollum.jpg

cards.name: Ravenous Hawk
cards.text: Forced: When a card effect instructs a player to "look" at cards in the encounter deck and Ravenous Hawk is among those cards, that player must put Ravenous Hawk into play engaged with him. (This does not satisfy the Forced effect of stage 1B or 2B).

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Nightmare/002 - Ravenous Hawk.jpg

cards.name: Hunting Warg
cards.text: Forced: At the beginning of the refresh phase, if Hunting Warg entered play this round, search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy of Hunters from Morder and add it to the staging area, if able. Shuffle the encounter deck.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Nightmare/003 - Hunting Warg.jpg

cards.name: Watched Path
cards.text: Each player who does not control at least 1 Clue card cannot draw cards through card effects.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If you do not control at least 1 Clue card, discard all cards from your hand.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Nightmare/004 - Watched Path.jpg

cards.name: Hunter's Lookout
cards.text: Each Mordor enemy with at least 1 Clue card attached gets +2 Ú.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Ú for each Clue card in play until the end of the round.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Nightmare/005 - Hunter_s Lookout.jpg

cards.name: Dark Pools
cards.text:
Progress cannot be placed on Dark Pools while it is in the staging area.

Forced: After Dark Pools becomes the active location, each player must discard an ally with the highest printed cost among the allies he controls.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Nightmare/006 - Dark Pools.jpg

cards.name: The Enemy's Trail
cards.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter discard pile for a Clue card and attach it to a Mordor enemy in play, if able. If no card is attached by this effect, The Enemy's Trail gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Search the encounter discard pile for a Clue card and attach it to a Mordor enemy in play, if able.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Nightmare/007 - The Enemy_s Trail.jpg

cards.name: Restless Hunters
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player chooses a Clue card attached to a hero and attaches it to a Mordor enemy in play, if able.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Damage from this attack must be applied to a hero you control with a Clue card attached, if able.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Nightmare/008 - Restless Hunters.jpg

cards.name: The Trail Goes Cold
cards.text:
When Revealed: Attach to the active location and remove all progress from that location. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per location. Attached location contributes its $ during the quest phase as if it were in the staging area.")

If The Trail Goes Cold does not attach to a location as a result of its effect, it gains surge.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/01 - The Hunt for Gollum/Nightmare/009 - The Trail Goes Cold.jpg

cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.text: Response: After Frodo Baggins is damaged, cancel the damage and instead raise your threat by the amount of damage he would have been dealt. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: Frodo began to feel restless, and the old paths seemed too well-trodden. he looked at maps and wondered what lay beyond their edges... <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Player/025 - Frodo Baggins.jpg

cards.name: Dunedain Warning
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains +1 [defense] Action: Pay 1 resource from attached hero's pool to attach Dúnedain Warning to another hero.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Player/026 - Dunedain Warning.jpg

cards.name: Second Breakfast
cards.text: Action: Each player returns the topmost attachment card from his discard pile to his hand.
cards.flavor:
...he was just sitting down to a nice little second-breakfast in the dinning-room...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Player/027 - Second Breakfast.jpg

cards.name: Beorning Beekeeper
cards.text: Action: Discard Beorning Beekeeper from play to deal 1 damage to each enemy in the staging area.
cards.flavor: "We are getting near," said Gandalf. "We are on th eedge of his bee pastures." <cite> The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Player/028 - Beorning Beekeeper.jpg

cards.name: Born Aloft
cards.text: Attach to an ally. Action: Discard Born Aloft from play to return attached ally to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: "Very well," said Gandalf. "Take us where and as far as you will!" <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Player/029 - Born Aloft.jpg

cards.name: Eomund
cards.text: Response: After Éomund leaves play, ready all Rohan characters in play.
cards.flavor: "You I have not seen before, for you are young, but I have spoken with Eomund your father..." <cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Player/030 - Eomund.jpg

cards.name: Nor am I a Stranger
cards.text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains the Rohan trait.
cards.flavor: "Nor indeed am I a stranger: for I have been in this land before, more than once, and ridden with the host of the Rohirrim, though under other name and in other guise." <cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Player/031 - Nor am I a Stranger.jpg

cards.name: Longbeard Map-Maker
cards.text: Action: Spend 1 [lore] resource to give Longbeard Map-Maker +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: On the table in the light of a big lamp with a red shade he spread a piece of parchment rather like a map. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Player/032 - Longbeard Map-Maker.jpg

cards.name: A Burning Brand
cards.text: Attach to a [lore] character. Restricted. Response: Exhaust A Burning Brand to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during an attack that attached character is defending.
cards.flavor:
"Keep close to the fire, with your faces outward!" cried Strider. "Keep some of th elonger sticks ready in your hands."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Player/033 - A Burning Brand (errata).jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Player/033 - A Burning Brand.jpg

cards.name: Song of Wisdom
cards.text:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [lore] resource icon.
cards.flavor:
It sit beside the fire and think
of all that I have seen,
of meadow-flowers and butterflies
in summers that have been
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Player/034 - Song of Wisdom.jpg

cards.name: Grimbeorn's Quest
cards.text: Setup: Add The Carrock to the staging area. Remove 4 unique Troll cards and 4 copies of the "Sacked!" card from the encounter deck and set them aside, out of play. Then shuffle 1 "Sacked!" card per player back into the encounter deck.

back.name: Grimbeorn's Quest
back.text: Forced: After placing the 7th progress token on Grimbeorn's Quest, The Carrock becomes the active location. Discard the previous active location from play.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Quest/035 - 1A - Grimbeorn_s Quest.jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Quest/035 - 01B - Grimbeorn_s Quest.jpg

back.name: Against the Trolls
back.text:
When Revealed: Place the unique Troll cards previously set aside into the staging area.

Players cannot defeat this stage if there are any Troll enemies in play.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Quest/036 - 2A - Against the Trolls.jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Quest/036 - 2B - Against the Trolls.jpg

cards.name: Grimbeorn the Old
cards.text:
Grimbeorn the Old does not exhaust to defend against Troll enemies.

If Grimbeorn the Old has 8 or more resource tokens on him, he joins the first player as an ally.

Action: Spend 1 Ì resource to place that resource on Grimbeorn the Old.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Encounter/037 - Grimbeorn the Old.jpg

cards.text:
While Louis is engaged with a player, all Troll enemies gain, "Forced: After this enemy attacks, the defending player must raise his threat by 3."

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Encounter/038 - Louis.jpg

cards.text:
While Morris is engaged with a player, all Troll enemies get +1 Û.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Encounter/039 - Morris.jpg

cards.name: Stuart
cards.text:
While Stuart is engaged with a player, all Troll enemies get +1 Ú.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Encounter/040 - Stuart.jpg

cards.name: Rupert
cards.text:
Forced: After Rupert attacks, shuffle all copies of the "Sacked!" card from the discard pile back into the encounter deck.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Encounter/041 - Rupert.jpg

cards.text: Forced: If Muck Adder damages a character, discard that character from play.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending character gets -1 Ú for the duration of this attack.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Encounter/042 - Muck Adder.jpg

Players cannot travel to The Carrock except through quest card effects.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Encounter/043 - The Carrock.jpg

cards.text: While it is in the staging area, River Langflood gets +1 $ for each Troll enemy in play.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Encounter/044 - River Langflood.jpg

cards.text: Response: After you travel to Bee Pastures, search the encounter deck and discard pile for Grimbeorn the Old and add him to the staging area. Then, shuffle the encounter deck.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Encounter/045 - Bee Pastures.jpg

cards.text: While Oak-wood Grove is the active location, resource tokens from any sphere may be spent as Ì resource tokens.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Encounter/046 - Oak-wood Grove.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: Each player raises his threat by the total $ of all cards in the staging area. Any player may choose to discard from play 1 Creature ally card he controls to cancel this effect.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Encounter/047 - A Frightened Beast.jpg

cards.name: Sacked!
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to a hero with no "Sacked!" cards attached controlled by the first player. (Cannot be canceled.) Counts as a condition attachment with the text: "Attached hero cannot attack, defend, commit to a quest, trigger its effect, or collect resources."
cards.shadow: Shadow: If attacking enemy is a Troll, resolve this card's "when revealed" effect.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Encounter/048 - Sacked!.jpg

cards.name: Roasted Slowly
cards.text: When Revealed: Destroy all heroes with the card "Sacked!" attached. Then, shuffle Roasted Slowly back into the encounter deck.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If attacking enemy is a Troll, remove 2 damage tokens from it.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Encounter/049 - Roasted Slowly.jpg

cards.name: Conflict at the Carrock
cards.text: The Quest Deck has been modified for Nightmare Mode. Flip this card over and keep it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active throughout the game, which is now ready to begin.

back.name: Conflict at the Carrock
back.text:
You are playing Nightmare mode. 

Stage 1A should read, "Remove 5 unique Troll cards" instead of 4.

Stage 2B should read, "When Revealed: Place Louis, Morris, Rupert and Stuart into the staging area."

Forced: At the end of the quest phase, if no progress was placed on the current quest this phase, place 1 progress on the current quest (bypassing the active location).

Response: After defeating a unique Troll enemy, you may choose and discard 1 "Sacked!" card from play.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Nightmare/001 - Conflict at the Carrock.jpg

cards.text: While Savage Hill-troll is in the victory display, each Troll enemy gets +1 hit point.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If attacking enemy is a Troll, defending character does not ready during the refresh phase this round.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Nightmare/002 - Savage Hill-troll.jpg

cards.name: Rob ' Bob
cards.text: Forced: After Rob & Bob makes its first attack each round, if there are two or more players, it engages the next player and makes an additional attack (discard and deal a new shadow card for this attack).

cards.text:
Immune to player events.

cards.text:
Rupert's Ú cannot be reduced.

cards.text:
Cannot have player attachments.

cards.text: While Troll Lair is in the staging area, players cannot reduce their threat.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Nightmare/008 - Troll Lair.jpg

cards.text: Forced: After any amount of progress is placed on Hives and Hives, deal 1 damage to each character in play.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/02 - Conflict at the Carrock/Nightmare/010 - Time for Supper.jpg

cards.name: Grimbeorn's Folly
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Rob & Bob to the staging area. Then, each player must search the encounter deck and discard pile for a non-unique Troll enemy and add it to the staging area, if able. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Grimbeorn's Folly
back.text: When Rob & Bob have been defeated, the players have rescued Grimbeorn the Old from certain death, and have won the game.

cards.text: Response: After a character leaves play, ready Prince Imrahil. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: But beyond, in the great fief of Belfalas, dwelt Prince Imrahil in his castle of Dol Amroth by the sea, and he was of high blood, and his fold also, tall men and proud with sea-grey eyes. <cite>The Return of the King.</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Player/050 - Prince Imrahil.jpg

cards.text: Action: Move any number of resource tokens from a [leadership] hero's resource pool to any other hero's resource pool.

cards.text: Response: After an ally is destroyed, exhaust 1 Eagle character to move that ally from the discard pile to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: The pale peaks of the mountains were coming nearer, moonlit spikes of rock sticking out of black shadows. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Player/054 - To the Eyrie.jpg

cards.text: While committed to a quest, Escort from Edoras gets +2 [willpower] Forced: After resolving a quest to which Escort from Edoras was committed, discard Escort from Edoras from play.

cards.name: Ancient Mathom
cards.text: Attach to a location. Response: After attached location is explored, the first player draws 3 cards.
cards.flavor: The Mathom-house it was called; for anything that Hobbits had no immediate use for, but were unwilling to throw away, they called a mathom. Their dwellings were apt to become rather crowded with mathoms... <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Player/056 - Ancient Mathom.jpg

cards.name: Haldir of Lorien
cards.text: Ranged. Sentinel.
cards.flavor: "But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies, and they speak the languages of other lands." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Player/057 - Haldir of Lorien.jpg

cards.name: Infighting
cards.text: Action: Move any number of damage from one enemy to another.
cards.flavor: That's cursed rebel-talk, and I'll stick you, if you don't shut it down, see? <cite>Orc Soldier, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Player/058 - Infighting.jpg

cards.text: Radagast collects 1 resource each resource phase. These resources can be used to pay for Creature cards played from your hand. Action: Spend X resources from Radagast's pool to heal X wounds on any 1 Creature.
cards.flavor: "I have an urgent errand. My news is evil."

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Player/059 - Radagast.jpg

back.text:
Response: After the quest phase begins, the first player may place X damage tokens on Wilyador to look at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Reveal and add 1 of these cards to the staging area, and discard the other 2. X is the number of players in the game.

Forced: After a card effect heals Wilyador, remove that card from the game.

02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Quest/061 - 2B - Radagast_s Request.jpg

back.name: Return to Rhosgobel
back.text:
When Revealed: Heal 5 wounds from Wilyador for each Athelas objective card the players control.

If Wilyador is completely healed when this effect resolves, Wilyador survives and the players have won the game. Otherwise, the players have lost the game.

back.text:
You are playing Nightmare mode.

Setup: Search the encounter deck for 1 copy of Goblin Eagle-hunter and add it to the staging area. Then shuffle the encounter deck.

Forced: The first Creature enemy revealed during each quest phase gains surge.

Response: After an Athelas card is placed in the discard pile, you may shuffle it into the encounter deck.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Nightmare/001 - A Journey to Rhosgobel.jpg

Goblin Eagle-hunter gets +1 hit point per player.

Forced: At the end of the combat phase, deal 1 damage to Wilyador.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If Wilyador has 10 or less damage on him, deal 2 damage to Wilyador.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Nightmare/002 - Goblin Eagle-hunter.jpg

cards.text:
While Treetop Bird-eater is engaged with a player, characters controlled by that player cannot be healed.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Nightmare/003 - Treetop Bird-Eater.jpg

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Nightmare/004 - Dark-wood Grove.jpg

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Nightmare/005 - Labyrinthine Woods.jpg

cards.shadow: Shadow: Resolve the "when revealed" effect of Shot from the Sky.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Nightmare/007 - Shot from the Sky.jpg

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/03 - A Journey to Rhosgobel/Nightmare/008 - Noxious Supplies.jpg

cards.name: Brand son of Bain
cards.text: Ranged. Response: After Brand son of Bain attacks and defeats an enemy engaged with another player, choose and ready one of that player's characters.
cards.flavor:
"The grandson of Bard the Bowman rules them, Brand son of Bain son of Bard."
<cite>Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/04 - The Hills of Emyn Muil/Player/072 - Brand son of Bain.jpg

cards.name: Keen-eyed Took
cards.text: Response: After Keen-eyed Took enters play, reveal the top card of each player's deck. Action: Return Keen-eyed Took to your hand to discard the top card of each player's deck.
cards.flavor:
Then something Tookish woke up inside him...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/04 - The Hills of Emyn Muil/Player/073 - Keen-eyed Took.jpg

cards.name: Rear Guard
cards.text: Quest Action: Discard a [leadership] ally to give each hero committed to this quest +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
In the dark at the rear, grim and silent, walked Aragorn.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/04 - The Hills of Emyn Muil/Player/074 - Rear Guard.jpg

cards.name: Descendant of Thorondor
cards.text: Descendant of Thorondor cannot have restricted attachments. Response: After Descendant of Thorondor enters or leaves play, deal 2 damage to any 1 enemy in the staging area.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/04 - The Hills of Emyn Muil/Player/075 - Descendant of Thorondor.jpg

cards.name: Meneldor's Flight
cards.text: Action: Choose an Eagle ally. Return that character to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor:
Not event an eagle poised against the sun would have marked the hobbits sitting there, under the weight of doom...
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/04 - The Hills of Emyn Muil/Player/076 - Meneldor_s Flight.jpg

cards.name: The Riddermark's Finest
cards.text: Action: Exhaust and discard The Riddermark's Finest to place 2 progress tokens on any location.
cards.flavor:
"And there are no horses like the ones that are bred in that great vale between the Misty Mountains and the White."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/04 - The Hills of Emyn Muil/Player/077 - The Riddermark_s Finest.jpg

cards.name: Ride to Ruin
cards.text: Action: Discard a Rohan ally to choose a location. Place 3 progress tokens on that location.
cards.flavor:
"Death! Ride, ride to ruin and the world's ending!"
<cite>Éomer, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/04 - The Hills of Emyn Muil/Player/078 - Ride to Ruin.jpg

cards.name: Gildor Inglorion
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Gildor Inglorion to look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Switch one of those cards with a card from your hand. Then, return the 3 cards to the top of your deck, in any order.
cards.flavor: "Go not to the Elves for counsel, for they will say both no and yes." <cite>Frodo Baggins, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/04 - The Hills of Emyn Muil/Player/079 - Gildor Inglorion.jpg

cards.name: Gildor's Counsel
cards.text: Play during the Quest phase, before characters are committed to the Quest. Action: Reveal 1 less card from the encounter deck this phase. (To a minimum of 1.)
cards.flavor:
"The wide world is all about you: you can fence yourselves in, but you cannot for ever fence it out."
<cite>Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/04 - The Hills of Emyn Muil/Player/080 - Gildor_s Counsel.jpg

cards.name: Song of Travel
cards.text:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [spirit] resource icon.
cards.flavor:
The Road goes ever on and on
Down from the door where it began.
Now far ahead the road has gone,
And I must follow, if I can.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/04 - The Hills of Emyn Muil/Player/081 - Song of Travel.jpg

cards.flavor: "...in Gondor we must trust to such weapons as we have." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Player/095 - Boromir (errata).jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Player/095 - Boromir.jpg

cards.name: Dunedain Watcher
cards.text: Response: Discard Dúnedain Watcher from play to cancel the shadow effects of a card just triggered.
cards.flavor: "If simple folk are free from care and fear, simple they will be, and we must be secret to keep them so. That has been the task of my kindred, while the years have lengthened and the grass has grown." <cite>Strider, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Player/096 - Dunedain Watcher.jpg

cards.text: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains ranged. Action: Pay 1 resource from attached hero's pool to attach Dúnedain Cache to another hero.

cards.text: Ranged.Vassal of the Windlord cannot have restricted attachments. Forced: After an attack in which Vassal of the Windlord attacked resolves, discard Vassal of the Windlord from play.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Player/098 - Vassal of the Windlord.jpg

cards.name: Song of Mocking
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust Song of Mocking to choose another hero. Until the end of the phase, attached hero takes all damage assigned to the chosen hero.
cards.flavor:
Old fat spider spinning in a tree!
Old fat spider can't see me!
Attercop! Attercop!
Won't you stop. Stop your spinning and look for me!
<cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Player/099 - Song of Mocking.jpg

cards.name: Elfhelm
cards.text: While Elfhelm is ready, he gains: "Response: After your threat is raised as the result of questing unsuccessfully, or by an encounter or quest card effect, reduce your threat by 1."
cards.flavor: "Buy my lord sends word that we must set ourselves in readiness: orders may come for a sudden move." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Player/100 - Elfhelm.jpg

cards.name: We Do Not Sleep
cards.text: Action: Until the end of the phase, Rohan characters do not exhaust to commit to quests.
cards.flavor: "But we must ride more warily; for war is abroad, and the Rohirrim, the Horse-lords, do not sleep, even if it seems so from afar." <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Player/101 - We Do Not Sleep.jpg

cards.name: Silvan Tracker
cards.text: Response: After a Silvan character readies during the refresh phase, heal 1 damage from that character.
cards.flavor: "The Wood-elves tracked him first, an easy task for them, for his trail was still fresh then." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Rings</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Player/102 - Silvan Tracker.jpg

cards.text: Attach to a Hobbit character. Action: Exhaust Fast Hitch to ready attached character.
cards.flavor: 'And I put as fast a hitch over the stump as any one could have done, in the Shire or out of it.' <cite>Sam, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Player/103 - Fast Hitch.jpg

Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [tactics] resource icon.
cards.flavor: We go, we go, we go to war, to hew the stone and break the door. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Player/104 - Song of Battle.jpg

cards.name: Into the Marshes
cards.text: Setup: Search the encounter deck for Gollum, and add it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck, then reveal 1 card per player from the encounter deck and add it to the staging area.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Quest/105 - 1A - Into the Marshes.jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Quest/105 - 1B - Into the Marshes.jpg

back.name: The Capture
back.text:
Forced: After this stage is defeated, the first player chooses a player. That player must pass an Escape test, dealing 1 card from the encounter deck for each resource token on Gollum, to capture him. If Gollum is not captured at this time, reset the quest deck to stage 1B.

If this final Escape test is passed, the players have captured Gollum and won the game.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Quest/106 - 2A - The Capture.jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Quest/106 - 2B - The Capture.jpg

cards.name: Gollum
cards.text:
If Gollum ever has 8 or more resource tokens on him, shuffle him back into the encounter deck.

Forced: At the end of the quest phase, the party must make an escape test, dealing 1 card per player from the encounter deck. If this test is failed, place 2 resource tokens on Gollum.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Encounter/107 - Gollum.jpg

cards.name: A Wisp of Pale Sheen
cards.text:
When Revealed: Place 2 resource tokens on Gollum. Any player may exhaust a Î hero to reduce this effect to 1 resource token.

Escape: 4

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Encounter/108 - A Wisp of Pale Sheen.jpg

cards.name: Nightfall
cards.text:
When Revealed: The first player makes an escape test, dealing 2 cards from the encounter deck. If this test is failed, place 1 resource token on Gollum and raise each player's threat by 2.

Escape: 2

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Encounter/109 - Nightfall.jpg

cards.name: Through the Mist
cards.text:
When Revealed: The first player makes an escape test counting Û instead of Ò, dealing 2 cards from the encounter deck. If this test is failed, place 1 resource token on Gollum and raise each player's threat by 1.

Escape: 3

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Encounter/110 - Through the Mist.jpg

cards.name: The Lights of the Dead
cards.text:
When Revealed: Each player must make an escape test, dealing 2 cards from the encounter deck for each test. Each player that fails this test places 1 resource token on Gollum, and raises his threat by 1.

Escape: 5

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Encounter/111 - The Lights of the Dead.jpg

cards.name: Giant Marsh Worm
cards.text:
Forced: Remove 2 damage from Giant Marsh Worm at the end of each round.

Escape: 2

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Encounter/112  - Giant Marsh Worm.jpg

cards.name: Impassable Bog
cards.text:
When Revealed: Place 1 resource token on Gollum for each location card in the staging area.

Escape: 2

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Encounter/113 - Impassable Bog.jpg

cards.name: The Heart of the Marshes
cards.text:
While The Heart of the Marshes is the active location, all cards dealt from the encounter deck for escape tests get +1 Escape. (Cards receive this bonus even if they do not have a printed escape value.)

Escape: 1

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Encounter/114 - The Heart of the Marshes.jpg

cards.name: Fens and Mires
cards.text:
Forced: After the players travel to this location, place 1 resource token on Gollum.

Escape: 2

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Encounter/115 - Fens and Mires.jpg

cards.name: The Dead Marshes
cards.text: The Quest Deck has been modified for Nightmare Mode. Flip this card over and keep it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active throughout the game, which is now ready to begin.

back.name: The Dead Marshes
back.text:
You are playing Nightmare mode.

Players cannot reduce their threat.

Setup: Search the encounter deck for The Mere of Dead Faces, and add it to the staging area. Then shuffle the encounter deck.

Forced: After Gollum is placed in the discard pile, shuffle him into the encounter deck.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Nightmare/001 - The Dead Marshes.jpg

cards.name: The Mere of Dead Faces
cards.text:
X is the number of resource tokens here. Cannot leave the staging area.

If Gollum is not in play, any resource tokens that would be placed on Gollum are placed here instead.

Forced: After Gollum enters play, place 2 resource tokens on Gollum, then move all resource tokens from The Mere of Dead Faces to Gollum.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Nightmare/002 - The Mere of Dead Faces.jpg

cards.name: Stagnant Quagmire
cards.text:
While Stagnant Quagmire is in play, it adds its Escape value to all escape tests.

Escape: 2
cards.shadow: Shadow: Perform an escape test, dealing 1 card from the encounter deck. If this test is failed, discard defending character.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Nightmare/003 - Stagnant Quagmire.jpg

cards.name: Things in the Pools
cards.text: Forced: After a character commits to an escape test, deal 1 damage to that character.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û (+2 Û instead if attacking enemy is Undead).

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Nightmare/004 - Things in the Pools.jpg

cards.name: Marsh-wight
cards.text: Forced: After Marsh-wight engages a player, that player makes an escape test, dealing 3 cards from the encounter deck. If this test is failed, place 2 resource tokens on Gollum and Marsh-wight make an immediate attack.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Nightmare/005 - Marsh-wight.jpg

cards.name: Lost Soul of Lorien
cards.text: Forced: After Lost Soul of Lórien is destroyed, attach it to a hero with 1 or more Ò, if able. (Counts as a condition attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero's Ò is reduced to 0.")

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Nightmare/006 - Lost Soul of Lorien.jpg

cards.name: Ill-fated Guard
cards.text: While Ill-fated Guard is engaged with a player, that player cannot commit more than 1 character to each escape test.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard all attachments from each characater you control with 3 or more Ò.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Nightmare/007 - Ill-fated Guard.jpg

cards.name: Candles of Corpses
cards.text:
When Revealed: Each player makes an escape test, dealing 1 card from the encounter deck. Each player who fails this test must either discard a hero he controls from play or raise his threat by 5.

Escape: 5

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Nightmare/008 - Candles of Corpses.jpg

cards.name: Swarming Mosquitoes
cards.text:
When Revealed: The first player makes an escape test counting Ú instead of Ò, dealing 2 cards from the encounter deck. If this test is failed, place 1 resource token on Gollum and deal 1 damage to each character in play.

Escape: 3

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Nightmare/009 - Swarming Mosquitoes.jpg

cards.name: Devilry of the Dark Land
cards.text:
When Revealed: Return the top X Undead enemies in the encounter discard pile to the staging area, where X is the number of players. If no enemies were returned to the staging area as a result of this effect, Devilry of the Dark Land gains surge.

Escape: 10

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/05 - The Dead Marshes/Nightmare/010 - Devilry of the Dark Land.jpg

cards.name: Dain Ironfoot
cards.text: While Dáin Ironfoot is ready, Dwarf characters get +1 [attack] and +1 [willpower].
cards.flavor: "You have not heard of Dáin and the dwarves of the Iron Hills?" <cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Player/116 - Dain Ironfoot.jpg

cards.name: Dunedain Signal
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains sentinel. Action: Pay 1 resource from attached hero's pool to attach Dúnedain Signal to another hero.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Player/117 - Dunedain Signal.jpg

cards.name: Dawn Take You All
cards.text: Play after shadow cards have been dealt, before any attacks have resolved. Combat Action: Each player may choose and discard 1 facedown shadow card from an enemy with which he is engaged.
cards.flavor: "Dawn take you all, and be stone to you!" <cite>Gandalf, The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Player/118 - Dawn Take You All.jpg

cards.name: Eagles of the Misty Mountains
cards.text: Eagles of the Misty Mountains cannot have restricted attachments. Eagles of the Misty Mountains gets +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] for each facedown attachment it has. Response: After another Eagle character leaves play, you may attach that card facedown to Eagles of the Misty Mountains.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Player/119 - Eagles of the Misty Mountains.jpg

cards.name: Support of the Eagles
cards.text: Attach to a [tactics] hero. Action: Exhaust Support of the Eagles to choose an Eagle ally. Until the end of the phase, attached hero adds that ally's [attack] or [defense] (choose 1) to its own.
cards.flavor: "I would bear you, whither you will, even were you made of stone." <cite>Gwaihir, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Player/120 - Support of the Eagles.jpg

cards.name: West Road Traveller
cards.text: Response: After you play West Road Traveller from your hand, switch the active location with any other location in the staging area.
cards.flavor:
The dark world was rushing by, and the wind sang loudly in his ears.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Player/121 - West Road Traveller.jpg

cards.name: Astonishing Speed
cards.text: Action: Until the end of the phase, all Rohan characters get +2 [willpower]
cards.flavor: With astonishing speed and skill they checked their steeds, wheeled, and came charging round. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Player/122 - Astonishing Speed.jpg

cards.name: Mirkwood Runner
cards.text:
While Mirkwood Runner is attacking alone, the defending enemy does not count its [defense].
"...let a ploughman plough, but choose an otter for swimming, and for running light over grass and leaf or over snow-an Elf."
–Legolas, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Player/123 - Mirkwood Runner.jpg

cards.name: Rumor from the Earth
cards.text: Action: Look at the top card of the encounter deck. Then, you may pay 1 [lore] resource to return Rumour from the Earth to your hand.
cards.flavor: 'Where sight fails the earth may bring us rumour,' said Aragorn. 'The land must groan under their hated feet.' <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Player/124 - Rumor from the Earth.jpg

cards.name: Shadow of the Past
cards.text: Action: Move the top card of the encounter discard pile to the top of the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: The wizard's face remained grave and attentive, and only a flicker in his deep eyes showed that he was startled and indeed alarmed. 'It has been called that before,' he said, 'but not by you.' <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Player/125 - Shadow of the Past.jpg

cards.name: Through the Forest
cards.text: Setup: Search the encounter deck for Gollum. Choose a player to guard Gollum at the start of the game, and place Gollum in front of that player. Then shuffle the encounter deck. Reveal 1 card per player from the encounter deck, and add it to the staging area.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Quest/126 - 1A - Through the Forest.jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Quest/126 - 1B - Through the Forest.jpg

back.name: Escape Attempt
back.text:
The player guarding Gollum cannot commit characters to this quest (unless he is the only player remaining in the game).

If the players quest unsuccessfully, Gollum escapes and the players have lost the game.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Quest/127 - 2A - Escape Attempt.jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Quest/127 - 2B - Escape Attempt.jpg

back.name: To the Elvin King's Halls
back.text: The player guarding Gollum cannot play cards from his hand.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Quest/128 - 3A - To the Elven King_s Halls.jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Quest/128 - 3B - To the Elven King_s Halls.jpg

back.name: Ambush
back.text:
Forced: At the beginning of the combat phase, all enemies in play engage the player guarding Gollum.

Players cannot defeat this stage if there are any enemies in play. If players defeat this stage, they have won the game.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Quest/129 - 4A - Ambush.jpg
02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Quest/129 - 4B - Ambush.jpg
