cards.text:
Damage from undefended attacks against you must be dealt to Gollum. If Gollum is destroyed, or if the player guarding Gollum is eliminated, the players have lost the game.

Forced: At the end of each round, raise the threat of the player guarding Gollum by 3. Then, that player may choose a new player to guard Gollum.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Encounter/130 - Gollum.jpg

cards.name: The Spider's Ring
cards.text: While The Spider's Ring is the active location, the player guarding Gollum cannot change.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack is undefended, return any current active location to the staging area. The Spider's Ring becomes the active location.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Encounter/131 - The Spider_s Ring.jpg

cards.name: Dry Watercourse
cards.text: While Dry Watercourse is the active location, all treachery card effects that target the player guarding Gollum also target each other player.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Encounter/132 - Dry Watercourse.jpg

cards.name: Woodman's Glade
cards.text:
Travel: The player guarding Gollum must exhaust a hero he controls to travel to Woodman's Glade.

Response: After exploring Woodman's Glade, reduce the threat of each player not guarding Gollum by 2.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Encounter/133 - Woodman_s Glade.jpg

cards.name: Wood Elf Path
cards.text: Response: After the players travel to Wood Elf Path, the player guarding Gollum may choose a new player to guard him.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Encounter/134 - Wood Elf Path.jpg

cards.name: Gollum's Anguish
cards.text: When Revealed: Raise the threat of the player guarding Gollum by 8. That player must choose a new player to guard Gollum, if able.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Raise the threat of the player guarding Gollum by 4.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Encounter/135 - Gollum_s Anguish.jpg

cards.name: Gollum's Bite
cards.text: When Revealed: Deal 4 damage to a hero controlled by the player guarding Gollum. That player must choose a new player to guard Gollum, if able.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal 2 damage to a hero controlled by the player guarding Gollum.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Encounter/136 - Gollum_s Bite.jpg

cards.name: Wasted Provisons
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard the top 10 cards from the deck of the player guarding Gollum. That player must choose a new player to guard Gollum, if able.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard the top 5 cards from the deck of the player guarding Gollum.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Encounter/137 - Wasted Provisons.jpg

cards.name: Mirkwood Bats
cards.text: Forced: After Mirkwood Bats engages a player, deal 1 damage to each character controlled by the player guarding Gollum.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Encounter/138 - Mirkwood Bats.jpg

cards.name: Attercop, Attercop
cards.text: Forced: At the beginning of the encounter phase, Attercop, Attercop automatically engages the player guarding Gollum, regardless of his threat.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Encounter/139 - Attercop, Attercop.jpg

cards.name: Return to Mirkwood
cards.text: The Quest Deck has been modified for Nightmare Mode. Flip this card over and keep it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active throughout the game, which is now ready to begin.

back.name: Return to Mirkwood
back.text:
You are playing Nightmare mode.

Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, the player who is guarding Gollum must either exhaust a hero he controls or resolve the "when revealed" effect of the topmost Tantrum card in the encounter discard pile.

Forced: When Stage 4A is revealed, search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy of Attercop, Attercop and add it to the staging area, if able. Shuffle the encounter deck.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Nightmare/001 - Return to Mirkwood.jpg

cards.name: Ambushing Orcs
cards.text: When Ambushing Orcs is dealt a shadow card that targets the player guarding Gollum, that shadow card also targets each other player.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Nightmare/002 - Ambushing Orcs.jpg

cards.name: Pursuing Warg-rider
cards.text: Forced: After the player guarding Gollum changes, Pursuing Warg-rider engages the player Guarding Gollum and makes an immediate attack against that player.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Nightmare/003 - Pursuing Warg-rider.jpg

cards.name: Web-spinner
cards.text: When Revealed: The player guarding Gollum must either exhaust a hero he controls, or Web-spinner gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: the player guarding Gollum must exhaust a character he controls.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Nightmare/004 - Web-spinner.jpg

cards.name: Deceptive Path
cards.text:
Progress cannot be placed on Deceptive Path while it is in the staging area.

Forced: After Deceptive Path becomes the active location, shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a location is discarded. Reveal that location and make it the active location. Then, discard Deceptive Path.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Nightmare/005 - Deceptive Path.jpg

cards.name: Web-wall
cards.text: When Revealed: Reveal the topmost Spider enemy in the encounter discard pile and add it to the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: The player guarding Gollum must discard all resources from each of his heroes' resource pools.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Nightmare/006 - Web-wall.jpg

cards.name: Isolation
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach Isolation to the current quest. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "All characters lose the ranged and sentinel keywords. The player guarding Gollum cannot choose a new player to guard Gollum.")

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Nightmare/007 - Isolation.jpg

cards.name: Befouled Equipment
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard all attachments controlled by the player guarding Gollum. Then, remove all cards in that player's discard pile from the game. If no attachments are discarded as a result of this effect, Befouled Equipment gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard all attachments controlled by the player guarding Gollum.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Nightmare/008 - Befouled Equipment.jpg

cards.name: Wickedness and Mischief
cards.text: When Revealed: The player guarding Gollum must either reveal the topmost Tantrum card in the encounter discard pile, or reveal 2 additional encounter cards from the encounter deck.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal the topmost Tantrum card in the encounter discard pile as a new shadow card for this attack, if able.

images.source: 02 - Shadows of Mirkwood/06 - Return to Mirkwood/Nightmare/009 - Wickedness and Mischief.jpg

cards.name: Dwalin
cards.text: Response: After Dwalin attacks and destroys an Orc enemy, lower your threat by 2.
cards.flavor:
It was a dwarf with a blue beard tucked into a golden belt, and very bright eyes under his dark-green hood.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/001 - Dwalin.jpg

cards.name: Bifur
cards.text: Action: Pay 1 resource from a hero's resource pool to add 1 resource to Bifur's resource pool. Any player may trigger this ability. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "And winter comes after autumn." <cite>Bifur, The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/002 - Bifur.jpg

cards.name: Narvi's Belt
cards.text: Attach to a Dwarf hero. Action: Exhaust Narvi's Belt to give attached hero a [leadership], [lore], [tactics] or [spirit] icon until the end of the phase.

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/003 - Narvi_s Belt (errata).jpg
03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/003 - Narvi_s Belt.jpg

cards.name: Durin's Song
cards.text: Action: Choose a Dwarf hero. That hero gets +2 [willpower], +2 [attack], and +2 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
A king he was on carven throne
In many-pillared halls of stone
With golden roof and silver floor,
And runes of power upon the door.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/004 - Durin_s Song.jpg

cards.name: Ever Onward
cards.text: Response: After players quest unsuccessfully, choose a player. That player does not raise his threat.

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/005 - Ever Onward.jpg

cards.name: Veteran of Nanduhiron
cards.text: Veteran of Nanduhirion enters play with 1 damage on it.
cards.flavor: With cries of "Moria!" and "Dain, Dain!" the dwarves of the Iron Hills plunged in... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/006 - Veteran of Nanduhiron.jpg

cards.name: Dwarrowdelf Axe
cards.text: Restricted. Attach to a Dwarf character. Attached character gets +1 [attack] Response: After attached character attacks, deal 1 damage to the defending enemy.
cards.flavor: "We make good armour and keen swords, but we cannot again make mail or blade to match those that were made before the dragon came." <cite>Gloin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/007 - Dwarrowdelf Axe.jpg

cards.name: Khazad! Khazad!
cards.text: Action: Choose a Dwarf character. Until the end of the phase, that character gets +3 [attack].

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/008 - Khazad! Khazad!.jpg

cards.name: Zigil Miner
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Zigil Miner and name a number to discard the top 2 cards of your deck. If at least one of those cards has cost equal to the named number, choose a hero you control. For each card that matches the named number, add 1 resource to that hero's resource pool.

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/009 - Zigil Miner (errata).jpg
03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/009 - Zigil Miner.jpg

cards.name: Untroubled by Darkness
cards.text: Action: Each Dwarf character gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase. (+2 [willpower] instead if the active location is an Underground or Dark location.)

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/010 - Untroubled by Darkness.jpg

cards.name: Erebor Record Keeper
cards.text: Erebor Record Keeper cannot attack or defend. Action: Exhaust Erebor Record Keeper and pay 1 [lore] resource to choose and ready a Dwarf character.

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/011 - Erebor Record Keeper.jpg

cards.name: Ancestral Knowledge
cards.text: Action: Exhaust a Dwarf character to place 2 progress tokens on the active location. (4 progress tokens instead if it is an Underground or Mountain location.)

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/012 - Ancestral Knowledge.jpg

cards.name: Boots from Erebor
keywords: Attach to a Dwarf or Hobbit character
cards.text: Attach to a Dwarf or Hobbit character. Limit 1 Boots from Erebor per character. Attached character gets +1 hit point.

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Player/013 - Boots from Erebor.jpg

cards.name: Patrol Leader
cards.text: Forced: Before Patrol Leader is dealt damage, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If the discarded card is an enemy, cancel that damage.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Cancel all damage dealt to this enemy.

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Encounter/Into the Pit/014 - Patrol Leader.jpg

cards.name: Signs of Conflict
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player raises his threat by 2.

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Encounter/Into the Pit/015 - Signs of Conflict.jpg

cards.name: East-gate
cards.text:
Players cannot optionally engage enemies and no engagement checks are made.

Forced: After East-gate leaves play as an explored location, add First Hall to the staging area.

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Encounter/Into the Pit/016 - East-gate.jpg

cards.name: First Hall
cards.text:
Travel: Each player must raise his threat by 3 to travel here.

Forced: After First Hall leaves play as an explored location, add Bridge of Khazad-dum to the staging area.

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Encounter/Into the Pit/017 - First Hall.jpg

cards.name: Bridge of Khazad-dum
cards.text: While Bridge of Khazad-dûm is the active location, players cannot play cards.

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Encounter/Into the Pit/018 - Bridge of Khazad-dum.jpg

cards.name: Stairs of Nain
cards.text: Travel: The first player must exhaust 1 character he controls to travel here.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player must choose and exhaust 1 character he controls.

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Encounter/Into the Pit/019 - Stairs of Nain.jpg

cards.name: Cave-troll
cards.text: For each excess point of combat damage dealt by Cave-troll (damage that is dealt beyond the remaining hit points of the character damaged by its attack) you must damage another character you control.

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Encounter/The Seventh Level/020 - Cave-troll.jpg

cards.name: Orc Horn Blower
cards.text: When Revealed: Reveal 1 card from the encounter deck and add it to the staging area.

images.source: 03 - Khazad-dûm/Encounter/The Seventh Level/021 - Orc Horn Blower.jpg

cards.name: Hidden Threat

cards.text:

images.source: 04 - Dwarrowdelf/05 - Foundations of Stone/Nightmare/006 - Nest of Horrors.jpg

cards.name: Elrond
cards.text: You may spend resources from Elrond's resource pool to pay for [spirit], [leadership], and [tactics] allies. Response: After a character is healed by another card effect, heal 1 damage on it.

"But you do not stand alone."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 04 - Dwarrowdelf/06 - Shadow and Flame/Player/128 - Elrond.jpg

cards.name: We Are Not Idle
cards.text: Action: Exhaust X Dwarf heroes to add X resources to a hero's resource pool and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "You should see the stone-paved roads of many colours! And the halls and cavernous streets under the earth with arches carved like trees; and the terraces and towers upon the Mountain's sides! Then you would see that we have not been idle." <cite>Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 04 - Dwarrowdelf/06 - Shadow and Flame/Player/129 - We Are Not Idle (errata).jpg

<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 04 - Dwarrowdelf/06 - Shadow and Flame/Player/130 - Hardy Leadership.jpg

<cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.text: The Quest Deck has been modified for Nightmare Mode. Flip this card over and keep it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active throughout the game, which is now ready to begin.

back.text:
You are playing Nightmare mode. 

Setup: Shuffle the 10 encounter cards with the Attack trait into a separate 'Balrog deck.' 

When Durin's Bane would be dealt a shadow card, deal it from the Balrog deck instead of the encounter deck. Shadow cards dealt from the Balrog deck are discarded into a separate Balrog discard pile. 

At the beginning of each combat phase (or if the Balrog deck runs out of cards), shuffle the Balrog discard pile back into the Balrog deck.

cards.shadow: Shadow: For each excess point of combat damage dealt by this attack (damage that is dealt beyond the remaining hit points of the character damaged by this attack) you must damage another character you control. Exhaust all characters damaged by this effect.

images.source: 04 - Dwarrowdelf/06 - Shadow and Flame/Nightmare/002 - Terrible Strength.jpg

cards.shadow: Shadow: For each point of damage dealt by this attack, heal 1 damage from Durin's Bane.

cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard all cards attached to the defending character and deal it 1 damage. Cannot be canceled.

cards.text: Forced: While Durin's Bane has no damage, Servant of Flame gets +2 Û and +2 Ú.

cards.name: Beregond
cards.text: Sentinel. Lower the cost to play Weapon and Armor attachments on Beregond by 2.
cards.flavor: "It is over-late to send for aid when you are already besiged." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 05 - Heirs of Númenor/Player/001 - Beregond.jpg

cards.name: Boromir
cards.text: While Boromir has at least 1 resource in his resource pool, Gondor allies get +1 [attack].
cards.flavor: "By our valour the wild fold of the East are still restrained, and the terror of Morgul kept at bay..." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 05 - Heirs of Númenor/Player/002 - Boromir.jpg

cards.name: Errand-rider
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Errand-rider to move 1 resource from the resource pool of a hero you control to another hero's resource pool.

images.source: 05 - Heirs of Númenor/Player/003 - Errand-rider.jpg

cards.name: Citadel Custodian

cards.flavor: "These are the Rohirrim, as we name them, masters of horses... and have ever proved true to us, aiding us at need, and guarding our northern marches and the Gap of Rohan." <cite>Faramir, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 05 - Heirs of Númenor/Player/005 - Mutual Accord.jpg

cards.name: Wealth of Gondor
cards.text: Action: Choose a Gondor hero. Add 1 resource to that hero's resource pool.

images.source: 05 - Heirs of Númenor/Player/006 - Wealth of Gondor.jpg

cards.name: Defender of Rammas
cards.flavor: "And the Enemy must pay dearly for the crossing of the River." <cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 05 - Heirs of Númenor/Player/007 - Defender of Rammas.jpg

cards.flavor: ...seven walls of stone so strong and old that it seemed to have been not builded by carven by giants out of the bones of the earth. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 05 - Heirs of Númenor/Player/008 - Behind Strong Walls.jpg

cards.text: Restricted. Attach to a [tactics] character. Limit 1 per character. Response: After attached character is declared as a defender, deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy.

images.source: 05 - Heirs of Númenor/Player/011 - Light the Beacons.jpg

cards.text: Response: After a location worth no victory points leaves play as an explored location, return it to the top of the encounter deck.

05 - Heirs of Númenor/Player/012 - A Watchful Peace.jpg

<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 06 - Against the Shadow/01 - The Steward_s Fear/Player/005 - Gondorian Shield.jpg

We heard of the horns in the hills ringing,
the swords shining in the South-kingdom.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

back.text:

Forced: After the active location leaves play as an explored location, place 1 resource token on this quest.

If there are 4 or more resource tokens on Conspiracy, advance to the next stage.

Forced: After the active location leaves play as an explored location place 1 resource token on this quest.

<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 06 - Against the Shadow/02 - The Drúadan Forest/Player/035 - Mighty Prowess.jpg

06 - Against the Shadow/02 - The Drúadan Forest/Player/036 - Trained for War.jpg

"The Elves have their own labours and their own sorrows..."

images.source: 06 - Against the Shadow/02 - The Drúadan Forest/Player/037 - Silvan Refugee.jpg

images.source: 06 - Against the Shadow/02 - The Drúadan Forest/Player/039 - Harbor Master.jpg

back.name: The Morgul Vale
back.text:
You are playing Nightmare mode. 

Setup: Place 1 progress on To the Tower.

images.source: 06 - Against the Shadow/06 - The Morgul Vale/Nightmare/001 - The Morgul Vale.jpg

cards.name: Warrior of Nurn
cards.text: Each Captain enemy gets +1 Ú. Forced: At the end of the round, heal all damage from each Captain enemy in play.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Heal all damage from each Captain enemy in play.

images.source: 06 - Against the Shadow/06 - The Morgul Vale/Nightmare/002 - Warrior of Nurn.jpg

cards.name: Orc Captor
cards.text: Forced: At the end of the round, if Orc Captor is in the staging area, place 1 progress token on To the Tower.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +3 Ú until the end of the combat phase.

images.source: 06 - Against the Shadow/06 - The Morgul Vale/Nightmare/003 - Orc Captor.jpg

cards.name: Sentry of the White Bridge
cards.text: X is the number of progress tokens on To the Tower.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û. If this attack destroys a character, place 1 progress on To the Tower.

images.source: 06 - Against the Shadow/06 - The Morgul Vale/Nightmare/004 - Sentry of the White Bridge.jpg

cards.name: Banks of Morgulduin
cards.text: Forced: When Banks of Morgulduin is explored, deal it facedown as a shadow card to a Captain enemy.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If attacking enemy is a Captain, deal it 3 additional shadow cards for this attack.

images.source: 06 - Against the Shadow/06 - The Morgul Vale/Nightmare/005 - Banks of Morgulduin.jpg

cards.name: Ephel Duath
cards.text: While Ephel Dúath is in the staging area, each Captain enemy gets +2 Û.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player must either place 1 progress token on To the Tower or treat this attack as undefended.

images.source: 06 - Against the Shadow/06 - The Morgul Vale/Nightmare/006 - Ephel Duath.jpg

cards.name: White-Flowered Fields
cards.text: Forced: At the end of the round, each player must either exhaust a hero he controls or place 1 progress token on To the Tower.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Return attacking enemy to the staging area after this attack.

images.source: 06 - Against the Shadow/06 - The Morgul Vale/Nightmare/007 - White-Flowered Fields.jpg

cards.name: The Tower Beckons
cards.text: When Revealed: Place 1 progress token on To the Tower. Until the end of the phase, The Towers Beckons adds X $ to the total $ in the staging area, where X is the number of progress tokens on To the Tower.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Place 1 progress token on To the Tower.

images.source: 06 - Against the Shadow/06 - The Morgul Vale/Nightmare/008 - The Tower Beckons.jpg

cards.name: Noxious Fumes
cards.text: When Revealed: Place 1 progress token on To the Tower. Each player must assign damage among characters he controls equal to the number of progress token on To the Tower.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack destroys a character, place 1 progress on To the Tower.

images.source: 06 - Against the Shadow/06 - The Morgul Vale/Nightmare/009 - Noxious Fumes.jpg

cards.name: Eomer
cards.text: Response: After a character leaves play, Éomer gets +2 [attack] until the end of the round. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I am named Éomer son of Éomund, and am called the Third Marshal of Riddermark." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/001 - Eomer.jpg

cards.name: Grima
cards.text: Action: Lower the cost of the next card you play from your hand this round by 1. That card gains Doomed 1. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "Let your counsellor Gríma keep all things till your return – and I pray that we may see it, though no wise man will deem it hopeful." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/002 - Grima.jpg

cards.name: Saruman
keywords: At the end of the round, discard Saruman from play
cards.text: Doomed 3. At the end of the round, discard Saruman from play. Response: After Saruman enters play, choose a non-unique enemy or location in the staging area. While Saruman is in play, the chosen enemy or location is considered to be out of play.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/003 - Saruman.jpg

cards.name: Orthanc Guard
cards.text: Response: After you raise your threat from the Doomed keyword, ready Orthanc Guard.
cards.flavor: "...the keepers of the gate were on the watch for me and told me that Saruman awaited me." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/004 - Orthanc Guard.jpg

cards.name: Isengard Messenger
cards.text: Response: After you raise your threat from the Doomed keyword, Isengard Messenger gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the round. (Limit twice per round.)
cards.flavor: "I have an urgent errand," he said. "My news is evil." <cite>Radagast, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/005 - Isengard Messenger.jpg

cards.name: Westfold Outrider
cards.text: Action: Discard Westfold Outrider to choose an enemy not engaged with you. Engage the chosen enemy.
cards.flavor: "Erkenbrand of Westfold has drawn off those men he could gather towards his fastness at Helm's Deep. The rest are scattered." <cite>Rider of Rohan, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/006 - Westfold Outrider.jpg

cards.name: Westfold Horse-breeder
cards.text: Response: After Westfold Horse-breeder enters play, search the top 10 cards of your deck for a Mount attachment and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "They love their horses next to their kin." <cite>Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/007 - Westfold Horse-breeder.jpg

cards.name: Rohan Warhorse
keywords: Attach to a Ï or Rohan hero
cards.text: Attach to a [tactics] or Rohan hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, exhaust Rohan Warhorse to ready attached hero.
cards.flavor: Their horses were of great stature, strong and clean-limbed... <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/008 - Rohan Warhorse.jpg

cards.name: Silver Lamp
cards.text:
Attach to a [spirit] hero.
While attached hero is ready, shadow cards dealt to enemies engaged with you are dealt face up. (Shadow card effects are still resolved when resolving enemy attacks.)
cards.flavor: ...one of them uncovered a small lamp that gave out a slender silver beam. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/009 - Silver Lamp.jpg

cards.name: Keys of Orthanc
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Response: After you raise your threat from the Doomed keyword, exhaust Keys of Orthanc to add 1 resource to attached hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor: "He has the Key of Orthanc" <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/010 - Keys of Orthanc.jpg

cards.name: Legacy of Numenor
cards.text: Doomed 4. Action: Add 1 resource to each hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor: "...in the midst of that valley is a tower of stone called Orthanc. It was not made by Saruman, but by the Men of Númenor long ago: and it is very tall and has many secrets..." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/011 - Legacy of Numenor.jpg

cards.name: Deep Knowledge
cards.text: Doomed 2. Action: Each player draws 2 cards.
cards.flavor: "His knowledge is deep, but his pride has grown with it..." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/012 - Deep Knowledge.jpg

cards.name: The Wizard's Voice
cards.text: Doomed 3. Action: Each player chooses 1 enemy engaged with him. Until the end of the phase, each chosen enemy cannot attack the player that chose it.
cards.flavor: ...it was a delight to hear the voice speaking, all that it said seemed wise and reasonable... <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/013 - The Wizard_s Voice.jpg

cards.name: Power of Orthanc
cards.text: Doomed 2. Action: Each player may choose and discard a Condition attachment from play.
cards.flavor: "But Saruman has long studied the arts of the Enemy himself, and thus we have often been able to forestall him." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/014 - Power of Orthanc.jpg

cards.name: The Seeing-stone
cards.text: Doomed 1. Action: Search your deck for a card with the Doomed keyword and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "...alone it could do nothing but see small images of things far off and days remote." <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Player/015 - The Seeing-stone.jpg

cards.name: Grima
cards.text:
If free of encounters, the first player gains control of Grima.

Action: Exhaust Grima to draw a card.

If Grima leaves play, the players lose the game.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Fords of Isen/016 - Grima.jpg

cards.name: The Islet
cards.text: While The Islet is the active location, each Dunland enemy in play gets +1 $

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Fords of Isen/017 - The Islet.jpg

cards.name: Fords of Isen
cards.text:
While Fords of Isen is in the staging area, players cannot gain resources from card effects.

Forced: After Fords of Isen becomes the active location, each player with fewer than 5 cards in his hand draws cards until he has 5 in his hand

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Fords of Isen/018 - Fords of Isen.jpg

cards.name: The King's Road
cards.text:
While any player has 3 or more cards in hand, The King's Road gets +3 quest points.

While any player has 5 or more cards in hand, the King's Road gains: 'When faced with the option to travel, the players must travel to The King's Road, if able.'

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Fords of Isen/019 - The King_s Road.jpg

cards.name: Gap of Rohan
cards.text: While Gap of Rohan is in the staging area, Dunland enemies get +1 Û
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û.  If this attack destroys a character, remove 1 time counter from the current quest.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Fords of Isen/020 - Gap of Rohan.jpg

cards.name: Pillaging and Burning
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player draws a card. Each player raises his threat by 1 for each card in his hand.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player discards an attachment he controls (each attachment he controls instead if this attack is undefended.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Fords of Isen/021 - Pillaging and Burning.jpg

cards.name: Down from the Hills
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must choose: Either remove 1 time counter from the current quest, or search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Dunland enemy, reveal it, and add it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck. If any player has 5 or more cards in hand, this effect cannot be canceled.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Fords of Isen/022 - Down from the Hills.jpg

cards.name: Ill Tidings
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player draws this card into his hand.  Ill tidings cannot leave that player's hand. Then, if the first player has 5 or more cards in his hand, Ill Tidings gains surge.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Fords of Isen/023 - Ill Tidings.jpg

cards.name: Mugash
cards.text: Forced: After Mugash is defeated, the first player attaches him to a hero he controls and exhausts that hero.  (Counts as a Captive attachment with the text: 'Attached hero cannot ready. If attached hero leaves play, the players lose the game.')

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/To Catch an Orc/024 - Mugash.jpg

cards.name: Mugash's Guard
cards.text:
While a player controls a hero with Mugash attached, Mugash's Guard engages that player.

Forced: After Mugash's Guard destroys a character, if Mugash is attached to a hero, return Mugash to the staging area.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/To Catch an Orc/025 - Mugash_s Guard.jpg

cards.name: Methedras Orc
cards.text: Forced: When Methedras Orc attacks, the defending player shuffles 1 random card from his hand into his out-of-play deck.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack destroys a character, remove 1 time counter from the current quest.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/To Catch an Orc/026 - Methedras Orc.jpg

cards.name: Methedras
cards.text:
While Methedras is the active location, each location in the staging area gets +1 $.

Forced: When Methedras leaves play as an explored location, each player Searches 3.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/To Catch an Orc/027 - Methedras.jpg

cards.name: Orc Cave
cards.text:
Forced: After Orc Cave leaves play as an explored location, the first player Searches 5.

Travel: Discard the top X cards of the encounter deck to travel here.  X is the number of players in the game. Add each Orc enemy discarded this way to the staging area.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/To Catch an Orc/028 - Orc Cave.jpg

cards.name: Mugash's Lair
cards.text: Forced: At the beginning of the encounter phase, reveal the top card of each player's out-of-play deck.  Add each revealed enemy to the staging area and discard the rest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player discards an attachment he controls.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/To Catch an Orc/029 - Mugash_s Lair.jpg

cards.name: Orc Territory
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a location and adds it to the staging area.  If the total $ in the staging area is less than the total Ò of all characters committed to the quest, each Orc enemy engaged with a player makes an immediate attack.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/To Catch an Orc/030 - Orc Territory.jpg

cards.name: Mugash
cards.text:
Action: Exhaust a hero to claim this objective when it is free of encounters. Attach Mugash to that hero.

Forced: After attached hero takes damage, return Mugash to the top of the encounter deck.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Into Fangorn/031 - Mugash.jpg

cards.name: Edge of Fangorn
cards.text: Travel: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Huorn enemy and add it to the staging area to travel here (2 Huorn enemies instead if there are 3 or more players in the game).

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Into Fangorn/032 - Edge of Fangorn.jpg

cards.name: Dark-Hearted Huorn
cards.text: Forced:  At the beginning of each resource phase, the engaged player must raise his threat by 2.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Into Fangorn/033 - Dark-Hearted Huorn.jpg

cards.name: Angry Huorn
cards.text: Forced:  At the beginning of each resource phase, Angry Huorn attacks the engaged player.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Into Fangorn/034 - Angry Huorn.jpg

cards.name: Deadly Huorn
cards.text: Forced:  At the beginning of each resource phase, the engaged player must deal 3 damage to a character he controls.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Into Fangorn/035 - Deadly Huorn.jpg

cards.name: Heart of Fangorn
cards.text: While Heart of Fangorn is in the staging area, each player cannot refresh more than 5 characters during the refresh phase
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Into Fangorn/036 - Heart of Fangorn.jpg

cards.name: The Forest's Malice
cards.text: When Revealed: Each Huorn enemy engaged with a player makes an immediate attack.  If no attack was made as a result of this effect, each player must search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Huorn enemy and put it into play engaged with him.  This effect cannot be canceled.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Into Fangorn/037 - The Forest_s Malice.jpg

cards.name: Orc Skirmisher
cards.text: Forced: After Orc Skirmisher engages a player, that player must either deal 3 damage to a character he controls, or remove 1 time counter form the current quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Misty Mountain Orcs/038 - Orc Skirmisher.jpg

cards.name: Orc Hunter
cards.text: When Revealed:  Either reveal an additional encounter card, or remove 1 time counter from the current quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy makes and additional attack after this one.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Misty Mountain Orcs/039 - Orc Hunter.jpg

cards.name: Orc Hound
cards.text: Forced:  After Orc Hound engages a player, that player must exhaust a character he controls.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Misty Mountain Orcs/040 - Orc Hound.jpg

cards.name: Orc Hunting Party
cards.text: When Revealed: Deal each Orc enemy in play a shadow card.  Each Orc enemy gets -15 engagement cost until the end of the round.  If there are no Orc enemies in the staging area, Orc Hunting Party gains surge.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Misty Mountain Orcs/041 - Orc Hunting Party.jpg

cards.name: Dunland Prowler
cards.text:
While any player has 3 or more cards in hand, Dunland Prowler gains surge.

While any player has 5 or more cards in hand, Dunland Prowler gets +1 $

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Dunland Raiders/042 - Dunland Prowler.jpg

cards.name: Dunlending Bandit
cards.text: While engaged with a player, Dunlending Bandit gets +1 Û for each card in that player's hand
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û (+2 Û instead if the defending player has at least 3 cards in his hand).

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Dunland Raiders/043 - Dunlending Bandit.jpg

cards.name: Dunland Raider
cards.text: Forced: After Dunland Raider engages a player, that player must deal X damage divided among characters he controls where X equals the number of cards in his hand.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard an attachment you control

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Dunland Raiders/044 - Dunland Raider.jpg

cards.name: Old Hatreds
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to the current quest. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: 'Forced: After a player draws any number of cards, raise his threat by 1.')

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Dunland Raiders/045 - Old Hatreds.jpg

cards.name: Dunland Tribesman
cards.text:
When Revealed: Each player draws a card.

Forced: After a player draws any number of cards, Dunland Tribesman gets +1 $ until the end of the round.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Dunland Warriors/046 - Dunland Tribesman.jpg

cards.name: Dunland Chieftain
cards.text: Forced: After Dunland Cheieftain engages a player, discard X cards from the top of the encounter deck where X is the number of cards in the engaged player's hand.  Put the topmost Dunland enemy discarded this way into play engaged with that player

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Dunland Warriors/047 - Dunland Chieftain.jpg

cards.name: Dunland Berserker
cards.text: Forced: After the engaged player draws any number of cards, Dunland Berserker makes an attack.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Dunland Warriors/048 - Dunland Berserker.jpg

cards.name: Wild Men of Dunland
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to the current quest.(Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: 'Forced: After a player draws any number of cards, that player deals 1 damage to a character he controls.'

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/The Dunland Warriors/049 - Wild Men of Dunland.jpg

cards.name: Ancient Forest
cards.text: While Ancient Forest is in the staging area, each Forest location in the staging area gets +1 $ and +3 quest points.  This ability does not stack with other copies of Ancient Forest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player exhausts a character he controls.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Ancient Forest/050 - Ancient Forest.jpg

cards.name: Tangled Woods
cards.text: While Tangled Woods is in the staging area, each Forest location in play gains: 'Travel: Exhaust a hero to travel here'.  This ability does not stack with other copies of Tangled Woods.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Ancient Forest/051 - Tangled Woods.jpg

cards.name: Turned Around
cards.text: When Revealed: Either remove 1 time counter from a card in play, or return the active location to the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack is undefended, return the active location to the staging area.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Ancient Forest/052 - Turned Around.jpg

cards.name: Prowling Wolf
cards.text: While engaged with a player, Prowling Wolf gets +1 Û for each location in the staging area
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player exhausts a character he controls.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Broken Lands/053 - Prowling Wolf.jpg

cards.name: Broken Lands
cards.text: While Broken Lands is in the staging area, progress cannot be placed on locations in the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û for each location in the staging area.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Broken Lands/054 - Broken Lands.jpg

cards.name: Take Cover!
cards.text: When Revealed: Either deal 1 damage to each exhausted character or remove 1 time counter from the current quest.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Broken Lands/055 - Take Cover!.jpg

cards.name: Low on Provisions
cards.text: When Revealed:  Each player must assign X damage among characters he controls where X is the number of characters that player controls.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û(+2 Û instead if the defending character is undamaged.)

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Weary Travelers/056 - Low on Provisions.jpg

cards.name: Off Track
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to a location in play. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per location. Attached location gets +2 quest points and gains: 'Forced: Remove and additional time counter from the current quest at the end of each refresh phase, if able.'"

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Weary Travelers/057 - Off Track.jpg

cards.name: In Need of Rest
cards.text: When Revealed: Remove a hero from the quest and attach In Need of Rest to that hero. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: 'Limit 1 per hero.  Forced:  After a time counter is removed from the current quest, attached hero takes 1 damage.')

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Encounter/Weary Travelers/058 - In Need of Rest.jpg

cards.name: Fight at the Fords
cards.text: Setup: Add The Islet to the staging area and attach Grima to that location. Each player searches the encounter deck for 1 different Dunland enemy and adds it to the staging area.  Shuffle the Encounter Deck.

back.name: Fight at the Fords
back.text:
Time 5. Forced: After the last time counter is removed from this stage, discard Grima from play.

The players cannot advance unless the first player controls Grima.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/059 - 1A - Fight at the Fords.jpg
07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/059 - 1B - Fight at the Fords.jpg

back.name: Dunlending Attack
back.text:
When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 different Dunland enemy and adds it to the staging area. Shuffle the Encounter Deck.

Time 2. Forced: After the last time counter is removed from this stage, each player assigns X damage among characters he controls where X is the number of cards in his hand. Place 2 time counters on this stage.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/060 - 2A - Dunlending Attack.jpg
07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/060 - 2B - Dunlending Attack.jpg

cards.name: Hold the Fords
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a different Dunland enemy and adds it to the staging area.  Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Hold the Fords
back.text:
Time 3. Forced: After the last time counter is removed from this stage, discard the top X cards of the encounter deck.  X is the number of card's in the first player's hand.  Add each enemy discarded this way to the staging area.  Put 3 time counters on this stage.

While there is at least 1 enemy in play, the players cannot defeat this stage.  If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/061 - 3A - Hold the Fords.jpg
07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/061 - 3B - Hold the Fords.jpg

cards.name: Orders from Orthanc
cards.text: Each player removes the top 20 cards of his deck and places them aside, as an out-of-play deck,  The first player takes Mugash plus 1 Mugash's Guard for each other player in the game and randomly shuffles one facedown into each player's out of play deck. Place any remaining copies of Mugash's Guard aide, out of play.

back.name: Orders from Orthanc
back.text: When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck for a Mountain location and adds it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck. Then, advance to Stage 2

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/062 - 1A - Orders from Orthanc.jpg
07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/062 - 1B - Orders from Orthanc.jpg

back.name: Searching for Mugash
back.text:
Time 2. Forced: After the last time counter is removed from this stage, shuffle the discard pile into the encounter deck and reveal 2 encounter cards per player. Place 2 time counters on this stage.

Response: After questing successfully, cancel all progress that would be placed on this stage. Then, place 1 time counter on this stage. Or, if Mugash is in play, advance to stage 3.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/063 - 2A - Searching for Mugash.jpg
07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/063 - 2B - Searching for Mugash.jpg

back.name: The Wizard's Prize
back.text:
Time 3.  Forced: After the last time counter is removed from this stage, return Mugash to the staging area and reveal X encounter cards.  X is the number of players in the game minus 1.  Place 3 time counters on this stage.

Progress cannot be placed on this stage unless Mugash is attached to a hero.

If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/064 - 3A - The Wizard_s Prize.jpg
07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/064 - 3B - The Wizard_s Prize.jpg

cards.name: Into the Woods
cards.text: Setup: Add Edge of Fangorn to the staging area an attach Mugash to that location. Shuffle the encounter deck.  Reveal X encounter cards where X equals the number of players in the game minus 1.

back.name: Into the Woods
back.text:
Time 4. Forced: After the last time counter is removed from this stage, shuffle Mugash into the encounter deck and advance to stage 3.

The players cannot advance to stage 2 unless Mugash is attached to a hero.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/065 - 1A - Into the Woods.jpg
07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/065 - 1B - Into the Woods.jpg

cards.name: Escape from Fangorn
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a Huorn enemy and adds it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Escape from Fangorn
back.text:
Time 4. Forced: After the last time counter is removed from this stage, shuffle Mugash into the encounter deck and advance to stage 3A.

The players cannot defeat this stage unless Mugash is attached to a hero.

If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

images.source: 07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/066 - 2A - Escape from Fangorn.jpg
07 - The Voice of Isengard/Quest/066 - 2B - Escape from Fangorn.jpg

cards.text:
Begin with the standard quest deck and encounter deck for The Dunland Trap scenario.
Remove the following cards, in the specified quantities, from the encounter deck:
4x Boar Clan Warrior
4x Hithaeglir Stream
1x Dunlending Ambush
1x Frenzied Attack
1x Low on Provisions
Then, shuffle the encounter cards in this Nightmare Deck into the remainder of the standard The Dunland Trap encounter deck.
Finally, flip this setup card over and place it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active through the game, which is now ready to begin.

cards.name: The Trial of Strength
cards.text: When Revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the remaining set aside Guardian enemies and 1 of the remaining set aside Barrow locations, reveal them, and add them to the staging area. Find the set aside Key objective that shares a Trait with the just revealed Guardian enemy and attach it to that enemy.

back.name: The Trial of Strength
back.text:
Each Guardian enemy engages the first player. Barrow locations cannot be the active location and are immune to player card effects.

When the players control the current trial’s Key objective, add all Barrow locations in play to the victory display and immediately advance to a stage 2A of the players’ choice. If all stage 2 quests have been defeated, advance to stage 3A, instead.

images.source: 08 - The Ring-maker/02 - The Three Trials/Quest/036 - 2A - The Trial of Strength.jpg
08 - The Ring-maker/02 - The Three Trials/Quest/036 - 2B - The Trial of Strength.jpg

cards.name: The Trial of Perseverance
cards.text: When Revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the remaining set aside Barrow locations and add it to the staging area. Then, randomly choose 1 of the remaining set aside Key objectives and attach it to that Barrow location. Find the set aside Guardian enemy that shares a Trait with the Key objective in play and reveal it, adding it to the staging area.

back.name: The Trial of Perseverance
back.text:
Each Guardian enemy engages the first player. Guardian enemies cannot be damaged or leave play except by quest effect.

When the players control the current trial’s Key objective, add all Guardian enemies in play to the victory display and immediately advance to a stage 2A of the players’ choice. If all stage 2 quests have been defeated, advance to stage 3A, instead.

images.source: 08 - The Ring-maker/02 - The Three Trials/Quest/037 - 2A - The Trial of Perseverance.jpg
08 - The Ring-maker/02 - The Three Trials/Quest/037 - 2B - The Trial of Perseverance.jpg

cards.name: The Trial of Intuition
cards.text: When Revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the remaining set aside Guardian enemies and 1 of the remaining set aside Barrow locations, reveal them, and add them to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Find the set aside Key objective that shares a Trait with the just revealed Guardian enemy and shuffle it into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck.

back.name: The Trial of Intuition
back.text:
Each Guardian enemy engages the first player. Any time players would place progress on this quest, discard an equal number of cards from the encounter deck instead. (Progress is placed on the active location before triggering this effect.)

When the players control the current trial’s Key objective, add all Guardian enemies and Barrow locations in play to the victory display and immediately advance to a stage 2A of the players’ choice. If all stage 2 quests have been
defeated, advance to stage 3A, instead.

images.source: 08 - The Ring-maker/02 - The Three Trials/Quest/038 - 2A - The Trial of Intuition.jpg
08 - The Ring-maker/02 - The Three Trials/Quest/038 - 2B - The Trial of Intuition.jpg

cards.name: The Antlered Crown
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Hallowed Circle to the staging area. Reveal each Guardian enemy in the victory display, adding them to the staging area.

back.name: The Antlered Crown
back.text:
Each Guardian enemy engages the player who controls the Key objective with a Trait shared by that enemy.

Players cannot defeat this stage unless Hallowed Circle is in the victory display. If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

cards.name: The Three Trials
cards.text:
Begin with the standard quest deck and encounter deck for The Three Trials scenario.
Remove the following cards, in the specified quantities, from the encounter deck:
3x Spirit of the Wild
3x Grim Foothills
1x Tangled Woods
3x Turned Around
Then, shuffle the encounter cards in this Nightmare Deck into the remainder of the standard The Three Trials encounter deck.
Finally, flip this setup card over and place it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active through the game, which is now ready to begin.

back.name: The Three Trials
back.text:
You are playing Nightmare mode.
Each engaged Guardian enemy contributes its $ to the total $ in the staging area.
While the Trial of Intuition is the current trial, each Guardian enemy cannot be damaged, and each Barrow location cannot be the active location and is immune to player card effects.

cards.name: Haldir of Lorien
cards.text: Ranged. Combat Action: If you have not engaged an enemy this round, exhaust Haldir of Lórien to declare him as an attacker (and resolve his attack) against an enemy not engaged with you. Limit once per round.
cards.flavor: "We allow no strangers to spy out the secrets of the Naith..." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 08 - The Ring-maker/03 - Trouble in Tharbad/Player/056 - Haldir of Lorien.jpg

cards.name: Herald of Anorien
cards.text: You may give Herald of Anórien doomed 2 when you play it from your hand. If you do, it gains: "Response: After you play Herald of Anórien, choose a player. That player may put into play 1 ally from his hand with a printed cost 2 or lower."
cards.flavor: "Send the heralds forth! Let them summon all who dwell nigh!" <cite>Théoden, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 08 - The Ring-maker/03 - Trouble in Tharbad/Player/057 - Herald of Anorien.jpg

cards.name: O Lorien!
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust O Lórien! to lower the cost of the next Silvan ally played this phase by 1 (to a minimum of 1).
cards.flavor:
"I sang of leaves, of leaves of gold, and
leaves of gold there grew:
Of wind I sang, a wind there came and in the
branches blew." <cite>Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 08 - The Ring-maker/03 - Trouble in Tharbad/Player/058 - O Lorien!.jpg

cards.name: Gwaihir

cards.flavor: "The North Wind blows, but we shall outfly it." <cite>Gwaihir, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 08 - The Ring-maker/03 - Trouble in Tharbad/Player/059 - Gwaihir.jpg

cards.name: Pursuing the Enemy
cards.text: Action: Return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to choose a player. Deal 1 damage to each enemy engaged with that player.

images.source: 08 - The Ring-maker/03 - Trouble in Tharbad/Player/060 - Pursuing the Enemy.jpg

cards.text: Action: Choose a hero. That hero gets +2 [willpower] until the end of the phase. Then, if your threat is 20 or less and this is the first time you played a copy of Courage Awakened this round, return this card to your hand instead of discarding it.
cards.flavor: But the courage that had been awakened in him was now too strong: he could not leave his friends so easily. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 08 - The Ring-maker/03 - Trouble in Tharbad/Player/061 - Courage Awakened.jpg

cards.name: Free to Choose

cards.name: Trouble in Tharbad
cards.text:
Begin with the standard quest deck and encounter deck for the Trouble in Tharbad scenario.
Remove the following cards, in the specified quantities, from the encounter deck:
1x Orc Hunter
2x Orc Skirmisher
2x Tharbad Hideout
2x Hidden Alleyway
1x Decrepit Rooftops
2x Orc Hunting Party
Then, shuffle the encounter cards in this Nightmare Deck into the remainder of the standard Trouble in Tharbad encounter deck.

Playing Tip: There are many effects in the nightmare version of Trouble in Tharbad that reduce the players' threat elimination level. It may be helpful to use a separate threat tracker or pen and paper to track the players' current threat elimination level.

cards.name: The Antlered Crown
cards.text:
Begin with the standard quest deck and encounter deck for The Antlered Crown scenario.
Remove the following cards, in the specified quantities, from the encounter deck:
1x Dunland Prowler
1x Dunland Berserker
2x Dunlending Bandit
3x Raven Skirmisher
3x Raven War-camp
2x Driven Back
Then, shuffle the encounter cards in this Nightmare Deck into the remainder of the standard The Antlered Crown encounter deck.
Finally, flip this setup card over and place it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active through the game, which is now ready to begin.
Note: Dunlending Horde has the "Dunlending Warriors" encounter set icon and should be shuffled into the Raven deck during setup.
