cards.name: Raid Golfimbul's Vault
cards.text:
Forced: After a card is captured by another card effect, capture a random card from each player's hand underneath Raid Golfimbul's Vault.
Forced: When the captured cards underneath Raid Golfimbul's Vault are rescued, put each rescued Item card into its owner's hand and discard the rest.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/02 - Escape from Mount Gram/Nightmare/008 - Raid Golfimbul_s Vault.jpg

cards.name: Orc of Thaurdir
cards.text: Forced: When Orc of Thaurdir attacks you, either discard the top 2 cards of your captured deck, or deal Orc of Thaurdir 2 additional shadow cards.
cards.shadow: Shadow: For each damage dealt by this attack discard the top card of your captured deck.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/02 - Escape from Mount Gram/Nightmare/009 - Orc of Thaurdir.jpg

cards.name: Dori
cards.text: Sentinel. Response: After another hero is declared as a defender, exhaust Dori to add his [defense] to the defending hero's [defense] for this attack.
cards.flavor:
Dori was really a decent fellow in spite of his grumbling.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Player/054 - Dori.jpg

cards.name: Ranger Provisions
cards.text: Attach to a location. Limit 1 per location. Response: After attached location is explored, the first player adds 1 resource to each of his heroes' resource pools.
cards.flavor:
"Rangers have been here lately. It is they who left the firewood behind."
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Player/055 - Ranger Provisions.jpg

cards.name: Dunedain Message
cards.text: Action: Search your deck for a side quest and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor:
"I called for the help of the Dúnedain, and their watch has doubled..."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Player/056 - Dunedain Message.jpg

cards.name: Longbeard Sentry
cards.text: Action: Discard 2 cards from the top of your deck to give Longbeard Sentry sentinel and +1 [defense] until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
"...many of them have had experience in the dreadful dwarf and goblin wars, of which you have no doubt heard."
<cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Player/057 - Longbeard Sentry.jpg

cards.name: Delay the Enemy
cards.text: Battle. Limit 1 per deck. Response: When this stage is defeated, each player may choose and discard a non-unique enemy engaged with him.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Player/058 - Delay the Enemy.jpg

cards.name: Steed of Imladris
keywords: Attach to a Ê or Noldor hero
cards.text: Attach to a [spirit] or Noldor hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero commits to a quest, discard a card from your hand to place 2 progress on the active location.
cards.flavor:
In the dusk its headstall flickered and flashed, as if it were studded with gems like living stars.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Player/059 - Steed of Imladris.jpg

cards.name: Fair and Perilous
cards.text: Action: Choose a Noldor or Silvan character. Until the end of the phase, add that character's [willpower] to its [attack].
cards.flavor:
"...you saw him for a moment as he is upon the other side: one of the mighty of the Firstborn."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Player/060 - Fair and Perilous.jpg

cards.name: Wellinghall Preserver
cards.text: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. Response: After Wellinghall Preserver readies, heal 1 damage from an Ent character.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Player/061 - Wellinghall Preserver.jpg

cards.name: None Return
keywords: Limit 3 copies of None Return in the victory display
cards.text: Limit 3 copies of None Return in the victory display. Response: After a non-unique enemy is destroyed, add None Return to the victory display to add that enemy to the victory display.
cards.flavor:
"None of the Orcs will ever return out of Lórien."
<cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Player/062 - None Return.jpg

cards.name: Hope Rekindled
cards.text: Action: Reduce the cost of the next event that has a Valour trigger you play this phase by 2. Valour Action: Search the top 10 cards of your deck for an event that has a Valour trigger and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor:
Hope he rekindled, and in hope ended;
over death, over dread, over doom lifted
out of loss, out of life, unto long glory.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Player/063 - Hope Rekindled.jpg

cards.name: Into the Ettenmoors
cards.text: Setup: Set aside each of the 3 Across the Ettenmoors side quests and each of the 4 locations with the safe keyword. Reveal 1 of those side quests at random and 1 of those safe locations at random, adding them to the staging area with the safe location guarded by the side quest. Search the encounter deck for 1 copy of Savage Trollspawn per player and add them to the staging area. Shuffle the remaining side quests and safe locations back into the encounter deck. The first player gains control of Amarthiúl.

back.name: Into the Ettenmoors
back.text:
Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, if there are no encounter side quests in play, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side quest is discarded, and add it to the staging area.

Forced: When a side quest is defeated, place progress tokens on Into the Ettenmoors equal to that side quest's quest points.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Quest/064 - 1A - Into the Ettenmoors.jpg
10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Quest/064 - 1B - Into the Ettenmoors.jpg

cards.name: A Miserable Journey
cards.text: When Revealed: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side quest is discarded. Reveal that side quest and add it to the staging area, if able.

back.name: A Miserable Journey
back.text: Reveal 1 additional encounter card during the quest phase unless there is an active location with the safe keyword.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Quest/065 - 2A - A Miserable Journey.jpg
10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Quest/065 - 2B - A Miserable Journey.jpg

cards.name: Journey's End
cards.text: When Revealed: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side quest is discarded. Reveal that side quest and add it to the staging area, if able.

back.name: Journey's End
back.text:
Each damaged character gets –2 Ò unless there is an active location with
the safe keyword.

If the players defeat this stage, they have escaped the Ettenmoors
with their lives, and win the game.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Quest/066 - 3A - Journey_s End.jpg
10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Quest/066 - 3B - Journey_s End.jpg

cards.name: Amarthiul
cards.text:
Response: After an enemy engages a player, give control of Amarthiúl to that player.

If Amarthiúl leaves play, the players lose the game.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/067 - Amarthiul.jpg

cards.name: Secluded Cave
cards.text: Response: After you travel to Secluded Cave, each player draws 3 cards.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/068 - Secluded Cave.jpg

cards.name: The Hoarwell
cards.text: Response: After you travel to The Hoarwell, heal 1 damage from each character in play.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/069 - The Hoarwell.jpg

cards.name: Abandoned Camp
cards.text: Response: After you travel to Abandoned Camp, each player may return 1 card from his discard pile to his hand.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/070 - Abandoned Camp.jpg

cards.name: Patch of Woods
cards.text: Response: After you travel to Patch of Woods, each player adds 1 resource to each of his heroes’ resource pools.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/071 - Patch of Woods.jpg

cards.name: Savage Trollspawn
cards.text: Savage Trollspawn gets +1 Û for each damaged character the engaged player controls.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û for each damaged character the defending player controls.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/072 - Savage Trollspawn.jpg

cards.name: Coldfell Giant
cards.text: Forced: After Coldfell Giant engages you, deal 1 damage to 3 different characters you control.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If the defending character has at least 1 damage token on it, attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/073 - Coldfell Giant.jpg

cards.name: Cruel Mountain-troll
cards.text: For each excess point of combat damage dealt by Cruel Mountain-troll (damage that is dealt beyond the remaining hit points of the character damaged by its attack) you must remove 1 progress from each quest card in play.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/074 - Cruel Mountain-troll.jpg

cards.name: Ruthless Hill-troll
cards.text: Ruthless Hill-troll gets +2 Û and +2 Ú while it has 3 or more damage on it.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Shuffle 1 location with the safe keyword (but not its attached encounter) back into the encounter deck.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/075 - Ruthless Hill-troll.jpg

cards.name: Goblin Pursuer
cards.text: Damaged characters cannot be declared as attackers or defenders against Golbin Pursuer.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û (+3 Û instead if this attack is undefended).

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/076 - Goblin Pursuer.jpg

cards.name: Troll-fells
cards.text:
While Troll-fells is the active location, Weather cards gain doomed 1.

When Revealed: If Troll-fells is not revealed guarding a safe location, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a location with the safe keyword and attach it to Troll-fells, guarded. Shuffle the encounter deck.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/077 - Troll-fells.jpg

cards.name: Barren Moorland
cards.text:
While Barren Moorland is in the staging area, it gains: “Forced: When an ally enters play, you must either exhaust it or deal 1 damage to it.”

Travel: Deal 1 damage to each exhausted character.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/078 - Barren Moorland.jpg

cards.name: Arador's Bane
cards.text: When Revealed: Starting with the first player, each player must either engage an enemy in the staging area with a higher engagement cost than his threat, or search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Troll or Giant enemy and add it to the staging area. Deal each enemy that engages a player through this effect 2 shadow cards.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/079 - Arador_s Bane.jpg

cards.name: No Rest
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to an exhausted hero, or to a ready hero if there are no exhausted heroes. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: “Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero cannot ready and does not collect resources during the resource phase. Discard No Rest if the players travel to a safe location.”)

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/080 - No Rest.jpg

cards.name: Lie Low
cards.text:
Forced: At the end of the quest phase, if no progress was placed on Lie Low this round, each enemy gets –20 engagement cost until the end of the round.

Response: After this stage is defeated, choose an enemy in the staging area and shuffle it into the encounter deck.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/081 - Lie Low.jpg

cards.name: Forage for Food
cards.text:
Forced: After 1 or more resources are spent from a hero’s resource pool, deal 1 damage to that hero.

Response: After this stage is defeated, heal 1 damage from each hero.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/082 - Forage for Food.jpg

cards.name: Scavenge for Supplies
cards.text:
The cost to play each player card is increased by 1.

Forced: When this stage is defeated, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Troll enemy and put it into play engaged with the player with the highest threat. Each player may play a card from his hand, at no cost.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Encounter/083 - Scavenge for Supplies.jpg

cards.name: Across the Ettenmoors
cards.text:
Begin with the standard quest deck and encounter deck for the Across the Ettenmoors scenario.
Remove the following cards, in the specified quantities, from the standard encounter deck:
1x Into the Ettenmoors
2x Shrouded Hills
1x No Rest
2x Arador's Bane
2x Troll-fells
2x Goblin Pursuer
2x Cold from Angmar
Then, shuffle the encounter cards in this Nightmare Deck into the remainder of the standard Across the Ettenmoors encounter deck.
Finally, flip this setup card over and place it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active throughout the game, which is now ready to begin.

back.name: Across the Ettenmoors
back.text:
Your are playing Nightmare mode.
Forced: When resolving the 'when revealed' effect on stage 2A or stage 3A, also discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a location with the safe keyword is discarded. Attach that location to the newly revealed side quest, as a guarded objective.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Nightmare/001 - Across the Ettenmoors.jpg

cards.name: Into the Ettenmoors
cards.text: Setup: Set aside each side quest and each location with the safe keyword. Reveal 1 of those side quests and 1 of those safe locations at random, adding them to the staging area with the safe location guarded by the side quest. shuffle the remaining side quests and safe locations into the encounter deck. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until X enemies are discarded, where X is the number of players in the game. Add the discarded enemies to the staging area. The first player gains control of Amarthiul.

back.name: Quest
back.text:
You have escaped from the prisons of Mount Gram, but you are not safe yet.
Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, if there are no encounter side quests in play, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side quest is discarded, reveal it, and add it to the staging area.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Nightmare/002 - 1A - Into the Ettenmoors.jpg
10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Nightmare/002 - 1B - Into the Ettenmoors.jpg

cards.name: Hoarwell River Serpent
cards.text:
As an additional cost to travel to a safe location, one player must engage Hoarwell River Serpent.
Forced: When you engage Hoarwell River Serpent, deal 1 damage to each damaged character you control.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Nightmare/003 - Hoarwell River Serpent.jpg

cards.name: Scavenging Stone-troll
cards.text:
You cannot travel to a safe location while Scavenging Stone-troll has no damage on it.
While Scavenging Stone-troll is in the staging area, cards in each player's discard pile cannot leave the discard pile.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Nightmare/004 - Scavenging Stone-troll.jpg

cards.name: Giant Beetle
cards.text:
While Giant Beetle is engaged with a player, it gains: "As an additional cost to travel to a safe location, Giant Beetle makes an immediate attack against the engaged player."
Damaged characters cannot be declared as attackers or defenders against Giant Beetle.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Nightmare/005 - Giant Beetle.jpg

cards.name: Rocky Foothills
cards.text:
When faced with the option to travel, the players must travel to Rocky Foothills, if able.
Rocky Foothills gets +2 quest points for each quest in play.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û for each damage on the defending character.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Nightmare/006 - Rocky Foothills.jpg

cards.name: Vast Troll-fells
cards.text:
As an additional cost to travel to a safe location, each player must spend 1 resource.
Heroes cannot gain resources by card effects.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If no progress was placed on a side quest this round, attacking enemy gets +4 Û.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Nightmare/007 - Vast Troll-fells.jpg

cards.name: Crashing Thunder
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player assigns X damage among characters he controls, where X is the number of quests in play. Exhaust each damaged character in play.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Shuffle each Weather card from the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Nightmare/008 - Crashing Thunder.jpg

cards.name: Barren and Desolate
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to a side quest. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per quest. While attached quest is the current quest, each character gets -1 Ò.")

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Nightmare/009 - Barren and Desolate.jpg

cards.name: Isolated
cards.text:
Caught in a dense fog, you suddenly find yourself separated from your companions.
Surge. Players cannot draw cards by card effects.
Forced: When this stage is defeated, each player draws 1 card.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Nightmare/010 - Isolated.jpg

cards.name: Rescue from the Trolls
cards.text:
When Revealed: Each player places the lowest-threat-cost hero he controls facedown underneath Rescue from the Trolls, out of play.
Response: After a Troll enemy is destroyed, place 3 progress on Rescue from the Trolls.
Forced: When Rescue from the Trolls is defeated, each player takes control of each of his heroes underneath it.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/03 - Across the Ettenmoors/Nightmare/011 - Rescue from the Trolls.jpg

cards.name: Erestor
cards.text:
Draw 3 additional cards at the beginning of the resource phase.
At the end of the round, discard all cards in your hand.
cards.flavor:
"That is the path of despair. Of folly, I would say, if the long wisdom of Elrond did not forbid me."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Player/084 - Erestor.jpg

cards.name: Reinforcements
keywords: You must use resources from 3 different heroes' pools to pay for this card
cards.text: You must spend resources from 3 different heroes' resource pools to play this card. Action: The players, as a group, can put up to 2 allies into play from their hands. Each of these allies may enter play under any player's control. At the end of the phase, return each of those allies that are still in play to their owners' hands.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Player/085 - Reinforcements.jpg

cards.name: Send for Aid
cards.text: Limit 1 per deck. Response: When this stage is defeated, each player may search the top 10 cards of his deck for an ally and put it into play under his control. Each player who did shuffles his deck.
cards.flavor:
"Often the Rohirrim have aided us, but now the Lord Denethor asks for all your strength and all your speed..."
<cite>Hirgon, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Player/086 - Send for Aid.jpg

cards.name: Elven Spear
keywords: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan hero
cards.text: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan hero. Restricted. Action: Discard a card from your hand to give attached hero +1 [attack] until the end of the phase. Limit 3 times per phase.
cards.flavor:
Their spears and swords shone in the gloom with a gleam of chill flame, so deadly was the wrath of the hands that held them.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Player/087 - Elven Spear.jpg

cards.name: Horn's Cry
cards.text: Action: All enemies get -1 [attack] until the end of the phase. Valour Action: Choose a player. Each enemy engaged with that player gets -3 [attack] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
Loud the challenge rang and bellowed, like the shout of many throats under the cavernous roof.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Player/088 - Horn_s Cry.jpg

cards.name: Galadhrim Weaver
cards.text: Cannot attack or defend. Response: After Galadhrim Weaver enters play, shuffle the top card of your discard pile into your deck.
cards.flavor: "You are indeed high in the favour of the Lady! For she herself and her maidens wove this..." <cite>Lórien Elf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Player/089 - Galadhrim Weaver.jpg

cards.name: Silver Harp
cards.text: Restricted. Attach to a [spirit] hero. Response: After a card is discarded from your hand, exhaust Silver Harp to return that card to your hand.
cards.flavor: Elrond wore a mantle of grey and had a star upon his forehead, and a silver harp was in his hand... <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Player/090 - Silver Harp.jpg

cards.name: Galdor of the Havens
cards.text: Response: After 1 or more cards are discarded from your hand, draw 1 card. Limit once per round.
cards.flavor:
"But have they the strength, have we here the strength to withstand the Enemy, the coming of Sauron at the last, when all else is overthrown?"
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Player/091 - Galdor of the Havens.jpg

cards.name: The Door is Closed!
cards.text: Response: After an encounter card is revealed from the encounter deck, cancel its effects and discard it if there is a card with the same title in the victory display.
cards.flavor:
"...I perceive the Dark Lord and know his mind, or all of his mind that concerns the Elves. And he gropes ever to see me and my thought. But still the door is closed!"
<cite>Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Player/092 - The Door is Closed!.jpg

cards.name: Elf-friend
cards.text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains the Noldor and Silvan traits.
cards.flavor:
"I name you Elf-friend; and may the stars shine upon the end of your road!"
<cite>Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Player/093 - Elf-friend.jpg

cards.name: Secrets of Rhudaur
cards.text: Setup: Make The Great Hall the active location. Set Thaurdir aside, out of play. Add the 3 Treachery of Rhudaur side quests to the staging area, quest side faceup. Search the encounter deck for 1 copy of Ancient Causeway, and add it to the staging area (2 copies instead if there are 3 or 4 players in the game). The first player gains control of Amarthiúl.

back.name: Secrets of Rhudaur
back.text:
Time 5. Forced: After the last time counter is removed from Secrets of Rhudaur, remove each Treachery of Rhudaur side quest from the game and immediately advance to stage 2.

During the quest phase, Secrets of Rhudaur cannot be chosen as the current quest.

If there are no Treachery of Rhudaur side quests in play, immediately advance to stage 2.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Quest/094 - 1A - Secrets of Rhudaur.jpg
10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Quest/094 - 1B - Secrets of Rhudaur.jpg

cards.name: Thaurdir's Pursuit
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Thaurdir to the staging area. Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for an Undead enemy and adds it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Thaurdir's Pursuit
back.text:
Thaurdir’s Pursuit has –5 quest points for each Clue objective attached to a character.

This stage cannot be defeated while Thaurdir has any hit points remaining. When this stage is defeated, the players win the game.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Quest/095 - 2A - Thaurdir_s Pursuit.jpg
10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Quest/095 - 2B - Thaurdir_s Pursuit.jpg

cards.name: Amarthiul
cards.text:
Response: After an enemy engages a player, give control of Amarthiúl to that player.

If Amarthiúl leaves play, the players lose the game.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Encounter/096 - Amarthiul.jpg

cards.name: The Great Hall
cards.text: Forced: When The Great Hall is explored, each player discards the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and chooses an Undead enemy he discarded in this way to add to the staging area.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Encounter/097 - The Great Hall.jpg

cards.name: Thaurdir
cards.text: Forced: After a treachery card with the Sorcery trait is revealed from the encounter deck, Thaurdir heals 3 damage and makes an immediate attack against the first player.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Encounter/098 - Thaurdir.jpg

cards.name: Wight of Rhudaur
cards.text:
While the current quest has 1 or more progress on it, Wight of Rhudaur gains surge.

While the current quest has 0 progress on it, Wight of Rhudaur gains doomed 2.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Encounter/099 - Wight of Rhudaur.jpg

cards.name: Traitorous Wight
cards.text: Forced: When Traitorous Wight engages a player, remove 2 progress from each quest card in play.
cards.shadow: Shadow: For each point of damage dealt by this attack, remove 1 progress from each quest in play.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Encounter/100 - Traitorous Wight.jpg

cards.name: Forbidden Descent
cards.text:
While Forbidden Descent is in the staging area, the first 2 progress that would be placed on a quest each round must be placed on Forbidden Descent, instead.

Forced: If Forbidden Descent leaves play from the staging area, raise each player’s threat by 2.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Encounter/101 - Forbidden Descent.jpg

cards.name: Eerie Halls
cards.text: Action: Raise your threat by 1 to lower the $ of Eerie Halls by 1 until the end of the phase. Any player may trigger this action.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If the defending player does not control at least 1 Clue objective, the attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/04 - The Treachery of Rhudaur/Encounter/102 - Eerie Halls.jpg

cards.name: Ghostly Ruins
cards.text:
Any time the encounter deck runs out of cards, return the topmost Undead enemy in the encounter discard pile to the staging area before resetting the encounter deck.

Travel: Return the topmost Undead enemy in the encounter discard pile to the staging area.

Long was the way that fate them bore,
O'er stony mountains cold and grey,
Through halls of iron and darkling door,

cards.name: The Dread Realm
cards.text:
Begin with the standard quest deck and encounter deck for The Dread Realm scenario.
Remove the following cards, in the specified quantities, from the standard encounter deck:
3x Witch of Angmar
2x A Fell Dread
1x Unholy Crypt
1x Sinister Dungeon
2x Dead Lord
3x Terror of the North
Then, shuffle the encounter cards in this Nightmare Deck into the remainder of the standard The Dread Realm encounter deck.
Finally, flip this setup card over and place it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active throughout the game, which is now ready to begin.

back.name: The Dread Realm
back.text: You are playing Nightmare mode.

images.source: 10 - Angmar Awakened/06 - The Dread Realm/Nightmare/001 - The Dread Realm.jpg

<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 11 - The Grey Havens/Player/002 - Galdor of the Havens.jpg

<cite>Galdor, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 11 - The Grey Havens/Player/006 - Warden of the Havens.jpg

an errand that should never rest
to bear his shining lamp afar,
the Flammifer of Westernesse.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

and flame was in the darkness lit;
more bright than light of diamond
the fire upon her carcanet.

<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

1x Jungle Path
2x Cursed Temple
1x Deeper into the Ruins
3x Sunken Ruins
2x Aimless Wandering
2x Curse of the Downfallen
1x Dwindling Supplies
3x Faithless Desecrator

cards.name: The Grotto
cards.text:
In the sunken ruins of the temple, you find a grotto leading deep below the sea level. Much of the grotto is submerged underwater.

Setup: Set Shrine to Morgoth aside, out of play. Prepare the Grotto deck. Add the top 2 locations from the Grotto deck to the staging area, Grotto side faceup (the top 3 instead if there are 3 or more players in the game). The first player takes control of Captain Sahír, and the last player takes control of Na'asiyah (objective-ally sides faceup).

back.name: The Grotto
back.text:
While an Underwater location is the active location, players cannot play attachments or allies.

Forced: After a double-sided location is explored, add the top location from the Grotto deck to the staging area, Grotto side faceup.

You cannot advance unless there are at least 3 Underwater locations in the victory display.

12 - Dream-chaser/04 - The Drowned Ruins/Quest/092 - 1B - The Grotto.jpg

cards.name: Sahir's Betrayal
cards.text:
In the center of the shrine, reverently placed on a large altar, lies a long black chest. As soon as you get close, Sahír knocks one of the heroes over and grabs it!

When Revealed: Make the set aside Shrine to Morgoth the active location, Grotto side faceup. Captain Sahír flips to his enemy side (removing all tokens) and makes an immediate attack against the first player. Remove Captain Sahír from the game. Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for an Undead enemy and adds it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Sahír's Betrayal
back.text:
You dive at Sahír, but he swiftly runs to the entrance, laughing as he seals you in. "Captain?! What about me?" Na'asiyah screams angrily. As soon as the entrance is sealed shut, the walls shudder, and water begins to leak in rapidly from the ceiling and walls. "We have to get out of here!" the heroes shout, as the water level starts to rise.

While an Underwater location is the active location, players cannot play attachments or allies.

images.source: 12 - Dream-chaser/04 - The Drowned Ruins/Quest/093 - 2A - Sahir_s Betrayal.jpg
12 - Dream-chaser/04 - The Drowned Ruins/Quest/093 - 2B - Sahir_s Betrayal.jpg

Begin with the standard quest deck and encounter deck for The Drowned Ruins scenario.
Remove the following cards, in the specified quantities, from the standard encounter deck:
1x Cursed Caverns / Twisting Hollow
1x Undersea Grotto / Dark Abyss
2x Throngs of Unfaithful
2x Soulless Cadaver
2x Drowned Cave
3x Into the Abyss
1x Tangling and Grasping
2x Sea-scorpion

The players have won the game.

back.text:
Players cannot defeat this stage unless The Great Goblin is in the victory display.

When Revealed: Reveal 3 encounter cards per player. Bilbo Baggins may spend X resources to reduce the total number of encounter cards revealed by X. (To a minimum of 1.)

If the players defeat this stage, they have won the game.

back.text:
Players cannot advance to stage 3A unless both 1B and 2B are complete.

Progress tokens cannot be added to, or removed from, this quest except by answering riddles.

Cards in the riddle area are immune to player card effects and cannot leave the riddle area except by quest effects.

back.name: Into the Fire
back.text:
When Revealed: The first player gains control of Bilbo Baggins. Reveal 1 encounter card per player and add it to the staging area.

Gollum engages the first player. Damage from undefended attacks made by Gollum must be placed on Bilbo Baggins.

All riddle effects are ignored. Treachery cards gain surge.

If the players defeat this stage, they have won the game.
