images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/Flies and Spiders/033 - Caught in Webs.jpg

cards.name: Poisoned by Spiders
cards.text: When Revealed: Each character takes damage equal to the number of poison it has. If no characters were damaged by this effect, this card gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard an unconscious character you control.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/Flies and Spiders/034 - Poisoned by Spiders.jpg

cards.name: Hidden Path
cards.text:
While Hidden Path is the active location, locations in the staging area get -1 $.

Travel: Spend 2 Í resources to travel here.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/Wilderland/035 - Hidden Path.jpg

cards.name: Dark Bats
cards.text: Forced: After Dark Bats damages a character, attach it to that character. (While attached, counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Attached character gets -1 Ò, -1 Û, and -1 Ú.")
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attach this card to the defending character.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/Wilderland/036 - Dark Bats.jpg

cards.name: Fighting Among Friends
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player names a sphere. Then, all non-Baggins characters who do not belong to the named sphere are removed from the quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û. (+2 Û instead if undefended.)

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/Wilderland/037 - Fighting Among Friends.jpg

cards.name: Weighed Down
cards.text: When Revealed: Until the end of the round, exhausted characters get -1 Ò, -1 Û, and -1 Ú.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If the defending character is destroyed by this attack, its controller must raise his threat by 5.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/Wilderland/038 - Weighed Down.jpg

cards.name: A Bare Patch
cards.text:
While attached, Smaug the Magnificent gets -3 Ú.

Response: After the players quest successfully, the first player makes a burgle attempt. If successful, attach A Bare Patch to Smaug the Magnificent.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Lonely Mountain/039 - A Bare Patch.jpg

cards.name: Smaug the Golden
cards.text:
Cannot be engaged.

X is the number of non-Burglar characters committed to the quest.

Forced: After the 6th progress token is placed here, the players advance to stage 4A.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Lonely Mountain/040 - Smaug the Golden.jpg

cards.name: Smaug the Magnificent
cards.text:
Cannot leave the staging area (except by quest effect) but is considered to be engaged with the first player.

Forced: If Smaug the Magnificent is dealt a shadow card with a burgle effect, he makes an additional attack immediately after this one.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Lonely Mountain/041 - Smaug the Magnificent.jpg

cards.name: Croaking Crows
cards.text:
Forced: When a location is revealed from the encounter deck, put 1 progress on Smaug the Golden.

Burgle: The first player shuffles his deck and reveals the top card. He may discard 1 card from his hand that matches the revealed card's sphere and type.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Lonely Mountain/042 - Croaking Crows.jpg

cards.name: The Lonely Mountain
cards.text:
While at least 1 card is stacked underneath, The Lonely Mountain is immune to player card effects, cannot leave the staging area, and gets -2 $ for each card stacked under it.

Action: While making a burgle attempt, the first player may spend 2 Í resources to take the revealed card into hand and reveal the next card of his deck.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Lonely Mountain/043 - The Lonely Mountain.jpg

cards.name: Great Hall
cards.text:
While Great Hall is the active location, it gains: "Forced: Put 1 progress on Smaug the Golden at the end of each round."

Burgle: The first player shuffles his deck and reveals the top card. He may discard 3 cards from his hand that match the revealed card's type.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Lonely Mountain/044 - Great Hall.jpg

cards.name: Secret Entrance
cards.text:
While Secret Entrance is the active location, The Lonely Mountain's $ is reduced by half (round up).

Travel: The first player must exhaust a hero and name a card type to travel here. Then, reveal the top card of the encounter deck. If the revealed card is not the named type, return Secret Entrance to the staging area. (The players cannot travel again this round.)

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/045 - Secret Entrance (errata).jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Lonely Mountain/045 - Secret Entrance.jpg

cards.name: Desolation of Smaug
cards.text:
While Desolation of Smaug is the active location, the first treachery card revealed each round gains surge.

Burgle: The first player shuffles his deck and reveals the top card. He may discard 2 cards from his hand that match the revealed card's cost.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Lonely Mountain/046 - Desolation of Smaug.jpg

cards.name: Western Slopes
cards.text:
Response: When Western Slopes leaves play as an explored location (choose one): the first player draws 2 cards, or remove 1 progress token from Smaug the Golden.

Burgle: The first player shuffles his deck and reveals the top card. He may discard 2 cards from his hand that match the revealed card's sphere.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Lonely Mountain/047 - Western Slopes.jpg

cards.name: Pretending to Sleep
cards.text:
When Revealed: Put 1 progress token on Smaug the Golden. Then, spend X Í resources or advance to stage 4A. X is the number of progress tokens on Smaug the Golden.

Burgle: The first player shuffles his deck and reveals the top card. He may discard 2 cards from his hand that match the revealed card's type.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Lonely Mountain/048 - Pretending to Sleep.jpg

cards.name: Known to an Ounce
cards.text:
When Revealed: Each player discards 2 random cards from hand. Until the end of the phase, each Dragon enemy in play gets +1 $ for each event discarded by this effect.

Burgle: The first player shuffles his deck and reveals the top card. He may discard 1 card from his hand that matches the revealed card's sphere and cost.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Lonely Mountain/049 - Known to an Ounce.jpg

cards.name: Belching Fire
cards.text:
When Revealed: Each Dragon enemy in the staging area makes an immediate attack against the player with the highest total Ò committed to the quest. (Do not deal a shadow card for this attack.)

Burgle: The first player shuffles his deck and reveals the top card. He may discard 1 card from his hand that matches the revealed card's type and cost.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Lonely Mountain/050 - Belching Fire.jpg

cards.name: Dragon-Spell
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to the hero with the most resources without Dragon-Spell attached. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Attached hero gets -1 Ò for each resource in its resource pool. Forced: When attached hero spends resources, attached hero takes X damage. X is equal to the number of resources spent.")

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Lonely Mountain/051 - Dragon-Spell.jpg

cards.name: Misty Mountain Eagle
cards.text: Action: The first player may spend 2 Í resources to (choose one): take control of Misty Mountain Eagle, or discard this ally to discard a non-unique enemy in the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal 3 damage to attacking enemy.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/052 - Misty Mountain Eagle.jpg

cards.name: Bolg
cards.text:
X is the number of players in the game.

Cannot leave the staging area.

The first Goblin revealed each round gains surge.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/053 - Bolg.jpg

cards.name: Bodyguard of Bolg
cards.text: Forced: When this enemy attacks, deal it an additional shadow card for each quest stage in play with no progress tokens on it.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/054 - Bodyguard of Bolg.jpg

cards.name: Gundabad Wolf Rider
cards.text: Forced: When this enemy attacks, remove 1 progress from the current quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û for each quest stage in play with no progress on it.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/055 - Gundabad Wolf Rider.jpg

cards.name: Gundabad Climber
cards.text: When Revealed: Remove 1 progress from every quest stage in play. (2 progress instead if 3 or more players in the game.)

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/056 - Gundabad Climber.jpg

cards.name: Vanguard of Bolg
cards.text: This enemy gets +1 $, +1 Û, and +1 Ú for each quest stage in play with no progress on it.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack destroys a character, remove all progress from the current quest.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/057 - Vanguard of Bolg.jpg

cards.name: Gundabad Archer
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must deal 2 damage to a character he controls.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal 1 damage to defending character for each quest stage in play with no progress on it.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/058 - Gundabad Archer.jpg

cards.name: Ravenous Warg
cards.text: Forced: When Ravenous Warg attacks, the defending player must declare the character he controls with the most damage as the defender. (Even if exhausted.)
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending character gets -1 Ú for each quest stage in play with no progress on it.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/059 - Ravenous Warg.jpg

cards.name: Northern Slopes
cards.text:
While Northern Slopes is in the staging area, each Goblin enemy gets +1 Û and +1 Ú.

While Northern Slopes is the active location, it gains: "Forced: When a character leaves play, remove 1 progress from the current quest, if able."

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/060 - Northern Slopes.jpg

cards.name: Ruins of Dale
cards.text:
Forced: Remove 2 progress from stage 3B at the end of each round, if able.

Travel: Spend 3 Í resources to travel here. (1 Í instead if stage 3B is the current quest.)

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/061 - Ruins of Dale.jpg

cards.name: Ravenhill
cards.text:
Forced: Remove 2 progress from stage 4B at the end of each round, if able.

Travel: Spend 3 Í resources to travel here. (1 Í instead if stage 4B is the current quest.)

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/062 - Ravenhill.jpg

cards.name: The Front Gate
cards.text:
Forced: Remove 2 progress from stage 2B at the end of each round, if able.

Travel: Spend 3 Í resources to travel here. (1 Í instead if stage 2B is the current quest.)

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/063 - The Front Gate.jpg

cards.name: Hatred Rekindled
cards.text: When Revealed: Each enemy engaged with a player makes an immediate attack. Do not deal shadow cards for attacks made by this effect. If no attacks were made by this effect, this card gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy makes an additional attack immediately after this one.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/064 - Hatred Rekindled.jpg

cards.name: Goblins are Upon You!
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Goblin enemy and put it into play, engaged with him. Then, shuffle the encounter deck. (This effect cannot be canceled.)
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û for each Goblin enemy engaged with you.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/065 - Goblins are Upon You!.jpg

cards.name: Heedless of Order
cards.text: When Revealed: Choose a different quest to be the current quest until the end of the round, if able. If the current quest did not change as a result of this effect, this card gains Doomed 3.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Encounter/The Battle of Five Armies/066 - Heedless of Order.jpg

cards.name: Into Mirkwood
cards.text: Setup: Each player may shuffle 1 copy Bilbo's Magic Ring into his deck. Search the encounter deck for The Spider's Glade and set it aside, out of play. Then, shuffle the encounter deck and reveal 1 encounter card per player.

back.name: Into Mirkwood
back.text: Unconscious characters cannot quest, attack, defend, collect resources, trigger abilities, be poisoned, or ready (except by effects that target unconscious characters).

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/067 - 1A - Into Mirkwood.jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/067 - 1B - Into Mirkwood.jpg

back.name: Lost in the Dark
back.text: When Revealed: Reveal stage 3 and create a separate staging area for the first player using that stage. If there are no other players in the game, discard this stage and each card in its staging area. All other players advance to stage 4.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/068 - 2A - Lost in the Dark.jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/068 - 2B - Lost in the Dark (errata).jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/068 - 2B - Lost in the Dark.jpg

cards.name: Captured by Spiders
cards.text: When Revealed: Remove all resources from each hero's resource pool. Then, make each character you control (except Bilbo Baggins) unconscious.

back.name: Captured by Spiders
back.text:
Unconscious characters cannot quest, attack, defend, collect resources, trigger abilities, be poisoned, or ready (except by effects that target unconscious characters).

Do not pass the first player token. When this stage is complete, do not advance to stage 4 until the end of the quest phase. (Combine staging areas if necessary.)

Action: Spend 2 Í resources to ready an unconscious character you control.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/069 - 3A - Captured by Spiders.jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/069 - 3B - Captured by Spiders.jpg

cards.name: Battle with the Spiders
cards.text: When Revealed: Add The Spider's Glade to the staging area.

back.name: Battle with the Spiders
back.text:
Unconscious characters cannot quest, attack, defend, collect resources, trigger abilities, be poisoned, or ready (except by effects that target unconscious characters).

Progress cannot be placed on this stage while The Spider's Glade is in play.

Action: Spend 2 Í resources to ready an unconscious character you control.

If the players defeat this stage, they have won the game and discovered the treasure card Bilbo's Magic Ring.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/070 - 4A - Battle with the Spiders.jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/070 - 4B - Battle with the Spiders.jpg

cards.name: A Warm Welcome
cards.text: Setup: Search the encounter deck for Smaug the Golden, Smaug the Magnificent, The Lonely Mountain, and A Bare Patch. Set Smaug the Magnificent and A Bare Patch aside, out of play. Add Smaug the Golden and The Lonely Mountain to the staging area. Shuffle the five Erebor treasure cards and stack them facedown under The Lonely Mountain.

back.name: A Warm Welcome
back.text:
Skip the Quest phase.

Forced: At the end of round, advance to stage 2.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/071 - 1A - A Warm Welcome.jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/071 - 1B - A Warm Welcome.jpg

back.name: The Burglar's Turn
back.text:
Forced: After questing successfully, place 1 progress on Smaug the Golden. Then, the first player makes a burgle attempt. If successful, the first player takes the top treasure card from under The Lonely Mountain into his hand. Then, the players may advance to stage 3.

Forced: After the first player makes an unsuccessful burgle attempt, Smaug the Golden attacks the first player.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/072 - 2A - The Burglar_s Turn.jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/072 - 2B - The Burglar_s Turn.jpg

cards.name: Inside Information
cards.text: When Revealed: Set Smaug the Golden aside, out of play. Add Smaug the Magnificent and A Bare Patch to the staging area.

back.name: Inside Information
back.text:
Players cannot defeat this stage while Smaug the Magnificent is in play.

Forced: If the total number of progress on this stage is greater than the total remaining hit points on Smaug the Magnificent, remove Smaug the Magnificent from play.

If the players defeat this stage, they have won the game and discovered any treasure successfully burgled from The Lonely Mountain.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/073 - 3A - Inside Information.jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/073 - 3B - Inside Information.jpg

cards.name: Thieves! Fire! Murder!
cards.text: When Revealed: Remove all progress from Smaug the Golden and set him aside, out of play. Then, add Smaug the Magnificent to the staging area.

back.name: Thieves! Fire! Murder!
back.text: Forced: After placing the 7th progress token on this stage, remove all damage from Smaug the Magnificent and set him aside, out of play. Then, add Smaug the Golden to the staging area and reset the quest deck to stage 2B.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/074 - 4A - Thieves! Fire! Murder!.jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/074 - 4B - Thieves! Fire! Murder!.jpg

cards.name: The Gathering of the Clouds
cards.text: Setup: Search the encounter deck for Bolg and add it to the staging area. Then, shuffle the encounter deck and reveal 1 encounter card per player.

back.name: The Gathering of the Clouds
back.text: When Revealed: Put stage 2, stage 3, and stage 4 into play at the same time. Then, remove this stage from play.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/075 - 1A - The Gathering of the Clouds.jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/075 - 1B - The Gathering of the Clouds.jpg

back.name: The Eastern Spur
back.text:
Players cannot advance from this stage unless stage 3 and stage 4 are complete.

Forced: If there is no progress on this stage at the end of the round, each player must discard 1 random card from his hand.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/076 - 2A - The Eastern Spur.jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/076 - 2B - The Eastern Spur.jpg

back.name: Battle in the Dale
back.text:
Players cannot advance from this stage unless stage 2 and stage 4 are complete.

Forced: If there is no progress on this stage at the end of the round, the first player adds the topmost enemy in the discard pile to the staging area, if able.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/077 - 3A - Battle in the Dale.jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/077 - 3B - Battle in the Dale.jpg

back.name: The Defense of Ravenhill
back.text:
Players cannot advance from this stage unless stage 2 and stage 3 are complete.

Forced: If there is no progress on this stage at the end of the round, each player must discard all resources from each hero's resource pool.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/078 - 4A - The Defense of Ravenhill.jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/078 - 4B - The Defense of Ravenhill.jpg

back.name: The Clouds Burst
back.text:
When Revealed: Each player must search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Bodyguard of Bolg and add it to the staging area, if able. Shuffle the encounter deck.

Progress cannot be placed on this stage. While Bolg is in the staging area, it is considered to be engaged with the first player.

If Bolg is destroyed, the players win the game.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/079 - 5A - The Clouds Burst.jpg
13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Quest/079 - 5B - The Clouds Burst.jpg

cards.name: Flies and Spiders
cards.text: The Quest Deck has been modified for Nightmare Mode. Flip this card over and keep it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active throughout the game, which is now ready to begin.

back.name: Flies and Spiders
back.text:
You are playing Nightmare Mode.

Setup: Each player gives 1 poison to a hero he controls.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/Flies and Spiders/001 - Flies and Spiders.jpg

cards.name: Attercop
cards.text:
Attercop gets -1 engagement cost for each poison in play.
Poisoned characters cannot be declared as attackers or defenders against Attercop.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/Flies and Spiders/002 - Attercop.jpg

cards.name: Venemous Spider
cards.text: Forced: After a character is declared as a defender against Venomous Spider, give it 1 poison.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Give 2 poison to the defending character.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/Flies and Spiders/003 - Venemous Spider.jpg

cards.name: Dark Colony
keywords: While Dark Colony is the active location, poisoned characters cannot ready
cards.text: Travel: A player at this stage must give 1 poison to a hero he controls to travel here.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/Flies and Spiders/004 - Dark Colony.jpg

cards.name: Mirkwood Path
keywords: X is the number of poison in play
cards.text: Forced: When this location is explored, make 1 hero unconscious.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û for each poisoned character you control.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/Flies and Spiders/005 - Mirkwood Path.jpg

cards.name: Patch of Midnight
cards.text: While Patch of Midnight is the active location, treat the text box of each poisoned character as if it were blank (except for Traits).
cards.shadow: Shadow: Raise your threat by 1 for each poisoned character you control.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/Flies and Spiders/006 - Patch of Midnight.jpg

cards.name: A Horrible Battle
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must either give 1 poison to each hero he controls, or reveal an encounter card.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy makes an additional attack against the defending player after this one.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/Flies and Spiders/007 - A Horrible Battle.jpg

cards.name: Spider Bite
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to a hero that is not unconscious. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per hero. Forced: At the end of the refresh phase, give attached hero 1 poison. When attached hero becomes unconscious, discard Spider Bite.")

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/Flies and Spiders/008 - Spider Bite.jpg

cards.name: The Battle of Five Armies
cards.text: The Quest Deck has been modified for Nightmare Mode. Flip this card over and keep it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active throughout the game, which is now ready to begin.

back.name: The Battle of Five Armies
back.text:
You are playing Nightmare Mode.

While the players are at stage 5B, this card gains: "Forced: When the players are instruced to remove any amount of progress from a quest stage, place 1 progress here instead."

If there are X progress tokens here, the players lose the game. X depends on the number of players in the game:
1 player: X equals 5
2 players: X equals 7
3 players: X equals 9
4 players: X equals 11

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Battle of Five Armies/001 - The Battle of Five Armies.jpg

cards.name: Great Warg
cards.text: Forced: After Great Warg attacks and destroys a character, remove all progress from the current quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player discards 1 attachment he controls.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Battle of Five Armies/002 - Great Warg.jpg

cards.name: Frenzied Warg-Rider
cards.text: Forced: When Frenzied Warg-Rider attacks, remove 1 progress from each quest stage.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal 1 damage to the defending character (2 damage instead if the current quest has no progress on it).

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Battle of Five Armies/003 - Frenzied Warg-Rider.jpg

cards.name: Gundabad Elite
cards.text: Forced: At the end of the round, if Gundabad Elite is in the staging area, either remove 2 progress from the current quest, or Gundabad Elite makes an attack against the first player.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Battle of Five Armies/004 - Gundabad Elite.jpg

cards.name: Embattled Valley
cards.text:
Forced: At the end of the round, each player assigns X damage among heroes he controls. X is the number of quest stages with no progress on them.
Travel: The players (as a group) exhaust X characters. X is the number of quest stages with no progress on them.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Battle of Five Armies/005 - Embattled Valley.jpg

cards.name: Eastern Ridge
cards.text: Forced: At the end of the round, raise each player's threat by 1 for each quest stage with no progress on it.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Until the end of the phase, attacking enemy gets +1 Ú for each quest stage with no progress on it.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Battle of Five Armies/006 - Eastern Ridge.jpg

cards.name: Dread Has Come!
cards.text: When Revealed: Bolg makes an attack against each player in turn order. If at least 1 character is destroyed by one of these attacks, the players cannot place progress on the current quest this round.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +2 Û.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Battle of Five Armies/007 - Dread Has Come!.jpg

cards.name: The Lonely Mountain
cards.text: The Quest Deck has been modified for Nightmare Mode. Flip this card over and keep it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active throughout the game, which is now ready to begin.

back.name: The Lonely Mountain
back.text:
You are playing Nightmare Mode.

While there is at least 1 card stacked underneath The Lonely Mountain, the players cannot advance to stage 3.
Smaug the Magnificent cannot take damage unless A Bare Patch is attached to him.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Lonely Mountain/001 - The Lonely Mountain.jpg

cards.name: Erebor Bats
cards.text:
Forced: When Erebor Bats attacks, the defending player discards 1 random card from his hand.

Burgle: The first player shuffles his deck and reveals the top card. He may discard 2 cards from his hand that match the revealed card's cost and type.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Lonely Mountain/002 - Erebor Bats.jpg

cards.name: Secret Tunnel
cards.text:
Forced: After a player fails a burgle attempt, each player raises his threat by 2.

Travel: Exhaust Bilbo Baggins and spend 1 Í resource to travel here.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Lonely Mountain/003 - Secret Tunnel.jpg

cards.name: Southern Spur
cards.text: Forced: At the end of the planning phase, each player who played at least 1 ally this phase must raise his threat by 1.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +2 Û. If this attack destroys a character, raise each player's threat by 3.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Lonely Mountain/004 - Southern Spur.jpg

cards.name: The Front Gate
cards.text:
Forced: When The Front Gate is explored, each Dragon enemy in play makes an attack against the first player. (Deal and resolve a shadow card for this attack.)
Burgle: The first player shuffles his deck and reveals the top card. He may discard 3 cards from his hand that match the revealed card's cost.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Lonely Mountain/005 - The Front Gate.jpg

cards.name: The Dragon's Ire
cards.text: When Revealed: Each Dragon enemy in play makes an immediate attack against each player in turn order. Do not deal shadow cards for these attacks. For each character that is destroyed by one of these attacks, place 1 progress on each Dragon enemy in play.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Lonely Mountain/006 - The Dragon_s Ire.jpg

cards.name: Lust for Treasure
cards.text:
When Revealed: Each player raises his threat by 1 for each attachment attached to a character he controls.

Burgle: The first player shuffles his deck and reveals the top card. He may discard 1 card from his hand that matches the revealed card's sphere, type, and cost.

images.source: 13 - The Hobbit/02 - On the Doorstep/Nightmare/The Lonely Mountain/007 - Lust for Treasure.jpg

cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.text: Response: Spend 1 [fellowship] resource and exhaust The One Ring to cancel the effect of an encounter card just revealed from the encounter deck. Shuffle that card back into the encounter deck and reveal another encounter card.
cards.flavor: "I will take the Ring," he said, "though I do not know the way." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/001 - Frodo Baggins.jpg

cards.name: Sam Gamgee
cards.text: Response: After you engage an enemy with a higher engagement cost than your threat, ready Sam Gamgee. He gets +1 [willpower] +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "I'm going with him...and if any of those Black Riders try to stop him, they'll have Sam Gamgee to reckon with" <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/002 - Sam Gamgee.jpg

cards.name: Merry
cards.text: Merry gets +1 [attack] for each Hobbit hero you control. Response: After Merry participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, ready another character that participated in that attack.
cards.flavor: "You can trust us to stick to you through thick and thin to the bitter end" <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/003 - Merry.jpg

cards.name: Pippin
cards.text: Each enemy in play gets +1 engagement cost for each Hobbit hero you control. Response: After you engage an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat, draw a card.
cards.flavor:
"We Hobbits ought to stick together, and we will"
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/004 - Pippin.jpg

cards.name: Fatty Bolger
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Fatty Bolger to choose an enemy in the staging area and raise your threat by that enemy's [threat]. Until the end of the phase, that enemy does not contribute its [threat]. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I only hope that you do not need rescuing before the day is out" <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/005 - Fatty Bolger.jpg

cards.name: Bill the Pony
cards.text: Cannot have attachments. Lower the cost to play Bill the Pony by 2 if you control Sam Gamgee. Each Hobbit character gets +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: "He gave me a look as plain as Mr. Pippin could speak it: if you don't let me go with you, Sam, I'll follow on my own" <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/006 - Bill the Pony.jpg

cards.name: Barliman Butterbur
cards.text: If each hero you control has the Hobbit trait, damage from undefended attacks against you may be assigned to Barliman Butterbur.
cards.flavor: "But spooks or no spooks, they won't get in The Prancing Pony so easy." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/007 - Barliman Butterbur.jpg

cards.name: Farmer Maggot
cards.text: Response: After Farmer Maggot enters play, deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you. (Deal 2 damage instead if that enemy's engagement cost is higher than your threat.)
cards.flavor: "It is lucky for you that I know you. I was going out to set my dogs on any strangers." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/008 - Farmer Maggot.jpg

cards.name: Halfling Determination
cards.text: Action: Choose a Hobbit character. That character gets +2 [willpower], +2 [attack], and +2 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: "I have something to do before the end, and it lies ahead, not in the Shire. I must see it through, sir, if you understand me." <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/009 - Halfling Determination.jpg

cards.name: Smoke Rings
cards.text: Action: Reduce your threat by 1 for each Pipe you control. Each hero with a Pipe attachment gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: ...he smoked and blew smoke-rings with the same vigour and delight...<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/010 - Smoke Rings.jpg

cards.name: Take No Notice
cards.text: Lower the cost play Take No Notice by 1 for each Hobbit or Ranger hero you control. Action: Add 5 to each enemy's engagement cost until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: ...they made no noise that even hobbits would hear. Event the wild things in the fields and woods hardly noticed their passing. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/011 - Take No Notice.jpg

cards.name: Frodo's Intuition
cards.text: Action: Each hero you control gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the round. Draw 1 card for each Hobbit hero you control.
cards.flavor: "I wonder if that is Gandalf coming after us" said Frodo, but even as he said it, he had a feeling that it was not so... <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/012 - Frodo_s Intuition.jpg

cards.name: Hobbit Cloak
cards.text: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +2 [defense] while defending against an attack by an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat.
cards.flavor: In their dark cloaks they were invisible as if they all had magic rings. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/013 - Hobbit Cloak.jpg

cards.name: Dagger of Westernesse
cards.text:
Restricted.
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if attacking an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat).
cards.flavor:
...these blades were forged many long years ago by Men of Westernesse: they were foes of the Dark Lord...
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/014 - Dagger of Westernesse.jpg

cards.name: Hobbit Pipe
cards.text: Attach to a Hobbit character. Limit 1 per character. Response: After your threat is reduced by an event card effect, exhaust Hobbit Pipe to draw a card.
cards.flavor: But even the Dúnedain of Gondor allow us this credit: Hobbits first put it into pipes. Not even the Wizards first thought of that before we did. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/015 - Hobbit Pipe.jpg

cards.name: Elf-stone
cards.text: Attach to the active location. Attached location gets +1 quest point. Response: After attached location leaves play as an explored location, the first player puts 1 ally into play from his hand.
cards.flavor:
"It is a beryl, an elf-stone. Whether it was set there, or let fall by chance, I cannot say, but it brings hope to me"
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/016 - Elf-stone.jpg

cards.name: Mr. Underhill
cards.text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Action: Add Mr. Underhill to the victory display to choose an enemy engaged with you. Until the end of the round, that enemy cannot attack you.
cards.flavor: "I will give you a travelling name now. When you go, go as Mr. Underhill." -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/017 -Mr. Underhill.jpg

cards.name: Tireless Ranger
cards.text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [defense] and gains the Ranger trait.
cards.flavor: "What roads would any dare to tread, what safety would there be in quiet lands, or in the homes of simple men at night, if the Dúnedain were asleep, or were all gone into the grave?" -Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/018 - Tireless Ranger.jpg

cards.name: Skilled Healer
cards.text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +2 hit points and gains the Healer trait.
cards.flavor: "Few now have the skill in healing to match such evil weapons. But I will do what I can." -Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/019 - Skilled Healer.jpg

cards.name: Valiant Warrior
cards.text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] and gains the Warrior trait.
cards.flavor: "Three of the servants of Sauron were upon the Bridge, but they withdrew and I pursued them westward." -Glorfindel, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/020 - Valiant Warrior.jpg

cards.name: Noble Hero
cards.text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower] and gains the Noble trait.
cards.flavor: Venerable he seemed as a king crowned with many winters, and yet hale as a tried warrior in the fullness of his strength. -The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Player/021 - Noble Hero.jpg

cards.name: Three is Company
cards.text: Setup: Set Bucklebury Ferry aside, out of play.  Add 1 Black Rider to the staging area and make Bag End the active location.  Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Three is Company
back.text:
When a player fails a Hide test, each Nazgul enemy in the staging area engages that player. (Trigger Forced effects after resolving this effect.)

The players cannot advance unless Bag End is in the victory display.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/022 - 1A - Three is Company.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/022 - 1B - Three is Company.jpg

back.name: A Shortcut to Mushrooms
back.text:
When Revealed: The first player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a Black Rider, reveals it (cannot be cancelled), and adds it to the staging area.  Shuffle the encounter deck.

When a player makes a Hide test, add 1 to the total $ for each ally that player controls.

When a player fails a Hide test, each Nazgul enemy in the staging area engages that player. (Trigger Forced effects after resolving this effect.)

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/023 - 2A - A Shortcut to Mushrooms.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/023 - 2B - A Shortcut to Mushrooms.jpg

cards.name: Escape to Buckland
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Bucklebury Ferry to the staging area.

back.name: Escape to Buckland
back.text:
When Revealed: The first player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a Black Rider, reveals it (cannot be cancelled), and adds it to the staging area.  Shuffle the encounter deck.

When a player fails a Hide test, each Nazgul enemy in the staging area engages that player. (Trigger Forced effects after resolving this effect.)

Response: After a player makes a successful Hide test, place X progress on a non-unique location in play.  X is twice the number of players in the game.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/024 - 3A - Escape to Buckland.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/024 - 3B - Escape to Buckland.jpg

cards.name: Trouble in Bree
cards.text: Setup: Set all copies of Ringwraith, The Witch-king, Midgewater, and Weathertop aside, out of play.  Add The Prancing Pony and Bill Ferny to the staging area.  Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Trouble in Bree
back.text: The players cannot advance while The Prancing Pony is in play.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/025 - 1A - Trouble in Bree.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/025 - 1B - Trouble in Bree.jpg

back.name: Into the Wild
back.text:
When Revealed: Add Midgewater to the staging area.  Each player places 1 progress on the current quest.

Forced: At the end of the round, either remove X progress from the current quest or shuffle 1 out of play Ringwraith into the encounter deck.  X is the number of players in the game.

The players cannot advance while Midgewater is in play.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/026 - 2A - Into the Wild.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/026 - 2B - Into the Wild.jpg

cards.name: The Ringwraiths Attack
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Weathertop and The Witch-king to the staging area.  Search the encounter deck and discard pile and add each Nazgul enemy found to the staging area.  Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: The Ringwraiths Attack
back.text: If there are no Nazgul enemies in play, the players win the game.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/027 - 3A - The Ringwraiths Attack.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/027 - 3B - The Ringwraiths Attack.jpg

cards.name: Pursued by the Enemy
cards.text: Setup: Shuffle each burden card from the Flight to the Ford burden set into a Burden deck. Attach An Evil Wound to the Ring-bearer.  Set Ford of Bruinen and The Witch-King aside, out of play.  Add The Last Bridge and 1 Fell Rider per player to the staging area.  Set the Ring-bearer's life at 15. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Pursued by the Enemy
back.text:
The players cannot advance unless The Last Bridge is in the victory display.

Forced: At the end of the round, reduce the Ring-bearer's life by 1.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/028 - 1A - Pursued by the Enemy.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/028 - 1B - Pursued by the Enemy.jpg

back.name: Race To Rivendell
back.text:
When Revealed: Add Ford of Bruinen and The Witch-king to the staging area.

While at least 1 Nazgul enemy is in play, Race to Rivendell gets +15 quest points.

Forced: At the end of the round. Reduce the Ring-bearer's life by 1.

If the players defeat this stage, they have won the game.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/029 - 2A - Race to Rivendell.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/029 - 2B - Race to Rivendell.jpg

cards.name: A Shadow of the Past
cards.encounterSet: The Lord of the Rings Part 1
cards.text: Setup: Attach Mr. Underhill to the Ring-bearer. Add Gandalf's Delay to the staging area. Shuffle Gildor Inglorion and the The Ring Draws Them into the encounter deck.

back.name: A Shadow of the Past
back.text: Resolution: Choose Gandalf's Delay or The Ring Draws Them and add it to the Campaign Pool.  Then, choose Gildor Inglorion or Mr. Underhill and add it to the Campaign Pool.  The chosen cards have been earned by the players.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/030 - A Shadow of the Past.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/030 - Reverse.jpg

cards.name: Bag End
cards.text: Response: After Bag End leaves play, each player draws 1 card for each Hobbit hero he controls.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Shadow of the Past/031 - Bag End.jpg

cards.name: Woody End
cards.text: While Woody End is the Active location, reduce each Hide X value by 1.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Shadow of the Past/032 - Woody End.jpg

cards.name: Stock-brook
cards.text: When Revealed: Immediately travel to Stock-Brook.  If another location is currently active, return it to the staging area.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Shadow of the Past/033 - Stock-brook.jpg

cards.name: Bamfurlong
cards.text: Response: After the players travel to Bamfurlong, each player engaged with a Nazgul enemy may ready a hero he controls.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Shadow of the Past/034 - Bamfurlong.jpg

cards.name: Bucklebury Ferry
cards.text:
While there is at least 1 other location in play, the players cannot travel here.

Travel: The first player must make a Hide 3 test to travel here.

After Bucklebury Ferry leaves play as an explored location, the players win the game.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Shadow of the Past/035 - Bucklebury Ferry.jpg

cards.name: Green Hill Country
cards.text: While Green Hill Country is the active location, characters get +1 Ò while committed to Hide tests.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û (+2 Û instead if you have failed a Hide test this round).

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Shadow of the Past/036 - Green Hill Country.jpg

cards.name: Stock Road
cards.text:
While Stock Road is in the staging area, add 2 to the total $ of the discarded cards when a player resolves a Hide test.

Travel: The first player must make a Hide 1 test to travel here.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Shadow of the Past/037 - Stock Road.jpg

cards.name: The Marish
cards.text: Forced: After a player fails a Hide test, shuffle a Nazgul enemy from the discard pile into the encounter deck, if able.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û (+2 Û instead if the defending player failed a Hide test this round).

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Shadow of the Past/038 - The Marish.jpg

cards.name: Black Rider
cards.text: Forced: After engaged player fails a Hide test, Black Rider makes an immediate attack.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Shadow of the Past/039 - Black Rider.jpg

cards.name: Evil Crow
cards.text: While Evil Crow is engaged with a player, that player adds 1 to the Hide value for each Hide test he makes.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If you have failed a Hide test this round, this attack is considered undefended.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Shadow of the Past/040 - Evil Crow.jpg

cards.name: Crawling Towards Him
cards.text: When Revealed: If you have failed a Hide test this phase, remove each character you control form the quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Return attacking enemy to the staging area after this attack.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Shadow of the Past/041 - Crawling Towards Him.jpg

cards.name: Hunting for the Ring
cards.text: When Revealed: Starting with the first player, each player much either return a Nazgul enemy engaged with him to the staging area or make a Hide 2 test.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Shadow of the Past/042 - Hunting for the Ring.jpg

cards.name: Have you seen Baggins
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to a hero. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per hero. Forced: After a player fails a Hide test, discard attached hero.")

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Shadow of the Past/043 - Have you seen Baggins.jpg

cards.name: A Knife in the Dark
cards.encounterSet: The Lord of the Rings Part 2

back.name: A Knife in the Dark
back.text: Resolution: Starting with the first player, each player may choose one of the following boon cards and attach it to a hero he controls: Tireless Ranger, Skilled Healer, Valiant Warrior, Noble Hero. The chosen cards have been earned by the players.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/044 - A Knife in the Dark.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/044 - Reverse.jpg

cards.name: The Prancing Pony
cards.text:
Response: After the players travel here, the first player puts 1 ally into play from his hand.

Forced: After the Prancing Pony leaves play, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until X enemies have been discarded.  X is the number of players in the game. Put each enemy discarded by this effect into play engaged with the first player.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Knife in the Dark/045 - The Prancing Pony.jpg

cards.name: Weathertop
cards.text:
While Weathertop is in the victory display, each enemy in play gets -1 $.

Travel: The first player must exhaust The One Ring to travel here.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Knife in the Dark/046 - Weathertop.jpg

cards.name: Chetwood
cards.text: While Chetwood is in the staging area, Spy enemies get +1 $ and +1 Û.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player discards 1 random card from his hand.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Knife in the Dark/047 - Chetwood.jpg

cards.name: Midgewater
cards.text:
While Midgewater is the active location, enemies cannot attack, take damage, or be engaged.

Forced: After Midgewater becomes the active location, return each engaged enemy in play to the staging area.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Knife in the Dark/048 - Midgewater.jpg

cards.name: Weather Hills
cards.text:
Response: After the players travel here, place 1 non-unique enemy in play facedown under this location.  While an enemy is under this location, it is out of play.

Forced: After this location leaves play, return each enemy under it to the staging area face-up.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Knife in the Dark/049 - Weather Hills.jpg

cards.name: Rider of Mordor
cards.text:
While Rider of Mordor is engaged with a player, characters that player controls get -1 Ò.

While The One Ring is exhausted, Rider of Mordor gets -10 engagement cost.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Knife in the Dark/050 - Rider of Mordor.jpg

cards.name: Bill Fenry
keywords: Players cannot optionally engage Bill Ferny
cards.text: Forced: At the beginning of the staging step, either shuffle 1 out of play Ringwraith into the encounter deck or each player raises his threat by 1 for each non-☺ hero he committed to the quest.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Knife in the Dark/051 - Bill Fenry.jpg

cards.name: Shady Bree-lander
cards.text: While the One Ring is exhausted, Shady Bree-lander gains: "Cannot be optionally engaged."
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending character gets -1 Ú (-2 Ú instead if The One Ring is exhausted).

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Knife in the Dark/052 - Shady Bree-lander.jpg

cards.name: Squint-eyed Southerner
cards.text: When Revealed: You must either shuffle an out of play Ringwraith into the encounter deck or reveal an additional encounter card.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Knife in the Dark/053 - Squint-eyed Southerner.jpg

cards.name: Unwanted Attention
cards.text: When Revealed: You must either remove 2 heroes you control from the quest or shuffle an out of play Ringwraith into the encounter deck.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Return attacking enemy to the staging area after this attack.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Knife in the Dark/054 - Unwanted Attention.jpg

cards.name: Black Breath
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to a hero you control.  (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per hero. Reduce attached hero's Ò, Û, and Ú to 0.")

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/A Knife in the Dark/055 - Black Breath.jpg

cards.name: Flight to the Ford
cards.encounterSet: The Lord of the Rings Part 3
cards.text: Response: After an enemy is declared as an attacker, shuffle the top card of the burden deck into the encounter deck to cancel that attack. (Any player may trigger that ability.)

back.name: Flight to the Ford
back.text: Resolution: Add each burden card in player, in the encounter deck, and in the discard pile to the Campaign Pool.  Then added cards have been earned by the players.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/056 - Flight to the Ford.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Quest/056 - Reverse.jpg

cards.name: An Evil Wound
cards.text:
When attached hero would take any amount of damage, reduce the Ring-bearer's life an equal amount instead.

If the Ring-bearer's life reaches zero, the players lose the game.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/Flight to the Ford/057 - An Evil Wound.jpg

cards.name: The Last Bridge
cards.text:
X is the number of players in the game.

Travel: The first player must reveal the top card of the burden deck and resolve that card as if it were just revealed from the encounter deck to travel here.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/Flight to the Ford/058 - The Last Bridge.jpg

cards.name: Ford of Bruinen
cards.text:
Response: After Ford of Bruinen leaves play as an explored location, all engaged enemies are discarded.

Travel: The first player must reveal the top card of the encounter deck to travel here.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/Flight to the Ford/059 - Ford of Bruinen.jpg

cards.name: The Troll's Camp
cards.text: While The Troll's Camp is the active location, each hero gets +1 Ò, +1 Û +1 Ú.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/Flight to the Ford/060 - The Troll_s Camp.jpg

cards.name: Ettenmoors
cards.text:
While Ettenmoors is the active location, do not deal Nazgul enemies a shadow card during the combat phase.

Forced: After any amount of progress is placed on Ettenmoors, reduce the Ring-bearer's life by 1.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/Flight to the Ford/061 - Ettenmoors.jpg

cards.name: The Old Road
cards.text: Action: Place the top card of the burden deck on the encounter deck to place 4 progress on The Old Road. (Use this action only if you are playing campaign mode.)

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/Flight to the Ford/062 - The Old Road.jpg

cards.name: Fell Rider
cards.text: While Fell Rider is in the staging area, it gains: "Forced: At the beginning of the encounter phase, the first player must either reduce the Ring-bearer's life by 1 or engage Fell Rider."

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/Flight to the Ford/063 - Fell Rider.jpg

cards.name: Sticken Dumb
cards.text: When Revealed: You must either shuffle the top card of the burden deck into the encounter deck and reveal an additional encounter card, or raise each player's threat by 3 and immediately end the quest phase (do not resolve the quest).

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/01 - The Black Riders/Encounter/Flight to the Ford/064 - Sticken Dumb.jpg

cards.name: The Enemy is Upon Us!

cards.text: Response: After Frodo Baggins exhausts to defend an attack, exhaust The One Ring and spend 1 [fellowship] resource to target the attacking enemy. Then, this attack deals no damage and each player raises his threat by 2.
cards.flavor: "But there is more about you now than appears on the surface." <cite>Bilbo, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/02 - The Road Darkens/Player/001 - Frodo Baggins.jpg

cards.text: Play with the top card of your deck faceup. Once per phase, you may play the top card of your deck as if it was in your hand. When playing a card this way, Gandalf is considered to have the printed [leadership], [lore], [tactics], and [spirit] icons.
cards.flavor: "I am a servant of the Secret Fire, wielder of the flame of Anor." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/02 - The Road Darkens/Player/002 - Gandalf.jpg

keywords: At the end of the round, discard Galadriel from play

keywords: At the end of the round, discard Elrond from play

cards.text: Response: After Bilbo Baggins enters play, search your deck for a Pipe attachment and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "Elves may thrive on speech alone, and Dwarves endure great weariness, but I am an old Hobbit, and I miss my meal at noon." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/02 - The Road Darkens/Player/006 - Bilbo Baggins.jpg

cards.text: Action: Add Flame of Anor to the victory display and discard the top card of your deck to ready an Istari character you control. That character gets +X [attack] until the end of the phase where X is the discarded card's cost.
cards.flavor: "You cannot pass!" <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/02 - The Road Darkens/Player/007 - Flame of Anor.jpg

cards.text: Attach to Gandalf. Restricted. Action: Exhaust Gandalf's Staff to (choose one): choose a player to draw 1 card, add 1 resource to a hero's resource pool, or discard a shadow card from a non-unique enemy.
cards.flavor: ...he held his staff aloft, and from its tip there came a feint radiance. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/02 - The Road Darkens/Player/008 - Gandalf_s Staff.jpg

cards.text: Attach to an Istari character. Limit 1 per character. Action: Exhaust Wizard Pipe to exchange a card in your hand with the top card of your deck.
cards.flavor: ...there was a long silence, broken only by the soft puffs of Gandalf's pipe, as he blew white smoke-rings out of the window. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/02 - The Road Darkens/Player/009 - Wizard Pipe.jpg

cards.name: Fellowship of the Ring
cards.text: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Each hero gets +1 [willpower]. Forced: After a character is destroyed, discard Fellowship of the Ring.
cards.flavor:
"The Company of the Ring shall be Nine: and the Nine Walkers shall be set against the Nine Riders that are evil."
<cite>Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/02 - The Road Darkens/Player/010 - Fellowship of the Ring.jpg

cards.text: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Response: After attached hero exhausts to defend an attack, discard the top card of the encounter deck. Deal damage to the attacking enemy equal to the discarded card's [threat].

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/02 - The Road Darkens/Player/011 - Sting.jpg

cards.name: Mithril Shirt
cards.text: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Attached hero gets +1 [defense] and +1 hit point.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/02 - The Road Darkens/Player/012 - Mithril Shirt.jpg

keywords: Attach to a Warrior hero or Gandalf

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/02 - The Road Darkens/Player/013 - Glamdring.jpg

keywords: Attach to a Noble hero or Aragorn

Declare attached hero as an attacker against that enemy (and resolve the attack).

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/02 - The Road Darkens/Player/015 - Phial of Galadriel.jpg

cards.flavor: "...your hands shall flow with gold, and yet over you gold shall have no dominion." -Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/02 - The Road Darkens/Player/016 - Three Golden Hairs.jpg

cards.name: Lorien Rope

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/02 - The Road Darkens/Player/017 - Lorien Rope.jpg

Each player chooses one and adds it to his hand. If any of those boon cards remain unchosen, shuffle them into the first player's deck.

back.text: Forced: At the end of the planning phase, each player places the top card of his deck faceup in front of him, in player order, until there are a total of 4 faceup cards between the players. The first player chooses 1 faceup card to player for 0 cost, 1 to add to its owners hand, 1 to discard, and 1 to shuffle into its owner's deck. Then, either shuffle Lust for the Ring into the encounter deck, or raise each player's threat by 5. Advance to stage 2.

cards.text:
Begin with the standard and encounter deck for the Breaking of the Fellowship scenario.

2x River Anduin
1x Slopes of Amon Hen
2x Black Feathered Arrows

cards.name: Aragorn
cards.text: The first player gains control of Aragorn. If Aragorn leaves play, the players lose the game. Action: Spend 2 resources from Aragorn's resource pool to ready a hero.
cards.flavor:
"I am Aragorn son of Arathorn and am called Elessar, the Elfstone, Dunadan, the heir of Isildur Elendil’s son of Gondor."
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/001 - Aragorn.jpg

cards.name: Theoden
cards.text: Sentinel. Reduce the cost of the first Rohan ally you play from your hand each round by 1 (to a minimum of 0).
cards.flavor: "Arise now, arise, Riders of Théoden!" <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/002 - Theoden.jpg

cards.name: Treebeard
cards.text: Cannot have restricted attachments. Action: Deal 1 damage to Treebeard to give him +1 [willpower] and +1 [attack] until the end of the phase. (Limit 5 times per phase.)
cards.flavor:
"I am not altogether on anybody's side, because nobody is altogether on my side..."
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/003 - Treebeard.jpg

cards.name: Gimli
cards.text: Sentinel. Response: After an enemy is revealed from the encounter deck, ready Gimli.
cards.flavor:
"Give me a row of orc-necks and room to swing and all weariness will fall from me!"
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/004 - Gimli.jpg

cards.name: Legolas
cards.text: Ranged. Response: After Legolas participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "He stands not alone," said Legolas, bending his bow and fitting an arrow with hands that moved quicker than sight. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/005 - Legolas.jpg

cards.name: Quickbeam
cards.text: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. Response: After Quickbeam enters play, deal 1 damage to him to ready him.
cards.flavor: "I am Bregalad, that is Quickbeam in your language. But it is only a nickname, of course." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/006 - Quickbeam.jpg

cards.name: Hama
cards.text: Combat Action: Ready Háma. He gets +3 [defense] until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase, discard Háma. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I am the Doorward of Théoden," he said. "Háma is my name." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/007 - Hama.jpg

cards.name: Arod
keywords: Attach to a hero or Legolas
cards.text: Attach to a hero or Legolas. Response: After attached character participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, exhaust Arod to place 1 progress token on any location.
cards.flavor: "A smaller and lighter horse, but restive and fiery, was brought to Legolas. Arod was his name." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/008 - Arod.jpg

cards.name: Ent Draught
keywords: Play only if you control at least 1 Ent character
cards.text: Play only if you control at least 1 Ent character. Attach to a character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +2 hit points.
cards.flavor: The effect of the draught began at the toes, and rose steadily through every limb, bringing refreshment and vigour as it coursed upwards, right to the tips of the hair. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/009 - Ent Draught.jpg

cards.name: Herugrim
cards.text: Attach to a Rohan hero. Restricted. Reduce the cost to play Herugrim on Théoden by 1. Response: After attached hero is declared as an attacker, exhaust Herugrim to add attached hero's [willpower] to its [attack] for this attack.
cards.flavor: "Here, lord, is Herugrim, your ancient blade." <cite>Háma, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/010 - Herugrim.jpg

cards.name: Entmoot
keywords: Play only if you control at least 1 Ent character
cards.text: Play only if you control at least 1 Ent character. Action: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for any number of Ent cards and add them to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.flavor: "...it is a gathering of Ents - which does not often happen nowadays." <cite>Treebeard, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/011 - Entmoot.jpg

cards.name: Helm! Helm!
keywords: Play only after the resolving enemy attacks step is complete
cards.text: Play only after the resolving enemy attacks step is complete. Combat Action: Exhaust and discard a Rohan ally you control to choose and discard a non-unique enemy engaged with you.
cards.flavor: "Helm is arisen and comes back to war. Helm for Théoden King!" <cite>Riders of Rohan, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/012 - Helm! Helm!.jpg

cards.name: The Three Hunters
keywords: Play only if you control ☺ Aragorn
cards.text: Play only if you control [fellowship] Aragorn. Quest Action: Choose 3 heroes committed to the quest. Ready those heroes. Until the end of the round, each of the chosen heroes gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense].
cards.flavor: "We shall makes such a chase as shall be accounted a marvel among the Three Kindreds: Elves, Dwarves, and Men. Forth the Three Hunters!" <cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/013 - The Three Hunters.jpg

cards.name: Shadowfax
cards.text: Attach to Gandalf. Gandalf gains ranged and sentinel. Action: Exhaust Shadowfax to ready Gandalf.
cards.flavor: "He is the chief of the Mearas, lords of horses, and not even Théoden, King of Rohan, has ever looked on a better." <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/014 - Shadowfax.jpg

cards.name: Intimidation
cards.text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a Warrior hero. Response: After attached hero is declared as the only attacker against a non-unique enemy, exhaust Intimidation to give that enemy -2 [defense] for this attack.
cards.flavor: "None knows what the new day shall bring him," said Aragorn. "Get you gone, ere it turn to your evil!" -Aragorn, The Two Towers

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/015 - Intimidation.jpg

cards.name: Hands of a Healer
cards.text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a Healer hero. Action: Exhaust attached hero and Hands of a Healer to heal up to 3 damage from a hero.
cards.flavor:
"Life to the dying
  In the king"s hand lying!"
  -Herb-master, The Return of the King

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/016 - Hands of a Healer.jpg

cards.name: Forewarned
cards.text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a Ranger hero. Response: After attached hero is declared as a defender against a non-unique enemy, exhaust Forewarned to discard 1 shadow card from that enemy.
cards.flavor: "Faint and far are the feet of our enemies." -Aragorn, The Two Towers

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/017 - Forewarned.jpg

cards.name: Leader of Men
cards.text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a Noble hero. Response: After attached hero quests successfully, exhaust Leader of Men to add 1 resource to attached hero's pool.
cards.flavor: "Take this, dear lord!" said a clear voice. "It was ever at your service." -The Two Towers

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/018 - Leader of Men.jpg

cards.name: Beyond All Hope
cards.text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], +1 [defense] and cannot have treachery card attachments.
cards.flavor: "Beyond all hope you return to us in our need!" -Aragorn, The Two Towers

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/019 - Beyond All Hope.jpg

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/03 - The Treason of Saruman/Player/020 - Palantir of Orthanc.jpg

cards.flavor: "And ever Wormtongue's whispering was in your ears, poisoning your thought, chilling your heart, weakening your limbs..." –Gandalf, The Two Towers

1x Snaga
2x Eastemnet
2x Plains of Rohan
3x The Wold

cards.text:
When Revealed: Make Blocked Tunnel the active location, returning any other active location to the staging area.

cards.name: Shelob's Poison

cards.shadow: Shadow: If attacking enemy is Shelob, resolve the ‘When Revealed’ effect on Shelob’s Poison.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Encounter/The Great Spider/060 - Shelob_s Poison.jpg

cards.name: Lurking Malice
cards.text: When Revealed: Either place 1 resource on Shelob, or she makes an immediate attack against you.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If attacking enemy is Shelob, place 1 resource on her. Then, she gets +1 Û for each resource on her.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Encounter/The Great Spider/061 - Lurking Malice.jpg

cards.name: Rage and Hunger
cards.text: When Revealed: Shelob gets +2 Û until the end of the phase. Then, she makes an immediate attack against each player, in player order.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Encounter/The Great Spider/062 - Rage and Hunger.jpg

cards.name: The One Ring
cards.text: Setup: The first player claims The One Ring and attaches it to the Ring-bearer. Attached hero does not count against the hero limit. The first player gains control of attached hero. If The One Ring leaves play, the players lose the game.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Encounter/The Great Spider/063 - The One Ring.jpg

cards.name: The Taming of Smeagol
cards.text: Setup: Put Gollum into play engaged with the first player. Each player searches the encounter deck for 1 location, reveals it, and adds it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: The Taming of Smeagol
back.text:
The players cannot advance unless the first player controls Smeagol.

Forced: After a player declares any number of attackers against Gollum, discard the top card of the encounter deck. Gollum gets +X Ú for this attack, where X is the discarded card's $.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/064 - 1A - The Taming of Smeagol.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/064 - 1B - The Taming of Smeagol.jpg

cards.name: Across the Marshes
cards.text: When Revealed: If the number of locations in the staging area is less than the number of players in the game, discard cards from the encounter deck until a location is discarded. Then, add the discarded location to the staging area.

back.name: Across the Dead Marshes
back.text:
Progress cannot be placed on locations in the staging area.

The players cannot advance unless the first player controls Smeagol and there are at least 4 locations in the victory display.

Forced: At the end of the staging step, if the number of locations in the staging area is less than the number of players in the game, reveal the top card of the encounter deck.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/065 - 2A - Across the Marshes.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/065 - 2B - Across the Marshes.jpg

cards.name: Don't Look at the Lights!
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for an Undead enemy and puts it into play engaged with him. Shuffle all locations in the victory display into the encounter deck.

back.name: "Don't Look at the Lights!"
back.text:
While any player is engaged with an Undead enemy, progress cannot be placed on this stage.

The players cannot defeat this stage unless the first player controls Smeagol. If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/066 - 3A - Don_t Look at the Lights!.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/066 - 3B - Don_t Look at the Lights!.jpg

cards.name: The Passage of the Marshes
cards.text: Setup: Each player shuffles 1 copy of The Searching Eye into his deck. Remove each burden with the following burden set icons from the encounter deck and each player's deck: HD, RtI.

back.name: The Passage of the Marshes
back.text: Resolution: Each player must choose: either take a permanent +2 starting threat penalty, or earn 1 copy of The Seatching Eye. Record each player's choice in the campaign log.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/067 - The Passage of the Marshes (errata).jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/067 - The Passage of the Marshes.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/067 - Reverse.jpg

cards.name: Ambush the Men of Harad
cards.text: Setup: Add The Black Gate and The Cross­roads to the staging area. Shuffle the Men of Harad encounter set and place it facedown under The Cross­roads. Each player, except the first player, searches the encounter deck for a different non-unique location adds it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Ambush the Men of Harad
back.text:
Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, reveal the top card facedown card from under The Cross­roads and add it to the staging area.

The players cannot defeat this stage while The Cross­roads is in play. When The Cross­ roads is explored, the players win the game.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/068 - 1A - Ambush the Men of Harad.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/068 - 1B - Ambush the Men of Harad.jpg

cards.name: Journey to the Cross-roads
cards.text: Setup: Each player must choose: either add 1 resource to each of his heroes' pools, or shuffle 1 copy of Brace of Coneys into his deck. Remove each burden with the following burden set icons from the encounter deck and each player's deck: HD, RtI

back.name: Journey to the Cross-roads
back.text: Resolution: Each player who chose to shuffle a copy of Brace of Coneys into his deck during setup has earned that boon. Add each earned copy to the campaign pool. Record the name and quantity of each enemy underneath The Black Gate in the notes section of the campaign log.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/069 - Journey to the Cross-roads.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/069 - Reverse.jpg

cards.name: The Stairs of Cirith Ungol
cards.text: Setup: Set Cleft of Cirith Ungol, Shelob and The Great Spider encounter set aside, out of play. Put Smeagol into play under the first player’s control. Make Morgul Vale the active location. Add Smeagol’s Secret Way to the staging area.

back.name: The Stairs of Cirith Ungol
back.text:
Progress cannot be placed on Underground locations.

Response: After Smeagol’s Secret Way is explored, discard 3 random cards from each player’s hand to discard each Nazgul enemy in the staging area.

Forced: At the end of the quest phase, if Smeagol’s Secret Way is in the victory display, advance to stage 2A.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/070 - 1A - The Stairs of Cirith Ungol.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/070 - 1B - The Stairs of Cirith Ungol.jpg

cards.name: The Spider's Pass
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Shelob to the staging area and shuffle all cards from The Great Spider encounter set and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.

back.name: The Spider's Pass
back.text:
Shelob cannot leave the staging area and Smeagol cannot attack or defend. 
Each player cannot play, or put into play, more than 1 ally each round.
No more than 4 progress can be placed on this stage each round.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/071 - 2A - The Spider_s Pass.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/071 - 2B - The Spider_s Pass.jpg

cards.name: Gollum's Betrayal
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Cleft of Cirith Ungol to the staging area. Flip Smeagol to Gollum and heal all damage from Shelob. Each player places 1 resource on Shelob.

back.name: Gollum's Betrayal
back.text:
If Gollum is defeated, add him to the victory display. (Do not flip him over.)

While Shelob has at least 1 resource on her, she gains: “Forced: When Shelob is dealt any amount of damage, cancel that damage and discard 1 resource from Shelob instead.” 

The players cannot defeat this stage unless Shelob and Gollum are in the victor display. If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/072 - 3A - Gollum_s Betrayal.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/072 - 3B - Gollum_s Betrayal.jpg

cards.name: Shelob's Lair
cards.text: Setup: Attach A Heavy Burden to the Ring­bearer. Remove each burden with the following burden set icons from the encounter deck and each player's deck: RD, RtI.

back.name: Shelob's Lair
back.text: Resolution: Add A Heavy Burden to the campaign pool. The players have earned that burden.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/073 - Shelob_s Lair.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Quest/073 - Reverse.jpg

cards.text:

Forced: When Gollum is defeated, flip him to Smeagol and exhaust Smeagol.

back.name: Smeagol
back.text:
Forced: After the players quest unsuccessfully, flip Smeagol to Gollum.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Encounter/Gollum/075 - Gollum.jpg
