cards.name: Journey to the Crossroads
cards.text:
Begin with the standard quest deck and encounter deck for the Journey to the Crossroads scenario.

1x Captain of Harad
1x Henneth Annun
2x Southward Road
4x Hills of Ithilien
3x The Dark Lord's Summons
Then, shuffle the encounter cards in this Nightmare Deck into the remainder of the standard Journey to the Cross-roads encounter deck.
Finally, flip this setup card over and place it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active through the game, which is now ready to begin.

back.name: Journey to the Cross-roads
back.text:
You are playing Nightmare mode.
Setup: Place 1 Southron Warrior per player facedown under The Cross-roads, then shuffle the facedown cards under The Cross-roads. Set any remaining Southron Warriors aside, out of play.

cards.name: Southron Warrior
cards.text: Forced: After Southron Warrior engages you, discard an ally you control.
cards.shadow: Atacking enemy gets +1 Û (+2 Û instead if the defending character is damaged).

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/Journey to the Cross-roads/002 - Southron Warrior.jpg

cards.name: Southron Rearguard
cards.text:
Cannot have attachments or be placed under The Black Gate.
Southron Rearguard gets –1 engagement cost for each progress token on stage 1B.
cards.shadow: Return attacking enemy to the staging area.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/Journey to the Cross-roads/003 - Southron Rearguard.jpg

cards.shadow: Discard a non-objective attachment you control.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/Journey to the Cross-roads/004 - Wooded Glade.jpg

cards.text: While Dense Fern-brake is the active location, enemies in the staging area are immune to player card effects.
cards.shadow: Exhaust a character you control.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/Journey to the Cross-roads/005 - Dense Fern-brake.jpg

cards.text:
Shadowy Thicket gets +2 $ for each facedown card under The Black Gate.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/Journey to the Cross-roads/006 - Shadowy Thicket.jpg

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/Journey to the Cross-roads/007 - Blind Wrath.jpg

Begin with the standard quest deck and encounter deck for the Shelob's Lair scenario.

4x Morgul Orc
2x The Under-way
3x Deep Dark Passage
2x Many Openings

back.text:
You are playing Nightmare mode.

cards.text: Forced: When Foul-smelling Cave is explored, place 1 resource on Shelob, if able.
cards.shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û (+2 Û instead if attacking enemy is Shelob).

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/Shelob_s Lair/002 - Foul-smelling Cave.jpg

While Torech Ungol is in the staging area, Shelob gets +1 Û and +1 Ú.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/Shelob_s Lair/003 - Torech Ungol.jpg

cards.text:
Immune to player card effects.
While Cobwebbed Tunnel is in the staging area, each Underground location in the staging area gets +1 $ and +5 quest points.
Travel: The first player reveals an encounter card to travel here.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/Shelob_s Lair/004 - Cobwebbed Tunnel.jpg

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/Shelob_s Lair/005 - Orc of Minas Morgul.jpg

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/Shelob_s Lair/006 - Under-gate Sentry.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: Each player removes a character he controls from the quest and exhausts that character. Until the end of the round, characters cannot be readied by player card effects.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/Shelob_s Lair/007 - Impenetrable Dark.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: Deal Growing Stench to Shelob as a facedown shadow card.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/Shelob_s Lair/008 - Growing Stench.jpg

cards.name: The Passage of the Marshes
cards.text:
Begin with the standard quest deck and encounter deck for The Passage of the Marshes scenario.
Remove the following cards, in the specified quantities, from the encounter deck:
3x Groping Dead
3x Dead Things
3x Soft Mires
3x Haunted Mere
3x Bitter Reek
Then, shuffle the encounter cards in this Nightmare Deck into the remainder of the standard The Passage of the Marshes encounter deck.
Finally, flip this setup card over and place it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active through the game, which is now ready to begin.

back.name: The Passage of the Marshes
back.text:
You are playing Nightmare mode.
Forced: When a location in the staging area is explored, raise each player's threat by X, where X is that location's Mire value.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/The Passage of the Marshes/001 - The Passage of the Marshes.jpg

cards.text:
Forced: When Festering Mire is discarded by the Mire keyword, each player discards his hand.

cards.text:
Forced: When Candle-lit Pool is discarded by the Mire keyword, each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for an Undead enemy and puts it into play engaged with him.
Travel: Spend 2 ? resources to travel here.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/The Passage of the Marshes/003 - Candle-lit Pool.jpg

cards.text:
Forced: When Great Reed Thicket is discarded by the Mire keyword, either flip Sméagol to Gollum, or Gollum makes an immediate attack.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/The Passage of the Marshes/004 - Great Reed Thicket.jpg

cards.text:
The engaged player cannot reduce his threat.

cards.text:
Cannot have attachments.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/The Passage of the Marshes/006 - Rotting Thing.jpg

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/04 - The Land of Shadow/Nightmare/The Passage of the Marshes/007 - Rot and Vapors.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: Deal Gollum's Rage to Gollum as a facedown shadow card, if able.

cards.name: Aragorn
cards.text: The first player gains control of Aragorn. If Aragorn leaves play,the players lose the game. While Aragorn has an Artifact attached, he gains sentinel and does not exhaust to quest.
cards.flavor:
"I have no help to send, therefore I must go myself..."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/001 - Aragorn.jpg

cards.name: Eowyn
cards.text: Setup: Reduce your threat by 3. Action: Raise your threat by 3 to ready Éowyn. She gets +9 [attack] until the end of the phase. (Limit once per game for the group.)
cards.flavor:
"But no living man am I! You look upon a woman. Éowyn I am, Éomund's daughter."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/002 - Eowyn.jpg

cards.name: Beregond
cards.text: Sentinel. Response: After Beregond defends an attack and takes no damage, reduce the defending player's threat by 1. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
"The Lord does not permit those who wear the black and silver to leave their post for any cause..."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/003 - Beregond.jpg

cards.name: Grimbold
cards.text: Combat Action: Discard Grimbold to choose an enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase.
cards.flavor:
Grimbold's men turned aside and passed round to a great gap in the wall further eastward.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/004 - Grimbold.jpg

cards.name: Prince Imrahil
cards.text: While there is a hero in your discard pile, Prince Imrahil loses the ally card type and gains the hero card type.
cards.flavor:
"We must gather all of the strength that we can find."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/005 - Prince Imrahil.jpg

cards.name: Halbarad
cards.text:
Reduce the cost to play Halbarad by 1 for each enemy engaged with you.
Each enemy engaged with you gets +10 engagement cost.
cards.flavor:
"Halbarad Dúnadan, Ranger of the North I am..."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/006 - Halbarad.jpg

cards.name: Ghan-buri-Ghan
cards.text: X is the [threat] of the active location. Travel Action: Discard Ghân-buri-Ghân to travel to a location without resolving its Travel effect.
cards.flavor:
"Ghân-buri-Ghân will not lead you into trap."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/007 - Ghan-buri-Ghan.jpg

cards.name: Sterner than Steel
cards.text: Response: Exhaust a Weapon or Armor card attached to the defending character to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during combat.
cards.flavor:
"Do what you will; but I will hinder it, if I may."
<cite>Éowyn, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/008 - Sterner than Steel.jpg

cards.name: Desperate Defense
cards.text: Response: After a sentinel character is declared as a defender, it gets +2 [defense] for this attack. If this attack deals no damage, ready the defending character.
cards.flavor: ...but alone in the porch upon the topmost step stood Beregond, clad in the black and silver of the Guard; and he held the door against them. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/009 - Desperate Defense.jpg

cards.name: Golden Shield
cards.text: Attach to a Rohan hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero is declared as a defender, exhaust Golden Shield to add attached hero's [willpower] to it's [defense] for this attack.
cards.flavor: His golden shield was uncovered, and lo! it shone like an image of the Sun... <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/010 - Golden Shield.jpg

cards.name: Livery of the Tower
cards.text: Attach to a Gondor hero. Restricted. Response: Spend X resources from attached hero's pool to cancel X damage just dealt to attached hero.
cards.flavor:
This was the livery of the heirs of Elendil, and none wore it now in all Gondor, save the Guards of the Citadel...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/011 - Livery of the Tower.jpg

cards.name: Roheryn
cards.text: Attach to a Dúnedain hero. If the attached hero is Aragorn, he gains a [tactics] icon. Response: After you optionally engage an enemy, exhaust Roheryn and attached hero to declare attached hero as an attacker (and resolve its attack) against that enemy.
cards.flavor:
"Aragorn's own horse that they had brought from the North; Roheryn was his name."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/012 - Roheryn.jpg

cards.name: Banner of Elendil
cards.text:
Attach to Aragorn.
While Aragorn is commited to the quest, each other questing character you control gets +1 [willpower].
While Aragorn is attacking, each other attacking character you control gets +1 [attack].
cards.flavor:
Seven stars were about it, and a high crown above it, the signs of Elendil that no lord had borne for years beyond count.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/013 - Banner of Elendil.jpg

cards.name: Esquire of Rohan
cards.text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the Rohan trait. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] while attacking with another Rohan character.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/014 - Esquire of Rohan.jpg

cards.text: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the Gondor trait. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower] while committed to the quest with another Gondor character.
cards.flavor: "Here do I swear fealty and service to Gondor, and to the Lord and Steward of the realm..." -Pippin, The Return of the King

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/05 - The Flame of the West/Player/015 - Esquire of Gondor.jpg

cards.name: Overcome by Fear

cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.text: Planning Action: Exhaust The One Ring to add 1 resource to a hero's pool.
cards.flavor: "I must carry the burden to the end." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/001 - Frodo Baggins.jpg

cards.name: Aragorn
cards.text: Sentinel. The first player gains control of Aragorn. Action: Spend 1 resource from Aragorn's pool to ready him. (Limit once per phase.) If Aragorn leaves play, the players lose the game.
cards.flavor: "As I have begun, so I will go on.." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/002 - Aragorn.jpg

cards.name: Eomer
cards.text: Response: After Éomer commits to the quest, spend 1 resource from his resource pool to immediately declare him as an attacker (and resolve his attack) against an enemy in the staging area.
cards.flavor: ...he was young, and he was king; the lord of a fell people. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/003 - Eomer.jpg

cards.name: Tom Cotton
cards.text: While you are engaged with an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat, the first Hobbit ally you play each round does not require a resource match. Response: After a Hobbit ally enters play, it gets +2 [attack] until the end of the round.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/004 - Tom Cotton.jpg

cards.name: Rosie Cotton
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Rosie Cotton to choose a Hobbit hero and an attribute ([willpower], [attack], [defense]). Add Rosie Cotton's [willpower] to that hero's chosen attribute until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "…take care of yourself, and come straight back as soon as you have settled the ruffians!" <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/005 - Rosie Cotton.jpg

cards.name: Elfhelm
cards.text: Action: Spend 1 resource from a Rohan hero's resource pool to put Elfhelm into play from your hand under your control. At the end of the phase, discard Elfhelm if he is still in play.
cards.flavor: "...my lord sends word that we must set ourselves in readiness; orders may come for a sudden move." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/006 - Elfhelm.jpg

cards.name: Elladan
cards.text: While Elrohir is in play, Elladan gets +2 [attack]. After you optionally engage an Orc enemy, ready Elladan.
cards.flavor: ...they rode often far afield with the Rangers of the North, forgetting never their mother's torment in the dens of the Orcs. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/007 - Elladan.jpg

cards.name: Elrohir
cards.text: While Elladan is in play, Elrohir gets +2 [defense]. After you optionally engage an Orc enemy, ready Elrohir.
cards.flavor: "From the North we came with this purpose, and from Elrond our father we brought this very counsel." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/008 - Elrohir.jpg

cards.name: Captains of the West
cards.text: Quest Action: Until the end of the phase, each Noble hero gets +1 [willpower] and does not exhaust to commit to the quest.
cards.flavor: "...there are names among us that are worth more than a thousand mail-clad knights apiece." <cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/009 - Captains of the West.jpg

cards.name: Raise the Shire
cards.text: Response: After you engage an enemy, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Hobbit ally and put it into play (search you entire deck instead if that enemy's engagement cost is higher than your threat). Shuffle your deck. At the end of the round, if that ally is still in play, return it to your hand.
cards.flavor: …come on now, lads! Bywater is up! We must be in it!" <cite>Tom Cotton, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/010 - Raise the Shire.jpg

cards.name: Guthwine
cards.text: Attach to a Rohan hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero is declared as an attacker, exhaust Gúthwinë to give that hero +2 [attack] for this attack. If this attack destroys an enemy, return a Rohan ally from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor: "Gúthwinë!" cried Éomer. "Gúthwinë for the Mark!" <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/011 - Guthwine.jpg

cards.name: Friend of Friends
cards.text: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Limit 2 copies of Friend of Friends in play. While another hero has Friend of Friends attached, attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], +1 [defense] and +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: "Come, Mr. Frodo!" he cried, "I can't carry it for you, but I can carry you and it as well." <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/012 - Friend of Friends.jpg

cards.name: Orc Disguise
cards.text: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Limit one per hero. While an Orc is making an enagement check with you, it gets +5 engagement cost. Response: After an Orc engages you, discard Orc Disguise. . Until the end of the round, that enemy cannot attack you.
cards.flavor: "Well, there you are, Mr. Frodo. A perfect little orc…" <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/013 - Orc Disguise.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: The first player must choose: Either exhaust The One Ring and reveal an encounter card, or discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded and put it into play engaged with him.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard a non-objective attachment you control.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Encounter/Deep Shadows/061 - Drawn to the Ring.jpg

cards.name: Deep Shadows
cards.text: Doomed 2. When Revealed: Each player must choose: either discard your hand (with at least 3 cards in it), or he reveals an encounter card.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Encounter/Deep Shadows/062 - Deep Shadows.jpg

cards.name: Evil Vigilance
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must choose: Either discard a questing character you control, or raise your threat by 1 for each questing character you control.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û. If this attack destroys a character, reveal the top card of the encounter deck.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Encounter/Deep Shadows/063 - Evil Vigilance.jpg

cards.name: In Darkness Bind Them
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player exhausts a character he controls. If The Eye of Sauron is in the staging area, characters cannot be readied by player card effects this round.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If The Eye of Sauron is in the staging area, attacking enemy gets +2 Û and returns to the staging area after this attack.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Encounter/Epic Multiplayer Mode/064 - In Darkness Bind Them.jpg

cards.name: The One Ring
cards.text: Restricted. Immune to non-Master card effects. Setup: Attach to a hero you control and search your deck for a Master card. Add it to your hand and shuffle your deck. Your threat elimination level is reduced by 5. If The One Ring leaves play, the players lose the game.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Player/065 - The One Ring.jpg

cards.name: Pass the Two Watchers
cards.text: Setup: Set Shagrat aside, out of play. Add The Two Watchers (location side faceup) and Topmost Chamber to the staging area. The first player loses control of the Ring-bearer, places it faceup under Topmost Chamber as a guarded objective. Then, the first player attaches Last of the Company to a hero he controls and attaches The One Ring to that hero.

back.name: Pass the Two Watchers
back.text: Each non-unique location gets -1 $ and cannot leave the staging area. While The Two Watchers is in the staging area (enemy side faceup), it is considered to be engaged with each player. This stage cannot be defeated while The Two Watchers is in play.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/066 - 1A - Pass the Two Watchers.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/066 - 1B - Pass the Two Watchers.jpg

cards.name: Fighting in the Tower
cards.text: When Revealed: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards until X enemies are discarded, where X is the number of players in the game. Add each enemy discarded by this effect to the staging area.

back.name: Fighting in the Tower
back.text:
Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. If there is a copy of that enemy in the staging area, discard that copy as well. If there is not, add the discarded enemy to the staging area.
This stage cannot be defeated unless Topmost Chamber is in the victory display. When the Ring-bearer is free of encounters, the first player gains control of it.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/067 - 2A - Fighting in the Tower.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/067 - 2B - Fighting in the Tower.jpg

cards.name: Escape from Cirith Ungol
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Last of the Company to the victory display. Attach The One Ring to the Ring-bearer and exhaust the Ring-bearer. The first player moves The Two Watchers from the victory display to the staging area (location side faceup). Each other player reveals an encounter card.

back.name: Escape from Cirith Ungol
back.text:
The players cannot travel to The Two Watchers unless there is at least 12 progress on this stage.
While The Two Watchers is in the staging area (enemy side faceup), it gets +3 [Threat] and +3 [Defense] and is considered to be engaged with each player.
This stage cannot be defeated while The Two Watchers is in play. If this stage is defeated, the players win the game.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/068 - 3A - Escape from Cirith Ungol.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/068 - 3B - Escape from Cirith Ungol.jpg

cards.name: The Tower of Cirith Ungol
cards.text: Setup: Each player may change heroes he controls without incurring the +1 threat penalty. Attach A Heavy Burden to the hero with Last of the Company attached. Each player chooses an Item boon (excluding Anduril) from the campaign pool and sets it aside, out of play. Remove each burden with the following burden set icons from the encounter deck and flip this card over: HD, TRtI, TPotGC

back.name: The Tower of Cirith Ungol
back.text: Forced: When the players advance to stage 3A, attach A Heavy Burden to the Ring-bearer. Attach each set aside Item boon to Shagrat as a guarded objective. When Shagrat is defeated, return each guarded boon to its owner's hand. Resolution: If Shagrat is in play, remove each Item boon attached to it from the campaign pool. (The players have lost those boons.)

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/069 - The Tower of Cirith Ungol.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/069 - Reverse.jpg

cards.name: The Two Watchers
cards.text: Immune to player card effects.  X is twice the stage number of the main quest. Forced: After the players travel here, flip The Two Watchers to its enemy side and move it to the staging area.

back.name: The Two Watchers
back.text: Immune to player card effects. Cannot be optionally engaged. Forced: When The Two Watchers deals any amount of damage, cancel the damage and raise the defending player’s threat by X instead. X is the amount of damage just canceled.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Encounter/The Tower of Cirith Ungol/070 - The Two Watchers.jpg

cards.name: The Two Watchers
cards.text: Immune to player card effects.  X is twice the stage number of the main quest. Forced: After the players travel here, flip The Two Watchers to its enemy side and move it to the staging area.

back.name: The Two Watchers
back.text: Immune to player card effects. Cannot be optionally engaged. Forced: When The Two Watchers deals any amount of damage, cancel the damage and raise the defending player’s threat by X instead. X is the amount of damage just canceled.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Encounter/The Tower of Cirith Ungol/071 - The Two Watchers.jpg

cards.name: Embassy from The Dark Tower
cards.text: Setup: Add The Black Gate and The Mouth of Sauron to the staging area. Set Gwaihir aside, out of play. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Embassy from The Dark Tower
back.text: Dire. When Revealed: In player order, each player places the top card of his deck faceup in front of him until there are a total of 4 faceup player cards between the players. Place the top 4 cards of the encounter deck faceup. Starting with the highest cost player card, pair each player card with the highest threat encounter card remaining until there are 4 pairs. For each pair, the first player must choose: either discard both cards in that pair, or reveal the encounter card to play the player card at no cost.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/072 - 1A - Embassy from The Dark Tower.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/072 - 1B - Embassy from The Dark Tower.jpg

cards.name: The Battle of Morannon
cards.text: Dire When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a different Orc, Troll, or Nazgul enemy to the staging area. Shuffle Gwaihir into the encounter deck.

back.name: The Battle of the Morannon
back.text:
Dire. During the staging step, the first player does not reveal an encounter card as normal. Instead, he reveals 1 encounter card for each resource on The Black Gate.
Forced: After the players quest unsuccessfully, discard the active location. 
This stage cannot be defeated. Each round the players survive gives the Ring-bearer more time to fulfill the quest to Mount Doom.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/073 - 2A - The Battle of Morannon.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/073 - 2B - The Battle of Morannon.jpg

cards.name: The Black Gate Opens
cards.text: Setup: Each player may change heroes he controls without incurring the +1 threat penalty. The first player may raise each player’s threat by 1 to search his deck for Anduril and add it to his hand. Remove each burden with the following burden set icons from the encounter deck: ASotP, FtF, TRGS, TPofM, SL

back.name: The Black Gate Opens
back.text: Resolution: Record the number of resource tokens on The Black Gate in the notes section of the campaign log. If a Wraith on Wings is in the victory display, remove that copy from the campaign pool. If the first player controls Gwaihir, add him to the campaign pool. The players have earned that boon. If a hero is in its controller's discard pile, do not add that hero's name to the list of fallen heroes.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/074 - The Black Gate Opens.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/074 - Reverse.jpg

cards.name: The Land of Mordor
cards.text: Setup: Add Mount Doom and The Tower of Barad-dur to the staging area. Make Brake of Thorns the active location. Each player searches the encounter deck for a different location and adds it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: The Land of Mordor
back.text:
Dire. This stage gets +4 quest points for each player.
The first treachery revealed each quest phase is immune to player card effects and gains surge.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/075 - 1A - The Land of Mordor.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/075 - 1B - The Land of Mordor.jpg

cards.name: The Road to Isenmouthe
cards.text: Dire. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and victory display for Mordor Road and add it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and travel to Mordor Road.

back.name: The Road to Isenmouthe
back.text: Dire. Forced: After placing progress here from questing successfully, each player makes a fortitude test. If a player passes this test, he places a resource here. If a player fails this test, he discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded and puts that enemy into play engaged with him. At the end of the quest phase, if the number of resources here is equal to or greater than the number of players, advance to stage 3A.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/076 - 2A - The Road to Isenmouthe.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/076 - 2B - The Road to Isenmouthe.jpg

cards.name: The Last Gasp
cards.text: Dire. When Revealed: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until X locations are discarded, where X is the number of players in the game. Add each location discarded this way to the staging area.

back.name: The Last Gasp
back.text: Dire. The first treachery revealed each quest phase is immune to player card effects and gains surge. Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, the first player makes a Fortitude test. If the first player fails this test, no more than 5 progress can be placed here this round. This stage cannot be defeated unless Mount Doom is the active location.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/077 - 3A - The Last Gasp.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/077 - 3B - The Last Gasp.jpg

cards.name: The Crack of Doom
cards.text: Dire. When Revealed: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until X enemies are discarded, where X is the number of players. Add each enemy discarded this way to the staging area.

back.name: The Crack of Doom
back.text: Dire. Allies cannot enter play and ‘when revealed’ effects cannot be canceled. Forced: When Mount Doom is explored, the first player makes a Fortitude test. Discard 1 extra encounter card for each player. If the first player fails this test, the Ring-bearer claims The One Ring for himself and the players lose the game. If the test is successful, the Ring-bearer completes his quest and the players win the game.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/078 - 4A - The Crack of Doom.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/078 - 4B - The Crack of Doom.jpg

cards.name: Mount Doom
cards.text: Setup: Each player may change heroes he controls without incurring the +1 threat penalty. Place X resource tokens on this card, where X is the number or resource tokens on The Black Gate, as recorded in the campaign log. Remove each burden with the following burden set icons from the encounter deck: HD, TRtI, TPotGC Forced: At the end of the round, remove 1 resource token from this card. Then, if there are no resource tokens here, the players lose the game.

back.name: Mount Doom
back.text: Resolution: The first player must choose: - Keep The One Ring card and succumb to the power of Sauron. Then, the players lose the campaign. - Destroy The One Ring card and defeat the power of Sauron. Then, the players win the campaign.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/079 - Mount Doom.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/079 - Reverse.jpg

cards.name: Epic Multiplayer Mode
cards.text: Setup: Create two separate staging areas: one for The Black Gate Opens and one for Mount Doom. Divide the players into 2 teams, one for each scenario. No more than 4 players can be assigned to each scenario and the number of players assigned to Mount Doom cannot be more than the number assigned to The Black Gate Opens. Shuffle 1 copy of In Darkness Bind Them into each encounter deck. Place The Eye of Sauron in the Mount Doom staging area with its corresponding side faceup. Flip this card over and set it next to the Mount Doom quest deck.

back.name: Epic Multiplayer Mode
back.text: Ignore the Forced effect on the Mount Doom campaign card if it is in play. Forced: At the end of the round, the first player chooses a scenario (The Black Gate Opens or Mount Doom). Each player at the chosen scenario draws 1 card. Each player at the other scenario reduces his threat by 3. Then, the player who controls the Gwaihir objective-ally may give control of it to another player (at either scenario). At the end of the round, if the last player at either scenario is defeated, both teams lose the game. If the Mount Doom scenario is defeated, both teams win the game.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/080 - Epic Multiplayer Mode.jpg
14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Quest/080 - Reverse.jpg

cards.name: The Eye of Sauron
cards.text: Add (S) to each Fortitude test. Forced: At the end of the round, flip The Eye of Sauron, then move it and each Nazgul enemy in the staging area to The Black Gate Opens staging area. The first player may raise each player’s threat by 3 to cancel this effect.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Encounter/Epic Multiplayer Mode/081 - The Eye of Sauron.jpg

cards.name: The Eye of Sauron
cards.text: Each enemy in the staging area gets +1 $ and -10 engagement cost. Forced: At the end of the round, flip The Eye of Sauron, then move it and each Nazgul enemy in the staging area to the Mount Doom staging area. The first player may raise each player’s threat by 3 to cancel this effect.

images.source: 14 - The Lord of the Rings/06 - The Mountain of Fire/Encounter/Epic Multiplayer Mode/082 - The Eye of Sauron.jpg

cards.name: The Witch-king
keywords: Players cannot play attachments on The Witch-king
cards.text:
While The Witch-king is in the staging area, each character gets -1 Ò.

Forced: After The Witch-king attacks, he returns to the staging area unless the defending player raises his threat by 3.

cards.text: Forced: After Wolves from Mordor attack and destroy a character, shuffle Wolves from Mordor into the encounter deck.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal 2 damage to the defending character.

cards.name: Wainriders
cards.text: Each damage dealt by Wainriders raises the defending player's threat by 1.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Encounter/004 - Wainriders.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: Move the top Scout enemy from the encounter discard pile to the staging area. (Top 2 Scout enemies instead if the players have crossed the Anduin.)

cards.shadow: Shadow: attacking enemy gets +1 Û. (+2 Û instead if players have crossed the Anduin).

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Encounter/006 - Uruk Vanguard.jpg

cards.shadow: Shadow: Remove all defending characters from combat. This attack is considered undefended.

cards.text: While Morgulduin is the active Location, it gains: 'Forced: When a character commits to a Quest, deal 1 damage to that character.'
cards.shadow: Shadow: If the players have not yet crossed the Anduin, return any current active location to the staging area. Morgulduin becomes the active location.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Encounter/009 - Morgulduin.jpg

cards.name: Pelennor Fields
cards.text: If the players have crossed the Anduin, Pelennor Fields gains: 'When faced with the option to travel, the players must either travel to Pelennor Fields or raise each player's threat by 3.'

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Encounter/010 - Pelennor Fields.jpg

cards.name: Ruins of Osgiliath
cards.text: If the players have crossed the Anduin, Ruins of Osgiliath gets +3 $.

cards.name: Cut Off
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must discard all ally cards from his hand, if able.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player must discard 1 ally card from his hand or attacking enemy gets +3 Û. (2 allies instead if this attack is undefended.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Encounter/012 - Cut Off.jpg

cards.name: Dark Pursuit
cards.text: When Revealed: Raise the total $ of the staging area by 1 for each Scout enemy in play. If there are no Scout enemies in play, Dark Pursuit gains surge.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Encounter/013 - Dark Pursuit.jpg

cards.name: Massing at Osgiliath
cards.text: When Revealed: Until the end of the phase, each card revealed by the encounter deck gains doomed 1. (Doomed 3 instead if the players have crossed the Anduin.)

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Encounter/014 - Massing at Osgiliath.jpg

cards.name: Ranger of Ithilien
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player takes control of Ranger of Ithilien, exhausted and committed to the quest. Then, Ranger of Ithilien gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal 2 damage to attacking enemy. The defending player may exhaust a character he controls to take control of Ranger of Ithilien.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Encounter/015 - Ranger of Ithilien.jpg

cards.name: Beyond Expectations
cards.text: Setup: Search the encounter deck for 12 Scout cards, and add 3 per player (one of each title), to the staging area. Remove The Witch-king from the encounter deck and set him aside, out of play. Shuffle any unused Scoutcards back into the encounter deck.

back.name: Beyond Expectations
back.text: Players cannot travel to West Bank locations.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Quest/016 - 1A - Beyond Expectations.jpg
15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Quest/016 - 1B - Beyond Expectations.jpg

back.name: Through the Ruins
back.text:
Players cannot travel to West Bank locations.

Each player cannot play or put into play more than 1 card from his hand each round.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Quest/017 - 2A - Through the Ruins.jpg
15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Quest/017 - 2B - Through the Ruins.jpg

back.name: Anduin Crossing
back.text:
Progress tokens from card effects cannot be placed on this quest card or the active location.

Players cannot travel to East Bank or West Bank locations.

In order to commit characters to the Quest, a player must first choose a hero or 1 Ranger of Ithilien card he controls. Discard each chosen card from play.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Quest/018 - 3A - Anduin Crossing.jpg
15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Quest/018 - 3B - Anduin Crossing.jpg

back.name: Race to Minas Tirith
back.text:
When Revealed: Add The Witch-king to the staging area. Players have now crossed the Anduin. Players cannot travel to East Bank locations.

If the players defeat this stage, they have won the game.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Quest/019 - 4A - Race to Minas Tirith.jpg
15 - Print on Demand/01 - The Massing at Osgiliath/Quest/019 - 4B - Race to Minas Tirith.jpg

cards.name: The Disappearance
cards.text: Setup: Make Tarlang's Neck the active location. Set Derufin, The Lord of the Dead, The Stone of Erech, and the 3 Night objectives aside, out of play. Shuffle the encounter deck. Place Eventide into play, next to the current quest.

back.name: The Disappearance
back.text:
When Revealed: Reveal 1 encounter card per player, adding them to the staging area.

Players cannot defeat this stage while Tarlang's Neck is in play.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/02 - The Stone of Erech/Quest/001 - 1A - The Disappearance.jpg
15 - Print on Demand/02 - The Stone of Erech/Quest/001 - 1B - The Disappearance.jpg

cards.name: Terror of the Dead
cards.text: When Revealed: Add The Stone of Erech to the staging area and attach Derufin to it.

back.name: Terror of the Dead
back.text: Forced: At the beginning of each round, the players must choose: each player skips the next planning phase, or heroes do not collect resources during the resource phase this round.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/02 - The Stone of Erech/Quest/002 - 2A - Terror of the Dead.jpg
15 - Print on Demand/02 - The Stone of Erech/Quest/002 - 2B - Terror of the Dead.jpg

cards.name: The Shadow Host
cards.text: When Revealed: Starting with the first player, each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 Oathbreaker enemy, reveals it, and adds it to the staging area. Add the Lord of the Dead to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: The Shadow Host
back.text:
Players cannot place progress on this stage unless they control Derufin.

If the players defeat this stage, they have escaped the Blackroot Vale with Derufin and won the game.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/02 - The Stone of Erech/Quest/003 - 3A - The Shadow Host.jpg
15 - Print on Demand/02 - The Stone of Erech/Quest/003 - 3B - The Shadow Host.jpg

cards.text:
Forced: After the players travel to The Stone of Erech, the first player gains control of Derufin.

Dusk. Derufin gets -1 Ò.

Midnight. Derufin gets -2 Ò.

If Derufin leaves play, the players lose the game.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/02 - The Stone of Erech/Encounter/004 - Derufin.jpg

cards.name: The Lord of the Dead
cards.text: While you are engaged with The Lord of the Dead, treat all printed text boxes on characters you control as if they were blank (except for Traits).

cards.text:
Forced: At the end of the round, place 1 progress on Eventide.

cards.text: Forced: At the end of the round, place 1 progress on Midnight. Then, raise each player's threat by the number of progress on Midnight.

cards.name: Standard Game Mode
cards.text: Setup: Arrange the quest cards into three separate quest decks: 1A-3A, 1C-3C, and 1E-3E. Remove the 1C-3C deck and the 1E-3E deck from the game. Search the encounter deck for Annúminas, add it to the staging area, and set its city strength to 20. Flip this card over and place it next to the quest deck.

back.name: Standard Game Mode
back.text:
Forced: When the players advance to stage 2A (and before resolving its 'when revealed' effect), shuffle each set aside Dúnedain of Annúminas into the encounter deck. Then, shuffle X copies of Host of Angmar into the encounter deck, where X is one less than the number of players in the game, to a minimum of 1.

If a player is eliminated from the game, deal 9 damage to Annúminas.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/08 - The Siege of Annuminas/Encounter/001 - Standard Game Mode.jpg

cards.name: Epic Multiplayer Mode
cards.text: Setup: Arrange the quest cards into three separate quest decks: 1A-3A, 1C-3C, and 1E-3E. Create three separate staging areas, one for each quest deck. Give each stage its own encounter deck. Divide the players into 3 teams, one team for each stage. The team at stage 1A searches the encounter deck for Annúminas, adds it to their staging area and sets its city strength to 50. Each other team removes their copy of Annúminas from the game. Flip over all 3 Setup cards and place 1 next to each quest deck.

back.name: Epic Multiplayer Mode
back.text:
Each stage 2 can only be defeated at the beginning of the round, and only if each other stage 2 is complete.

While the players are at stage 2, each stage gains: "Forced: At the end of the round, each Host of Angmar in the staging area moves to the next staging area in descending alphabetical order. If it cannot move, discard it and deal 9 damage to Annúminas."

For example: At the end of the round, there is a Host of Angmar in the staging area at stage 2F. After the teams at stage 2B and 2D resolve their end-of-round effects, the Host of Angmar in the staging area at stage 2F moves to the staging area of stage 2D.

If the last player at a stage is eliminated, the enemy has broken through the city's defenses and all teams lose the game.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/08 - The Siege of Annuminas/Encounter/002 - Epic Multiplayer Mode.jpg
15 - Print on Demand/08 - The Siege of Annuminas/Encounter/002 - Epic Multiplayer Mode (Reverse).jpg

cards.name: Rebuild the Defenses
cards.text: Setup: Set Lieutenant of Angmar, Battering Ram, Enemy Camp, Siege Tunnel, each copy of Host of Angmar, and each copy Dúnedain of Annúminas aside, out of play. Each player searches the encounter deck for a different location and adds it to the staging area. One of those locations must be Gate of Annúminas. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Rebuild the Defenses
back.text:
Forced: At the beginning of the round (before the resource phase), place 1 resource here. Then, if there are 4 resources here, advance to stage 2.

Response: At the end of the round, remove 10 progress from this stage to increase the city strength of Annúminas by 10.

cards.name: Defend the City
cards.text: When Revealed: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until X enemies are discarded. X is one less than the number of players at this stage, to a minimum of 1. Add each enemy discarded in this way to the staging area.

back.name: Defend the City
back.text:
This stage gets -10 quest points for each Host of Angmar in a victory display.

Forced: After the players have committed characters to the quest, the highest Û enemy in the staging area makes an attack against each player in turn order. If no attacks are made in this way, reveal the top card of the encounter deck.

Response: At the end of the round, choose a stage. Each player at that stage heals 1 damage from a character he controls.

back.name: Lead a Sortie
back.text:
Progress cannot be placed here while Battering Ram is in play.

Response: At the end of the round, raise each player's threat by 1 and reveal an encounter card to choose a non-unique enemy worth no victory points at another stage. Discard the chosen enemy.

If Lieutenant of Angmar is in a victory display at the end of the round, the players have routed the enemy and win the game.

Each player discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until he discards an enemy or location. Add each enemy and location discarded in this way to the staging area.

back.name: Raise the Levee
back.text:
You race along the shores of Lake Nenuial to gather the Dúnedain inside the walls. "To arms!" you shout. "Everyone into the city! Angmar approaches!"

Response: At the end of the round, remove 10 progress from this stage. Then, the first player at each stage takes control of a set aside Dúnedain of Annúminas.

cards.name: Epic Multiplayer Mode
cards.text: Setup: Create 3 separate staging area, each with its own quest deck and encounter deck. Divide the players into 3 teams, one for each staging area. One team puts Dol Guldur into play in their staging area, attaches a threat dial to it, and sets its value to 5. Then, increase its value by 5 for each player at each stage. For the rest of the game, that threat dial is the siege tracker and it displays the city strength of Dol Guldur. Each other team removes their copy of Dol Guldur. Each other team removes their copy of Dol Guldur from the game. Flip this card over.

back.name: Epic Multiplayer Mode
back.text: While Dol Guldur's city strength is 0, each Lieutenant enemy loses indestructible. While the players are at stage 3, this card gains: "Forced: After resolving the Forced effect on Dol Guldur, the team with Dol Guldur in their staging area resolves the forced effect on the stage 3 that was not in play at any stage this round. Then, each team discards all progress from their stage 3 and advances to a new stage 3 of their choice. Each team must choose a different stage." Response: At the end of the round, a player who controls Host of Lórien or Power of Lórien may give control of that card to another player at any stage. If the last player at a stage is eliminated, the siege falls and the entire group loses the game. At the end of the round, if Dol Guldur's city strength is 0 and there are no Lieutenant enemies in play at each stage, Dol Guldur is captured and the players win the game.

images.source: 15 - Print on Demand/09 - Attack on Dol Guldur/Quest/000 - Epic Multiplayer Mode.jpg
15 - Print on Demand/09 - Attack on Dol Guldur/Quest/000 - Epic Multiplayer Mode (Reverse).jpg

cards.name: Standard Game Mode
cards.text: Setup: Add Dol Guldur to the staging area, attach a threat dial to it, and set its value to 5. Then, increase it's value by 5 for each player. For the rest of the game, that threat dial is the siege tracker and it displays the city strength of Dol Guldur. Flip this card over.

back.name: Standard Game Mode
back.text: While Dol Guldur's city strength is 0, each Lieutenant enemy loses indestructible. While the players are at stage 3, this card gains: "Forced: After resolving the Forced effect on Dol Guldur, randomly select a stage 3 that was not in play this round and resolve its Forced effect. Then, discard all progress from the current stage 3 and advance to a new stage 3 of your choice." At the end of the round, if Dol Guldur's city strength is 0 and there are no Lieutenant enemies in play, Dol Guldur is captured and the players win the game.

cards.text: Ranged. Response: After Legolas commits to a quest, discard a card from your hand to ready another hero. If that hero is Gimli, he gets +1[willpower] until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
"I go to find the Sun!"
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Player/002 - Legolas.jpg

cards.name: Greenwood Archer
cards.text: Ranged. Response: After Greenwood Archer enters play, ready a hero.
cards.flavor:
They dwelt most often by the edges of the woods, from which they could escape at times to hunt...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Player/003 - Greenwood Archer.jpg

cards.name: Erebor Guard
cards.text: Sentinel. Response: When you play Erebor Guard from you hand, discard the top 2 cards of your deck to reduce its cost by 2.
cards.flavor:
...the fortress of the dwarves could not be taken by surprise.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Player/004 - Erebor Guard.jpg

cards.name: Halfling Bounder
cards.text: While there is a side quest in the victory display, Halfling Bounder gains: "Response: Discard Halfling Bounder to cancel the 'when revealed' effects of an encounter card that was just revealed from the encounter deck."
cards.flavor:
"The Bounders have never been so busy before."
<cite>Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Player/005 - Halfling Bounder.jpg

cards.name: Vigilant Dunadan
cards.text: While there is a side quest in the victory display, Vigilant Dúnadan does not exhaust to defend.
cards.flavor:
"I don't think we've rightly understood till now what they did for us."
<cite>Barliman Butterbur, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Player/006 - Vigilant Dunadan.jpg

cards.name: Unlikely Friendship
cards.text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Silvan trait and another unique character with the Dwarf trait. Action: Draw 1 card and add 1 resource to the resource pool of a hero you control.
cards.flavor:
...folk that saw them pass marvelled to see such companions…
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Player/007 - Unlikely Friendship.jpg

cards.name: Well Warned
cards.text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Noble trait and another unique character with the Scout trait. Response: After a player engages an enemy, reduce his threat by X, where X is that enemy's printed [threat].
cards.flavor:
...the Captains of the West were well warned by their scouts...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Player/008 - Well Warned.jpg

cards.name: Dour-handed
cards.text: Action: Deal X damage to an enemy engaged with you. X is the number of side quests in the victory display.
cards.flavor:
...the tides of fate had turned against them and their doom was at hand.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Player/009 - Dour-handed.jpg

cards.name: Dwarven Shield
cards.text: Attach to a Dwarf hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1[defense]. Response: After attached hero takes damage from an enemy attack, exhaust Dwarven Shield to add 1 resource to attached hero's pool.
cards.flavor:
...each of them had also a short broad sword at his side and a round shield slung at his back.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Player/010 - Dwarven Shield.jpg

cards.name: Mirkwood Long-knife
cards.text: Attach to a Silvan hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1[willpower] and +1[attack].
cards.flavor:
Legolas had a bow and a quiver, and at his belt a long white knife.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Player/011 - Mirkwood Long-knife.jpg

cards.name: The Road Goes Ever On
cards.text: Attach to a quest card in play. Response: When attached quest is defeated, the first player chooses a player. That player searches his deck for a side quest, adds it to his hand, and shuffles his deck.
cards.flavor:
"Now far ahead the Road has gone,
And I must follow, if I can..."
<cite>Frodo Baggins, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Player/012 - The Road Goes Ever On.jpg

cards.name: The Storm Comes
cards.text:
Limit 1 copy of The Storm Comes in the victory display.
While this quest is in the victory display, the first ally played by each player each round does not require a resource match.
cards.flavor:
"For behold! The storm comes, and now all friends should gather together, lest each singly be destroyed."
<cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Player/013 - The Storm Comes.jpg

cards.name: Seize Them!
cards.text: Forced: After an enemy attacks and destroys a character, remove X progress from the main quest. X is the attacking enemy’s $.At the end of the the round, if the main quest has been in play the entire round and there are no progress tokens on it, the players lose the game.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Escape from Umbar/014 - Seize Them!.jpg

cards.text: Forced: When Umbar Sentry attacks, either remove 1 progress token from the main quest, or it gets +2 Û for this attack.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Escape from Umbar/015 - Umbar Sentry.jpg

cards.text: Response: After the player travel here, choose a non-unique enemy engaged with a player and place it faceup under this location. images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Escape from Umbar/016 - Narrow Alleyway.jpg

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Escape from Umbar/017 - Umbar Street.jpg

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Escape from Umbar/018 - Umbar Square.jpg

cards.text: X is the number of engaged enemies.Travel: Assign X damage among characters in play to travel here.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Escape from Umbar/019 - Port of Harad.jpg

Then, place 1 progress on the main quest, bypassing the active location. Shuffle the encounter deck.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Escape from Umbar/020 - Haradrim Estate.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: Either remove all progress from the main quest, or assign X damage among characters in play. X is the number of progress tokens on the main quest.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Escape from Umbar/021 - Enemy Pursuit.jpg

Forced: At the end of the round, remove X progress from the main quest. X is the tens digit of the temperature.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Crossing/022 - Seek Shade.jpg

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Crossing/023 - Were-worm.jpg

cards.text: Carrion Bird gets -1 engagement cost for each damaged character in play.Forced: After Carrion Bird engages you, discard a damaged character you control.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Crossing/024 - Carrion Bird.jpg

cards.text: While the temperature is 40 or higher, Burnt Sands gets +2 $.Forced: After Burnt Sands becomes the active location, increase the temperature by 2.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Crossing/025 - Burnt Sands.jpg

cards.name: Scorched Hamada
cards.text: X is the tens digit of the temperature.Forced: After Scorched Hamada becomes the active location, assign X damage among characters in play.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Raise your threat by X, where X is the tens digit of the temperature.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Crossing/026 - Scorched Hamada.jpg

cards.name: Parched Wadi
cards.text: While Parched Wadi is in the staging area, each Creature enemy gets +1 $ and +1 Û.Forced: After Parched Wadi becomes the active location, shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until a Creature enemy is discarded. Add that enemy to the staging area.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Crossing/027 - Parched Wadi.jpg

cards.name: Mirage
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard a the active location. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until a location is discarded. Make that location the active location.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Crossing/028 - Mirage.jpg

cards.name: Unbearable Heat
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player assigns X damage among characters he controls, where X is the tens digit of the temperature.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +X Û, where X is the tens digit of the temperature.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Crossing/029 - Unbearable Heat.jpg

cards.name: Scorching Sun
cards.text: When Revealed: Increase the temperature by 4.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Either raise the temperature by 2, or return attacking enemy to the staging area after this attack.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Crossing/030 - Scorching Sun.jpg

cards.name: Kahliel
cards.text:
Response: At the beginning of the planning phase, add 1 resource to a hero’s resource pool. 
If Kahliel leaves play, you are eliminated from the game.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/The Long Arm of Mordor/031 - Kahliel.jpg

cards.name: Firyal
cards.text:
Response: After Firyal commits to a quest, look at the top card of the encounter deck. Then, you may discard that card.
If Firyal leaves play, you are eliminated from the game.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/The Long Arm of Mordor/032 - Firyal.jpg

cards.name: Yazan
cards.text:
Response: After Yazan is declared as an attacker, deal 1 damage to a non-unique enemy in play. (Limit once per phase.)
If Yazan leaves play, you are eliminated from the game.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/The Long Arm of Mordor/033 - Yazan.jpg

cards.name: Jubayr
cards.text:
Response: After Jubayr is declared as a defender, discard 1 facedown shadow card from a non-unique enemy. (Limit once per phase.)
If Jubayr leaves play, you are eliminated from the game.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/The Long Arm of Mordor/034 - Jubayr.jpg

cards.name: Sauron's Enforcers
cards.text: X is the sequence number on the main quest.Forced: At the end of the round, assign X damage among characters in play.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/The Long Arm of Mordor/035 - Sauron_s Enforcers.jpg

cards.name: Southron Boma
cards.text: X is the stage number of the main quest.Travel: Each player spends 1 resource to travel here.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If the defending character is an objective-hero, ready it and cancel all damage from this attack.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/The Long Arm of Mordor/036 - Southron Boma.jpg

cards.name: Village Hut
cards.text: Response: After the players travel to Village Hut, the first player discards the top card of his deck. If that card is an ally, he puts it into play under his control, exhausted.Travel: Discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is an enemy, add it to the staging area.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/The Long Arm of Mordor/037 - Village Hut.jpg

cards.name: Savage Attack
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must choose: either discard the highest cost ally you control, or reveal an encounter card.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/The Long Arm of Mordor/038 - Savage Attack.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: Until the end of the phase, increase the total $ in the staging area by X, where X is twice the stage number of the main quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Assign X damage among characters you control, where X is the stage number of the main quest.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/The Long Arm of Mordor/039 - Overrun by Orcs.jpg

cards.name: Southron Champion
cards.text:
When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until a Harad enemy is discarded. Add that enemy to the staging area and place a resource token on it. That enemy is “the Champion.” While this stage is in play, the Champion gets +2 $, +2 Û, +2 Ú and gains: “Immune to player card effects. The main quest stage cannot be defeated while the Champion is in play.”
The champion cannot take damage unless there are at least 4 progress tokens here. This stage cannot be defeated while the champion is in play.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Harad Soldiers/040 - Southron Champion.jpg

cards.text: While Southron Captain is in the staging area, each other Harad enemy gets +1 $.While Southron Captain is engaged with you, each other Harad enemy engaged with you gets +1 Û.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Harad Soldiers/041 - Southron Captain.jpg

cards.name: Southron Soldier
cards.text: Forced: After Southron Soldier engages you, either remove 2 progress tokens from the main quest, or Southron Soldier makes an immediate attack.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Choose an enemy in the staging area. Engage it and deal it a shadow card.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Harad Soldiers/042 - Southron Soldier.jpg

cards.name: Southron Archer
cards.text: Forced: After Southron Archer engages you, either remove 2 progress tokens from the main quest, or discard an ally you control.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Harad Soldiers/043 - Southron Archer.jpg

cards.name: Nowhere to Hide
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded, and puts that enemy into play engaged with him.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û (+2 Û instead if it was engaged this round).

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Harad Soldiers/044 - Nowhere to Hide.jpg

cards.name: In Enemy Territory
cards.text:
Each player cannot have more than 5 cards in his hand. (If you have more than 5, immediately choose and discard cards from hand until you have only 5.)
Response: When this stage is defeated, each player draws a card.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Harad Territory/045 - In Enemy Territory.jpg

cards.name: Injured Companion
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must choose: either raise your threat by 1 for each character you control, or discard a character you control.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û. If this attack destroys a character, raise each player’s threat by 1.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Harad Territory/046 - Injured Companion.jpg

cards.name: Enfeebled
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player exhausts a character he controls. Until the end of the combat phase, exhausted characters cannot ready.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Until the end of the round, defending character cannot ready.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Harad Territory/047 - Enfeebled.jpg

cards.name: Find Water
cards.text:
Characters cannot be readied by player card effects.
Response: When this stage is defeated, each player readies 1 hero he controls.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Sands/048 - Find Water.jpg

cards.name: Towering Dunes
cards.text: While Towering Dunes is in the staging area, progress cannot be placed on locations in the staging area not named Towering Dunes.Forced: After Towering Dunes becomes the active location, reveal the top card of the encounter deck.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Sands/049 - Towering Dunes.jpg

cards.name: Desert Oasis
cards.text: While Desert Oasis is the active location, it gains: “Response: When Desert Oasis is explored, heal 4 damage from among characters in play.”Forced: After Desert Oasis becomes the active location, each player exhausts a character he controls.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Sands/050 - Desert Oasis.jpg

cards.name: Sandstorm
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player either discards his hand, or assigns X damage among characters he controls. X is the number of cards in his hand.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Sands/051 - Sandstorm.jpg

cards.shadow: Shadow: Exhaust a character you control.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Sands/052 - Heat Exhaustion.jpg

cards.text:
Treat the printed text box of each damaged character as if it were blank (except for Traits).

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Creatures/053 - Craft Remedy.jpg

cards.name: Sand Viper

cards.text: Forced: After Giant Scorpion damages a character, that character cannot ready until the end of the round.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Desert Creatures/055 - Giant Scorpion.jpg

cards.text: While Jungle Trail is the active location, each location in the staging area gets -1 $.Travel: Reveal the top card of the encounter deck to travel here.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Jungle Forest/056 - Jungle Trail.jpg

cards.name: Forest Clearing
cards.text: Forced: When Forest Clearing is explored, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is an enemy, add that enemy to the staging area.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Jungle Forest/057 - Forest Clearing.jpg

cards.name: Dense Jungle
cards.text: Forced: When Dense Jungle is explored, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is a location, add that location to the staging area.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Jungle Forest/058 - Dense Jungle.jpg

cards.name: Overgrown
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to the highest $ location in the staging area without a copy of Overgrown attached. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: “Attached location gets +1 $ and gains ‘Immune to player card effects.’”)

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Jungle Forest/059 - Overgrown.jpg

cards.text:
Each Orc enemy in the staging area gets -5 engagement cost.
Each Orc enemy engaged with a player gets +1 $.

cards.text: Cannot have player card attachments or be optionally engaged.While the engaged player is engaged with another Orc enemy, Uruk Chieftain cannot take damage.Forced: At the end of the encounter phase, Uruk Chieftain engages the player engaged with the most non-unique Orc enemies.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Mordor Orcs/061 - Uruk Chieftain.jpg

cards.text: Each ally with less Ò than Uruk of Mordor’s $ cannot defend against Uruk of Mordor.

cards.text: Uruk Warg-Rider gets +X Û while attacking a character with less Ò than Uruk Warg-rider’s $. X is the difference.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Encounter/Mordor Orcs/065 - Fear of Mordor.jpg

cards.name: Stranded in Umbar
cards.text: Setup: Add “Seize them!” to the staging area. Each player adds 1 different location to the staging area and puts 1 copy of Umbar Sentry into play engaged with him. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Stranded in Umbar
back.text: Alarm bells ring from high watchtowers and the city guard shouts for you to lay down your arms and surrender. You must run or be captured!This stage cannot have more than 15 progress tokens on it.While at least 1 player is engaged with an enemy, the players cannot defeat this stage.

16 - The Sands of Harad/Quest/066 - 1B - Stranded in Umbar.jpg

cards.name: Flee the City
cards.text: When Revealed: End the current phase. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Starting with the first player, each player discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until he discards an enemy, and puts that enemy into play engaged with him.

back.name: Flee the City
back.text: This stage cannot have more than 15 progress tokens on it.Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, if any player is not engaged with an enemy, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded and add it to the staging area.While at least 1 player is engaged with an enemy, the players cannot defeat this stage. 16 - The Sands of Harad/Quest/067 - 2B - Flee the City.jpg

cards.name: The Desert of Harad
cards.text: Setup: Each player searches the encounter deck for a copy of Burnt Sands and adds it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck. Place the heat tracker next to the quest deck and set the temperature to 10.

back.name: The Desert of Harad
back.text: As the sun climbs into the sky, you can feel the rising heat begin to take its toll on you...Forced: After an ally enters play, either exhaust it, or deal 1 damage to it.Forced: At the end of the round, increase the temperature by 4. If the temperature is 60 or higher, the players lose the game.

16 - The Sands of Harad/Quest/068 - 1B - The Desert of Harad.jpg

cards.name: Under the Merciless Sun
cards.text: When Revealed: Increase the temperature by 2. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and reveal 1 encounter card per player.

back.text: If you cannot make it across the desert soon, you are certain to die of thrist...Forced: At the end of the round, increase the temperature by 4. 16 - The Sands of Harad/Quest/069 - 2B - Under the Merciless Sun.jpg

back.name: Beasts of Legend
back.text: During the quest phase, add X $ to the total $ in the staging area, where X is the tens digit of the temperature.Forced: At the end of the round, increase the temperature by 4. 16 - The Sands of Harad/Quest/070 - 3B - Beasts of Legend.jpg

cards.name: Surprise Attack
cards.text: Setup: Set Uruk Chieftain aside, out of play. Each player adds 1 copy of Sauron’s Enforcers to the staging area. Move each hero to the staging area. Each player takes control of an objective-hero and adds 2 resources to its resource pool. Remove each remaining objective-hero from the game. For the remainder of the game, heroes in the staging area are in play but under no player’s control, immune to player card effects, and their text boxes are considered to be blank.

back.name: Surprise Attack
back.text: Damage from undefended attacks must be dealt to a hero in the staging area, if able.The first card each player plays each phase does not require a resource match.Forced: After placing progress from questing successfully, each player chooses a hero he owns in the staging area and, takes control of that hero, and exhausts it. Advance to stage 2A.

16 - The Sands of Harad/Quest/071 - 1B - Surprise Attack.jpg

Forced: When this stage is defeated, each player chooses a hero he owns in the staging area, takes control of that hero, and exhausts it.
