16 - The Sands of Harad/Quest/072 - 2B - Find the Others.jpg

cards.name: Free the Captives
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for an Orc enemy and adds it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck. Attach each hero in the staging area to a different Orc enemy in the staging area. Each hero attached to an enemy is guarded by that enemy. Guarded heroes are under no player’s control, immune to player card effects, and their text boxes are considered to be blank.

back.name: Free the Captives
back.text: While an enemy is guarding a hero it gets +1 $, +1 Û, +1 Ú and is immune to player card effects.Forced: When the enemy guarding a hero is defeated, that hero’s owner takes control of that hero and exhausts it.This stage cannot be defeated while an enemy is guarding a hero.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Quest/073 - 3A - Free the Captives.jpg
16 - The Sands of Harad/Quest/073 - 3B - Free the Captives.jpg

cards.name: Escape into the Jungle
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Uruk Chieftain to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and reveal 1 encounter card per player.

back.name: Escape into the Jungle
back.text: Uruk Chieftain cannot take non-combat damage.Each non-unique Orc enemy gets -10 engagement cost.Forced: After Uruk Chieftain engages a player, it makes an immediate attack.The players cannot defeat this stage while Uruk Chieftain is in play. If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

images.source: 16 - The Sands of Harad/Quest/074 - 4A - Escape into the Jungle.jpg
16 - The Sands of Harad/Quest/074 - 4B - Escape into the Jungle.jpg

cards.name: Kahliel
cards.text: You may use resources from Kahliel's resource pool to pay for Harad ally cards of any sphere. Action: Discard a Harad ally card from your hand to ready a Harad character in play. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
...the Southrons were bold men and grim...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Player/001 - Kahliel.jpg

cards.name: Andrath Guardsman
cards.text: Response: After you play Andrath Guardsman from your hand, choose a non-unique enemy engaged with you. That enemy cannot attack you this round.
cards.flavor:
They forgot or ignored what little they had known of the Guardians, and of the labours of those that made possible the long peace of the Shire.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Player/002 - Andrath Guardsman.jpg

cards.name: Prepare for Battle
cards.text:
Limit 1 copy of Prepare for Battle in the victory display.
While this quest is in the victory display, the first player draws an additional card during the resource phase.
cards.flavor:
"Soon there will be battle on the fields. A sortie must be made ready."
<cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Player/003 - Prepare for Battle.jpg

cards.name: Yazan
cards.text: Ranged. Response: After Yazan is declared as an attacker, deal 1 damage to a non-unique enemy in play. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
...he and his knights still held themselves like lords in whom the race of Númenor ran true.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Player/004 - Yazan.jpg

cards.name: Wait no Longer
cards.text: Response: At the beginning of the quest phase, search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy and put it into play engaged with you. Then, reveal one less encounter card this phase (to a minimum of 0). Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
"We must press our Enemy, and no longer wait upon him for the move."
<cite>Aragorn, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Player/005 - Wait no Longer.jpg

cards.name: Jubayr
cards.text: Sentinel. Response: After Jubayr exhausts to defend an attack, discard 1 facedown shadow card from a non-unique enemy. (Limit once per phase.)

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Player/006 - Jubayr.jpg

cards.name: Dwarf Pipe
cards.text: Attach to a Dwarf character. Limit 1 per character. Response: After a card is discarded from your deck, exhaust Dwarf Pipe to place that card on the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavor:
He held up a small pipe with a wide flattened bowl...
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Player/007 - Dwarf Pipe.jpg

cards.name: Firyal
cards.text: Response: After Firyal commits to the quest, look at the top card of the encounter deck. Then, you may discard the looked at card.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Player/008 - Firyal.jpg

cards.name: Coney in a Trap
cards.text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Ranger trait and another unique character with the Warrior trait. Response: After you engage an enemy, that enemy cannot attack you until the end of the round.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Player/009 - Coney in a Trap.jpg

cards.name: Kahliel's Headdress
cards.text: Attach to Kahliel. Restricted. Each Harad character gets +1[willpower]. Refresh Action: Exhaust Kahliel's Headdress to shuffle the topmost Harad ally in your discard pile into your deck.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Player/010 - Kahliel_s Headdress.jpg

cards.name: Horse-hair Lasso
cards.text: Response: After the attached enemy is dealt any amount of damage, the engaged player shuffles his deck and discards the top card. If the discarded card’s cost is equal to or greater than the attached enemy’s remaining hit points, add Horse-hair Lasso and attached enemy to the victory display.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/011 - Horse-hair Lasso.jpg

cards.name: Poisoned Spear
cards.text: Response: After the players quest successfully, the engaged player discards the top card of the encounter deck. If the discarded card’s $ is equal to or greater than the attached enemy’s remaining hit points, add Poisoned Spear and attached enemy to the victory display.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/012 - Poisoned Spear.jpg

cards.name: Pit Trap
cards.text: Response: After the players travel to a location, if the active location’s printed $ is equal to or greater than the attached enemy’s remaining hit points, the engaged player adds Pit Trap and attached enemy to the victory display.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/013 - Pit Trap.jpg

cards.name: Noose of Vines
cards.text: Response: After a character defends an attack against the attached enemy, if the defending character has more remaining hit points than the attached enemy, add Noose of Vines and attached enemy to the victory display.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/014 - Noose of Vines.jpg

cards.name: Wild Mumak
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects.
Cannot take more than 3 damage each round.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/015 - Wild Mumak.jpg

cards.name: Harad Tiger
cards.text: Cannot be optionally engaged.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/016 - Harad Tiger.jpg

cards.name: Territorial Ape
cards.text: Territorial Ape gets +X $ and + X Û, where X is the $ of the active location.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û (+2 Û instead if a location was explored this round).

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/017 - Territorial Ape.jpg

cards.name: Strangling Python
cards.text: Forced: After Strangling Python damages a character, attach it to that character. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: “Attached character cannot ready.”)

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/018 - Strangling Python.jpg

cards.name: Giant Centipede
cards.text: Forced: After Giant Centipede damages a character, treat that character’s text box as if it were blank until the end of the round (except for Traits).
cards.shadow: Shadow: Treat the defending character’s text box as blank until the end of the round.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/019 - Giant Centipede.jpg

cards.name: Mumak Trail
cards.text: While Mumak Trail is the active location, it gains: “Response: When Mumak Trail leaves play as an explored location, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Wild Mumak and add it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.”

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/020 - Mumak Trail.jpg

cards.name: Stampeding Oliphaunt
cards.text: Doomed 1.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/021 - Stampeding Oliphaunt.jpg

cards.name: The Savage South
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player discards the top 5 cards of his deck. Each player discards each card he controls that shares a title with any of the 5 cards he just discarded.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û. If this attack destroys a character, return attacking enemy to the staging area.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/022 - The Savage South.jpg

cards.name: Terrible Fever
cards.text: When Revealed: Remove a hero from the quest and attach Terrible Fever to that hero. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: “Forced: At the end of the round, deal 1 damage to attached character.”)
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending character cannot ready until the end of the round.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/023 - Terrible Fever.jpg

cards.name: Biting Insects
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player discards a random card from his hand and assigns X damage among characters he controls. X is the discarded card’s cost.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard a random card from your hand and assign X damage among characters you control. X is the discarded card’s cost.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/024 - Biting Insects.jpg

cards.name: Guardians of the Jungle
cards.text: The great apes of the jungle gather in the trees around you. They shadow your steps and slow your progress.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Encounter/025 - Guardians of the Jungle.jpg

cards.name: Welcome to the Jungle
cards.text: Setup: Set each copy of Wild Mûmak and each Capture objective aside, out of play. Each player adds 1 different location to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Welcome to the Jungle
back.text: Forced: After the active location leaves play as an explored location, shuffle 1 set aside Wild Mûmak into the encounter deck. The players cannot advance unless the number of Wild Mûmak in play is equal to the number of players.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Quest/026 -1A - Welcome to the Jungle.jpg
17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Quest/026 -1B - Welcome to the Jungle.jpg

cards.name: Capture the Oliphaunts
cards.text: When Revealed: Starting with the first player, each player attaches 1 random set-aside Capture objective to a Wild Mûmak in play.

back.name: Capture the Mumakil
back.text: Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, if there is no active location, reveal an additional encounter card this phase. This stage cannot be defeated while there are any Capture objectives in play. If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Quest/027 - 2A - Capture the Oliphaunts.jpg
17 - Haradrim/01 - The Mûmakil/Quest/027 - 2B - Capture the Oliphaunts.jpg

cards.name: Thurindir
cards.text: Thurindir gets +1 [willpower] for each side quest in the victory display. Setup: Search your deck for a side quest and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: “He is one of the wandering folk - Rangers we call them.” -Barliman Butterbur, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Player/028 - Thurindir.jpg

cards.name: Kahliel's Tribesman
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Kahliel's Tribesman to choose another Harad character. That character gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: But the Haradrim, being now driven to the brink, turned at bay, and they were fierce in despair... -The Return of the King

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Player/029 - Kahliel_s Tribesman.jpg

cards.name: Steed of the North
cards.text: Attach to a Dunedain or Ranger hero. Restricted. Response: After you engage an enemy, exhaust Steed of the North to ready attached hero.
cards.flavor: Their horses were strong and of proud bearing, but rough-haired... -The Return of the King

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Player/030 - Steed of the North.jpg

cards.name: Mighty Warrior
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gains the Warrior trait. Response: After you play Mighty Warrior from your hand, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Gimli hewed the legs from another that had sprung up on Balin’s tomb. -The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Player/031 - Mighty Warrior.jpg

cards.name: Proud Hunters
cards.text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Noble trait and another unique character with the Ranger trait. Response: After a hero you control participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, add X resources to that hero’s pool. X is the just destroyed enemy’s printed [threat].

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Player/032 - Proud Hunters.jpg

cards.name: Dunedain Pathfinder
cards.text: Forced: After this ally enters play, search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a non-unique location and add it to the staging area. If no location enters play by this effect, discard Dunedain Pathfinder. Shuffle the encounter deck.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Player/033 - Dunedain Pathfinder.jpg

cards.name: Backtrack
cards.text: Play only if the main quest has no keywords. Action: Remove X progress from the main quest to place X progress on a location in the staging area.
cards.flavor: “Well,” said Boromir, “when heads are at a loss bodies must serve...” -The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Player/034 - Backtrack.jpg

cards.name: Eryn Galen Settler
cards.text: Response: When the active location leaves play as an explored location, discard Eryn Galen Settler to discard a location in the staging with the same title as the just explored location.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Player/035 - Eryn Galen Settler.jpg

cards.name: Explore Secret Ways
cards.text:
Limit 1 copy of Explore Secret Ways in the victory display.
While this side quest is in the victory display, each location in the staging area with the same title as the active location does not contribute its [threat] to the total [threat] of the staging area.
cards.flavor: “I myself dared to pass the doors of the Necromancer in Dol Guldur, and secretly explored his ways...” -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Player/036 - Explore Secret Ways.jpg

cards.name: Steward of Orthanc
cards.text: Response: When you play an event, give it Doomed 1 to draw a card. You cannot trigger this ability if you have already triggered the ability of a Steward of Orthanc this round.
cards.flavor: “...the power of Orthanc cannot be lightly thrown aside...” -Saruman, The Two Towers

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Player/037 - Steward of Orthanc.jpg

cards.name: Tamed Mumak
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects.
Damage from undefended attacks against you must be assigned to Tamed Mumak.
If Tamed Mumak leaves play, the controlling player is eliminated.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Encounter/038 - Tamed Mumak.jpg

cards.name: River Harnen
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects.
The players cannot travel here unless there are at least 20 progress tokens on stage 4B.
Travel: Reveal 1 encounter card per player.
Stage 4B cannot be defeated while River Harnen is in play.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Encounter/039 - River Harnen.jpg

cards.name: Expanse of Harad
cards.text:
While the players are not at the same stage as the Orc’s stage, Expanse of Harad gets +2 $.
Forced: After Expanse of Harad becomes the active location, raise each player’s threat by 2.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Encounter/040 - Expanse of Harad.jpg

cards.name: Blistering Erg
cards.text:
X is the stage number of the main quest.
Forced: After Blistering Erg becomes the active location, each player assigns X damage among characters he controls.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Encounter/041 - Blistering Erg.jpg

cards.name: Harad Road
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Harad Road to the Orc’s area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If the players are not at the same stage as the Orcs, move attacking enemy to the Orc’s area after this attack.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Encounter/042 - Harad Road.jpg

cards.name: Uruk Pursuer
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Uruk Pursuer to the Orc’s area. If the players are not at the same stage as the Orcs, Uruk Pursuer gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If the players are not at the same stage as the Orcs, put Uruk Pursuer into play engaged with you.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Encounter/043 - Uruk Pursuer.jpg

cards.name: Racing Warg
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to an Orc enemy. Limit 1 per enemy. (Counts as a Mount attachment with the text: “Attached enemy gets +1 $, +1 Û, +1 Ú, and +1 hit point. Forced: When attached enemy leaves play, return Racing Warg to the staging area.”)

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Encounter/044 - Racing Warg.jpg

cards.name: Pursuers from Mordor
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an Orc enemy is discarded. Add that enemy to the Orc’s area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 Û. If this attack destroys a character, place 2 progress on the Orc’s stage.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Encounter/045 - Pursuers from Mordor.jpg

cards.name: Howling at their Heels
cards.text: When Revealed: If the players are not at the same stage as the Orcs, add the total $ of each card in the Orc’s area to the total $ in the staging area until the end of the phase. If the players are at the same stage as the Orcs, each enemy gets +1 $ until the end of the phase.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Raise your threat by 1.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Encounter/046 - Howling at their Heels.jpg

cards.name: Setting Out
cards.text: Setup: Set Ford of Harnen and 1 copy of Uruk Warg-rider aside, out of play. Each player takes control of a Tamed Mumak. Remove each remaining Tamed Mumak from the game. Create the Orc’s area with a second quest deck consisting of stage 1C, 2C, 3C, and 4C as well as Uruk Chieftain.

back.name: Setting Out
back.text: When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck for 1 different location and adds it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck. Advance to stage 2A.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/047 - 1A - Setting Out.jpg
17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/047 - 1B - Setting Out.jpg

cards.name: Racing North
cards.text: When Revealed: Choose the staging area or the Orc’s area. Add the set aside Uruk Warg-rider to the chosen area.

back.name: Racing North
back.text:
Uruk Chieftain cannot take damage.
Forced: After characters are committed to quest, no more than 5 progress can be placed here this round (10 progress instead if each Tamed Mumak in play is committed to the quest).

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/048 - 2A - Racing North.jpg
17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/048 - 2B - Racing North.jpg

cards.name: Hunted in Harad
cards.text: When Revealed: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until an Orc enemy is discarded. Add that enemy to the Orc’s area.

back.name: Hunted in Harad
back.text:
Uruk Chieftain cannot take damage.
Reveal an additional encounter card during the quest phase if Uruk Chieftain is at stage 2D.
Forced: After characters are committed to quest, no more than 5 progress can be placed here this round (10 progress instead if each Tamed Mumak in play is committed to the quest).

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/049 - 3A - Hunted in Harad.jpg
17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/049 - 3B - Hunted in Harad.jpg

cards.name: The Ford of Harnen
cards.text: When Revealed: Add River Harnen to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until an Orc enemy is discarded. Add that enemy to the Orc’s area.

back.name: The Ford of Harnen
back.text:
Forced: After characters are committed to quest, no more than 5 progress can be placed here this round (10 progress instead if each Tamed Mumak in play is committed to the quest).
Forced: After an enemy attacks and destroys a character, place 1 progress on the Orc’s stage.
If you defeat this stage, you have escaped the Orcs and win the game.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/050 - 4A - The Ford of Harnen.jpg
17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/050 - 4B - The Ford of Harnen.jpg

back.name: Setting Out
back.text:
Uruk Chieftain cannot leave the Orc’s area.
Forced: At the end of the quest phase, discard the top card of the encounter deck. Place X progress on this stage, where X is the discarded card’s $ plus the total $ in the Orc’s area.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/051 - 1C - Setting Out.jpg
17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/051 - 1D - Setting Out.jpg

cards.name: Racing North
cards.text: When Revealed: If the players have already defeated stage 2B, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an Orc enemy is discarded. Add that enemy to the Orc’s area.

back.name: Racing North
back.text:
While the players are at stage 3B, Uruk Chieftain cannot leave the Orc’s area.
Forced: At the end of the quest phase, return Uruk Chieftain to the Orc’s area and discard the top card of the encounter deck. Place X progress on this stage, where X is the discarded card’s $ plus the total $ in the Orc’s area.
If you are at stage 2B when this stage is defeated, you lose the game.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/052 - 2C - Racing North.jpg
17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/052 - 2D - Racing North.jpg

cards.name: Hunted in Harad
cards.text: When Revealed: If the players have already defeated stage 3B, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an Orc enemy is discarded. Add that enemy to the Orc’s area.

back.name: Hunted in Harad
back.text:
While the players are at stage 4B, Uruk Chieftain cannot leave the Orc’s area and each enemy at this stage gets +1 $.
Forced: At the end of the quest phase, return Uruk Chieftain to the Orc’s area and discard the top card of the encounter deck. Place X progress on this stage, where X is the total $ of the discarded card plus the total $ in the Orc’s area.
If you are at stage 3B when this stage is defeated, you lose the game.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/053 - 3C - Hunted in Harad.jpg
17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/053 - 3D - Hunted in Harad.jpg

back.name: The Ford of Harnen
back.text:
Uruk Chieftain cannot take damage while River Harnen is in the staging area.
Forced: At the end of the quest phase, discard the top card of the encounter deck. Place X progress on this stage, where X is the discarded card’s $ plus the total $ of each engaged enemy.
If the Orcs defeat this stage, the Orcs have caught you and you lose the game.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/054 - 4C - The Ford of Harnen.jpg
17 - Haradrim/02 - Race Across Harad/Quest/054 - 4D - The Ford of Harnen.jpg

cards.name: Hirgon
cards.text: Response: After Hirgon quests successfully, play a [tactics] ally from your hand, reducing its cost by 1 (to a minimum of 1). Then, you may raise your threat by 1 to give that ally +1 [attack] and +1 [defense]  until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "Hirgon I am, errand-rider of Denethor, who bring you this token of war." -The Return of the King

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/03 - Beneath the Sands/Player/055 - Hirgon.jpg

cards.name: Haradrim Spear
cards.text: Restricted. Attach to a Haradrim character. Attached character gets +1 [attack]. Response: After attached character is declared as an attacker, it gets +3 [attack] for this attack. After this attack resolves, discard Haradrim Spear.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/03 - Beneath the Sands/Player/056 - Haradrim Spear.jpg

cards.name: Hunting Party
cards.text: Play only if you control a unique character with the Warrior trait and another unique character with the Scout trait. Response: After the players have committed characters to the quest, discard a non-unique enemy in the staging area. Then, reveal an encounter card.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/03 - Beneath the Sands/Player/057 - Hunting Party.jpg

cards.name: The Red Arrow
cards.text: Limit 1 per deck. Attach to a Gondor hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower]. Valour Response: After attached hero quests successfully, add The Red Arrow to the victory display to search the top 5 cards of your deck for an ally and put it into play.
cards.flavor: "The Red Arrow has not been seen in the Mark in all my years!" -Théoden, The Return of the King

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/03 - Beneath the Sands/Player/058 - The Red Arrow.jpg

cards.name: Keep Watch
cards.text:
Limit 1 copy of Keep Watch in the victory display.
While Keep Watch is in the victory display, each non-unique enemy engaged with a player gets -1 [attack].
cards.flavor: "I called for the help of the Dúnedain, and their watch was doubled..." -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/03 - Beneath the Sands/Player/059 - Keep Watch.jpg

cards.name: Rider of Rohan
cards.text: While a side quest is in the victory display, Rider of Rohan does not exaust to quest.
cards.flavor: "Who are you, and what are you doing in this land?" said the Rider, using the Common Speech of the West… -The Two Towers

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/03 - Beneath the Sands/Player/060 - Rider of Rohan.jpg

cards.name: Fireside Song
cards.text: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower] for each Song attached to it.
cards.flavor:
"I sit beside the fire and think
of how the world will be
when winter comes without a spring
that I shall ever see." -Bilbo Baggins, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/03 - Beneath the Sands/Player/061 - Fireside Song.jpg

cards.name: Dunedain Lookout
cards.text: Response: Discard Dúnedain Lookout to cancel the 'When Revealed' effects of an enemy just revealed from the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: "Travellers scowl at us, and countrymen gives us scornful names." -Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/03 - Beneath the Sands/Player/062 - Dunedain Lookout.jpg

cards.name: Doughty Ranger
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gains the Ranger trait. Response: After you play Doughty Ranger from your hand, draw a card.
cards.flavor: ...he went forth clad only in rusty green and brown, as a Ranger of the wilderness. -The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/03 - Beneath the Sands/Player/063 - Doughty Ranger.jpg

cards.name: The Free Peoples

cards.name: Fight Your Way Out
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player adds Uruk Chieftain to the staging area. Each player chooses a hero he controls, discards all tokens and attachments from it, and attaches it to an unattached enemy in the staging area as a captive. Then, the players make a standard series of engagement checks against each enemy in the staging area. Reduce the engagement cost of each enemy not guarding an objective to 0 during these engagement checks.

back.name: Fight Your Way Out
back.text:
Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, discard cards from the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded and add that enemy to the staging area.
The players cannot defeat this stage while a guarded objective is in play. If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

17 - Haradrim/05 - The Dungeons of Cirith Gurat/Quest/134 - 3B - Fight Your Way Out.jpg

cards.name: Quickbeam
cards.text: Cannot have restricted attachments. Action: Deal 2 damage to Quickbeam to ready him. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "...he can move like a wind when he is roused." -Pippin, The Two Towers

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Player/135 - Quickbeam (errata).jpg
17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Player/135 - Quickbeam.jpg

cards.name: Halfast Gamgee
cards.text: Reduce the cost to play Halfast Gamgee by 1 for each side quest in the victory display. Response: After Halfast Gamgee enters play, add 1 resource to a hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor: "He works for Mr. Boffin at Overhill and goes up to the Northfarthing for the hunting." -Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Player/136 - Halfast Gamgee.jpg

cards.name: Bulwark of the West
cards.text: Action: Discard an ally you control to choose and discard a Condition attachment.
cards.flavor: "By our valour the wildfolk of the East are still restrained, and the terror of Morgul kept at bay; and thus alone are peace and freedom maintained in the lads behind us…" -Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Player/137 - Bulwark of the West.jpg

cards.text: Response: After Beorning Guardian participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, discard Beorning Guardian to place X progress on a location, where X is the destroyed enemy's printed [threat].
cards.flavor: "...if it were not for the Beornings, the passage from Dale to Rivendell would long ago have become impossible." -Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Player/138 - Beorning Guardian.jpg

cards.name: Followed
cards.text:
Play into your play area unattached.

cards.text: Play only if you control a Noldor or Silvan hero. Planning Action: Shuffle a set aside Wind from the Sea into the encounter deck. Then, remove Flight to the Sea from the game.
cards.flavor: "...they may pass to the Sea unhindered and leave the Middle-earth forever." -Haldir, The Two Towers

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Player/140 - Flight to the Sea.jpg

cards.text: Response: After Emyn Arnen Ranger commits to the quest, choose an enemy with a Trap attachment. Until the end of the phase, Emyn Arnen Ranger gets +X [willpower], where X is the chosen enemy's printed [threat].

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Player/142 - The Dam Bursts.jpg

cards.flavor: "In Eregion long ago many Elven-rings were made, magic rings as you call them, and they were, of course, of various kinds..." -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Player/143 - Magic Rings.jpg

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Encounter/152 - Danger Close Behind.jpg

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Encounter/155 - Mountains of Shadow.jpg

cards.text: The path through the hills has led you too far up and now you walk along exposed heights where there’s nowhere to hide. You need to find a way down. Surge. Each player’s threat cannot be reduced. Response: When Find a Way Down is defeated, each player reduces his threat by 3.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Encounter/156 - Find a Way Down.jpg

cards.name: Flight to Gondor
cards.text: Setup: Set Poros Garrison and each of the following encounter sets aside, out of play: Mountains of Shadow, Desert Sands, Desert Creatures, Harad Soldiers, and Mordor Orcs. The first player adds The Black Serpent to the staging area and shuffles the encounter deck. Each other player reveals an encounter card.

back.name: Flight to Gondor
back.text:
Allies enter play exhausted.
Forced: At the end of the planning phase, advance to a random stage 2.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Quest/157 - 1A - Flight to Gondor.jpg
17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Quest/157 - 1B - Flight to Gondor.jpg

cards.name: The Desert Path
cards.text: When Revealed: Shuffle the Desert Sands encounter set into the encounter deck. Remove the Mountains of Shadow encounter set and the other stage 2A from the game.

back.name: The Desert Path
back.text:
Forced: After a player plays an ally, he must either exhaust that ally or deal 1 damage to it.
Forced: When this stage is defeated, advance to a random stage 3.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Quest/158 - 2A - The Desert Path.jpg
17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Quest/158 - 2B - The Desert Path.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: Shuffle the Mountains of Shadow encounter set into the encounter deck. Remove the Desert Sands encounter set and the other stage 2A from the game.

back.name: The Ephel Duath
back.text:
Forced: After a player plays an ally, he must either exhaust that ally or raise his threat by 1.
Forced: When this stage is defeated, advance to a random stage 3.

17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Quest/159 - 2B - The Ephel Duath.jpg

back.text:
Enemies in the staging area cannot take damage.
Forced: After an enemy engages a player, deal 1 damage to a hero that player controls.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Quest/160 - 3A - Deadly Creatures.jpg
17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Quest/160 - 3B - Deadly Creatures.jpg

cards.name: Southron Pursuit
cards.text: When Revealed: Set each other stage 3A aside, out of play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the Harad Soldiers encounter set into the encounter deck. Then, each player reveals an encounter card.

back.name: Southron Pursuit
back.text:
Each enemy in the staging area gets -10 engagement cost.
Forced: After an enemy engages a player, remove 1 progress from this stage.

images.source: 17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Quest/161 - 3A - Southron Pursuit.jpg
17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Quest/161 - 3B - Southron Pursuit.jpg

Forced: After an enemy engages a player, raise that player’s threat by 1.

17 - Haradrim/06 - The Crossings of Poros/Quest/162 - 3B - Orc Patrols.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: The first player takes control of Poros Garrison. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for each enemy that belongs to an encounter set denoted by the first icon on each set aside stage 3 and add them to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back.name: Battle at the Crossings
back.text:
Forced: After an enemy attacks and destroys a character, remove X progress from this stage. X is the attacking enemy’s printed $.

cards.name: Brand son of Bain
cards.text: Each Dale character you control with a player attachment gets +1 [willpower]. Response: After you play an attachment on a Dale character without an attachment, draw a card.
cards.flavor:
"He is a strong king, and his realm now reaches south and east of Esgaroth."
<cite>Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/001 - Brand son of Bain.jpg

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/002 - Bard son of Brand.jpg

cards.name: Redwater Sentry
cards.text: Reduce the cost to play Armor attachments on Redwater Sentry by 1. Redwater Sentry gets +1 [defense] and gains Sentinel while it has an Armor attachment.

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/003 - Redwater Sentry.jpg

cards.name: North Realm Lookout
cards.text: North Realm Lookout gets +1 [willpower] and does not exhaust to quest while it has an Item attachment
cards.flavor:
There were people on the look-out on the banks.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/004 - North Realm Lookout.jpg

cards.name: Warrior of Dale
cards.text: Reduce the cost to play Weapon attachments on Warrior of Dale by 1. Warrior of Dale gets +1 [attack] and gains ranged while it has a Weapon attachment.

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/005 - Warrior of Dale.jpg

cards.name: Long Lake Trader
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Long Lake Trader to move an Item attachment from a character you control to another eligible character.
cards.flavor:
"Nowhere are there any men so friendly to us as the Men of Dale"
<cite>Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/006 - Long Lake Trader.jpg

cards.name: Hauberk of Mail
cards.text: Attach to a Dale or Warrior character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +1 [defense] (and +1 hit point if attached character has the sentinel keyword).
cards.flavor:
Each one of his folk was clad in a hauberk of steel mail that hung to his knees…
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/007 - Hauberk of Mail.jpg

cards.name: King of Dale
cards.text: Attach to a Dale or Esgaroth hero. Planning Action: Exhaust King of Dale to reduce the cost of the next Dale ally you play this phase by 1 for each different player attachment on attached hero. That ally does not require a resource match.
cards.flavor:
Then Bard II, Brand's son, became King in Dale...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/008 - King of Dale.jpg

cards.name: Bow of Yew
cards.text: Attach to a Dale or Warrior character. Restricted. Response: After attached character is declared as an attacker, exhaust Bow of Yew to deal 1 damage to the defending enemy.
cards.flavor:
"They would shoot at us with their great bows of yew…"
<cite>The Lord of the Eagles, The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/009 - Bow of Yew.jpg

cards.name: Map of Rhovanion
cards.text: Attach to a Dale or Scout character. Limit 1 per character. Response: After attached character commits to the quest, place 1 progress on the active location.
cards.flavor:
"You are come to the very edge of the Wild..."
<cite>Gandalf, The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/010 - Map of Rhovanion.jpg

cards.name: Necklace of Girion
cards.text:
Guarded (enemy or location).
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +2 [willpower] and collects an additional resource during the resource phase.
cards.flavor:
...the necklace of Girion, Lord of Dale, made of five hundred emeralds green as grass, which he gave for the arming of his eldest son…
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/011 - Necklace of Girion.jpg

cards.name: Traffic from Dale
cards.text: Planning Action: Choose a Dale hero you control. Add 1 resource to its pool for each character you control with a player attachment. You can only play 1 copy of Traffic from Dale each round.
cards.flavor:
The talk was all of the trade that came and went on the waterways and the growth of the traffic on the river...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/012 - Traffic from Dale.jpg

cards.name: To Arms!
cards.text: Action: Choose an ally with a player attachment. Ready that ally.
cards.flavor:
...the grim-voiced fellow ran hotfoot to the Master. “The dragon is coming or I am a fool!” he cried. “Cut the bridges! To arms! To arms!”
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/013 - To Arms!.jpg

cards.text: Response: After a character is declared as an attacker or defender against an enemy with an attachment, that character gets +3 [attack] and +3 [defense] until the end of this attack.
cards.flavor: "Dwarf-mail may be good, but they will soon be hard put to it." <cite>Bard the Bowman, The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Player/014 - Valour of the North.jpg

cards.text: Planning Action: Choose a ready player attachment on a character you control. Return that attachment to its owner’s hand to reduce the cost of the next attachment played this phase by X, where is the chosen attachment’s cost.

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Encounter/Journey Up the Anduin/018 - Frenzied Creature.jpg

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Encounter/Journey Up the Anduin/019 - Dangerous Crossing.jpg

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Encounter/Grey Mountain Goblins/020 - Goblin Troop.jpg

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Encounter/Grey Mountain Goblins/021 - Stray Goblin.jpg

cards.text: Forced: If Pack of Wargs is dealt a shadow card with no effect, Pack of Wargs makes an additional attack after this one. (Do not deal it a shadow card.)
cards.shadow: Shadow: Return attacking enemy to the staging area after this attack.

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Encounter/Hills of Wilderland/022 - Pack of Wargs.jpg

cards.text: X is the number of characters controlled by the player with the most characters. Quest Action: Exhaust a character to reduce Hills of Wilderland $ by 1 until the end of the phase. Only the first player can trigger this effect.

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Encounter/Hills of Wilderland/023 - Hills of Wilderland.jpg

cards.name: Ruined Supplies
cards.text: Doomed 1. When Revealed: Each player must choose: either raise your threat by 1 for each ally you control, or deal 1 damage to each ally you control.

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Encounter/Lost in the Wilderness/025 - Ruined Supplies.jpg

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Encounter/Lost in Mirkwood/029 - Overgrown Path.jpg

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Encounter/Lost in Mirkwood/032 - Forest Clearing.jpg

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Encounter/Lost in Mirkwood/033 - Twilight Hall.jpg

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Encounter/Lost in Mirkwood/034 - Mirkwood Patrol.jpg

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Encounter/Lost in Mirkwood/035 - Ravenous Spider.jpg

images.source: 18 - The Wilds of Rhovanion/Encounter/Lost in Mirkwood/036 - Unseen Danger.jpg

cards.name: The Cold-Drake Attacks!
cards.text: You’ve followed the Dragon tracks high up the Ered Mithrin mountain range to a sheltered hollow where you find the beast waiting for you. It lets out a roar that shakes the mountain, and rocks tumble down as it charges toward you in a rage! When Revealed: Add the set-aside Cold-Drake to the staging area.

back.name: The Cold-Drake Attacks!
back.text:
Ignore the Deep keyword.
Cold-Drake cannot leave the staging area (even if it has damage equal to its quest points), but it is considered to be engaged with each player.
No more than 6 damage can be placed on the Cold-drake each round and it cannot have more than 18 damage.
This stage cannot be defeated while Ice Drake has any hit points remaining.

images.source: 19 - Ered Mithrin/01 - The Withered Heath/Quest/023 - 2A - The Cold-Drake Attacks!.jpg
19 - Ered Mithrin/01 - The Withered Heath/Quest/023 - 2B - The Cold-Drake Attacks!.jpg

cards.name: Hunting the Beast
cards.text: The injured drake retreats among the rising slopes of the Ered Mithrin and you chase after it, carefully searching each potential hiding place. When Revealed: Shuffle 2 set-aside Dragon Sign objectives into the Caves deck. Set Cold-Drake aside, out of play. (Do not remove damage tokens from it.) Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until X locations are discarded, where X is the number of players. Add each discarded location to the staging area.

back.name: Hunting the Beast
back.text:
Forced: After the active location is explored, look at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Reveal 1 of those cards and discard the rest.
Forced: At the end of the round, remove 3 damage tokens from the set-aside Cold-Drake.
The players cannot defeat this stage unless at least 3 Dragon Signs are in the victory display.

images.source: 19 - Ered Mithrin/01 - The Withered Heath/Quest/024 - 3A - Hunting the Beast.jpg
19 - Ered Mithrin/01 - The Withered Heath/Quest/024 - 3B - Hunting the Beast.jpg

cards.name: A Cornered Dragon
cards.text: At last you have cornered the injured Dragon. But with nowhere left to run, it attacks you with desperate fury. The men of Dale will make songs of this battle, if you survive to tell the story... When Revealed: Add Cold-Drake to the staging area. It makes an immediate attack against each player in turn order. (Deal and resolve a shadow card for each attack.)

back.name: A Cornered Dragon
back.text:
Cold-Drake cannot take more than X damage each round, where X is the number of Dragon Signs in the victory display. 
Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, return Cold-Drake to the staging area. It makes an immediate attack against each player in turn order.
This stage cannot be defeated while Cold-Drake is in play. When Cold-Drake is defeated, the players win the game.

19 - Ered Mithrin/01 - The Withered Heath/Quest/025 - 4B - A Cornered Dragon.jpg

Progress cannot be placed on locations in the staging area.
Forced: When the active location is explored, if the first player controls Urdug, advance to a random stage 2A.

Shuffle the encounter deck. Each other player reveals an encounter card.

back.name: Rescue Tiny
back.text:
The ‘when revealed’ effects of treachery cards cannot be canceled.
Forced: When the players defeat this stage, remove it from the game. Advance to a random stage 2A, if able. Otherwise, advance to stage 3A.
The players cannot travel to the Grey Moorland guarding Tiny unless there is at least 5 progress on this stage. This stage cannot be defeated unless the first player controls Urdug and Tiny.

19 - Ered Mithrin/02 - Roam Across Rhovanion/Quest/048 - 2B - Rescue Tiny.jpg

Shuffle the encounter deck. Each other player reveals an encounter card.

back.name: Retrieve Urdug’s Horn
back.text:
Each enemy with 1 or more guarded attachments gets +2 [Threat] and +2 [Defense].
Forced: When the players defeat this stage, remove it from the game. Advance to a random stage 2A, if able. Otherwise, advance to stage 3A.

back.name: Find Durin’s Key
back.text:
Each encounter card guarding a card is immune to player card effects.
Forced: When the players defeat this stage, remove it from the game. Advance to a random stage 2A, if able. Otherwise, advance to stage 3A.

back.name: Urdug’s Gambit
back.text:
Progress cannot be placed on this quest from questing successfully.
Forced: When the players quest unsuccessfully, they do not raise their threat. Instead, place X progress here, where X is the amount by which they would have raised their threat. Then, if this stage has progress equal to its quest points, the players lose the game.
When Urdug has no hit points remaining, the players win the game.

cards.text: At the end of the round, discard Galadriel from play. Response: After you play Galadriel from your hand, search the top 5 cards of your deck for an attachment of cost 3 or less and put it into play. Put the remaining cards back in any order.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/005 - Galadriel.jpg

cards.name: Gimli
cards.text: Sentinel. Response: After an enemy is revealed from the encounter deck, ready Gimli.
cards.flavor:
"Give me a row of orc-necks and room to swing and all weariness will fall from me!"
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/006 - Gimli.jpg

cards.name: Faramir
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Faramir to choose a player. Each character controlled by that player gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
"He leads now in all perilous ventures. But his life is charmed, or fate spares him for some other end."
<cite>Mablung, Ranger of Ithilien,
The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/007 - Faramir.jpg

cards.name: Arwen Undomiel
cards.text: Response: After Arwen Undómiel exhausts, choose a character. That character gains sentinel and gets +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
...in whom it was said that the likeness of Lúthien had come on earth again...for she was the Evenstar of her people.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/008 - Arwen Undomiel.jpg

cards.name: Orophin
cards.text: Ranged. Response: After Orophin enters play, return a Silvan ally from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor: "Orophin has now gone in haste back to our dwellings to warn our people." <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/009 - Orophin.jpg

cards.name: Bofur
cards.text: Quest Action: Spend 1 [spirit] resource to put Bofur into play from your hand, exhausted and committed to a quest. If you quest successfully this phase and Bofur is still in play, return him to your hand.
cards.flavor: "Get up lazy-bones..." <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/010 - Bofur.jpg

cards.name: Fili
cards.text: Response: After you play Fili from your hand during the planning phase, search your deck for Kili and put him into play under your control. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "Fili is the youngest and still has the best sight" —Thorin, The Hobbit

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/011 - Fili.jpg

cards.name: Kili
cards.text: Response: After you play Kili from your hand during the planning phase, search your deck for Fili and put him into play under your control. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "Let us join the throng!" —Kili, The Hobbit

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/012 - Kili.jpg

cards.name: Silverlode Archer
cards.text: Ranged.
cards.flavor:
"We have been keeping watch on the rivers, ever since we saw a great troop of Orcs going north towards Moria, along the skirts of the mountains, many days ago."
<cite>Haldir of Lórien, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/013 - Silverlode Archer.jpg

cards.name: Defender of the Naith
cards.text: Sentinel. Response: After a Silvan ally you control leaves play, ready Defender of the Naith.
cards.flavor: "We have been keeping watch on the rivers, ever since we saw a great troop of Orcs going North toward Moria..." <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/014 - Defender of the Naith.jpg

cards.name: Andrath Guardsman
cards.text: Response: After you play Andrath Guardsman from your hand, choose a non-unique enemy engaged with you. That enemy cannot attack you this round.
cards.flavor:
They forgot or ignored what little they had known of the Guardians, and of the labours of those that made possible the long peace of the Shire.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/015 - Andrath Guardsman.jpg

cards.name: Woodland Courier
cards.text: Response: After Woodland Courier enters play, place 1 progress on a location (2 progress instead if that location has the Forest trait).

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/016 - Woodland Courier.jpg

cards.name: Naith Guide
cards.text: Response: After Naith Guide enters play, choose a hero. That hero does not exhaust to quest this round.
cards.flavor: "...I shall lead you well..." <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/017 - Naith Guide.jpg

cards.name: Blue Mountain Trader
cards.text: Action: Choose another player. That player gains control of Blue Mountain Trader. Then, that player moves 1 resource from the resource pool of a hero he controls to the resource pool of a hero you control, or Blue Mountain Trader is discarded. (Limit once per round.)

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/018 - Blue Mountain Trader.jpg

cards.name: Dwarven Sellsword
cards.text: Forced: At the end of the round, discard Dwarven Sellsword unless the players as a group spend 1 [leadership] resource.
cards.flavor:
...he did not altogether approve of dwarves and their love of gold...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/019 - Dwarven Sellsword.jpg

cards.name: Celebrian's Stone
cards.text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gains +2 [willpower]
If attached hero is Aragorn, he also gains a [spirit] resource icon.
cards.flavor:
"You needn't," said Bilbo. "As a matter of fact it was all mine. Except that Aragorn insisted on my putting in a green stone. He seemed to think it important. I don't know why."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/020 - Celebrian_s Stone.jpg

cards.name: Steward of Gondor
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the Gondor trait. Action: Exhaust Steward of Gondor to add 2 resources to attached hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor:
"It was commanded yesterday."
<cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/021 - Steward of Gondor.jpg

cards.name: Light of Valinor
cards.text: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan hero. Attached hero does not exhaust to commit to a quest.
cards.flavor:
"... those who have dwelt in the blassed realm live at once in both worlds, and against both the Seen and Unseen they have great power."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/022 - Light of Valinor.jpg

cards.name: Unexpected Courage
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust Unexpected Courage to ready attached hero.
cards.flavor:
"Here am I, naughty little fly;
you are fat and lazy.
You cannot trap me, though you try,
in your cobwebs crazy."
<cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/023 - Unexpected Courage.jpg

cards.name: Ancient Mathom
cards.text: Attach to a location. Response: After attached location is explored, the first player draws 3 cards.
cards.flavor: The Mathom-house it was called; for anything that Hobbits had no immediate use for, but were unwilling to throw away, they called a mathom. Their dwellings were apt to become rather crowded with mathoms... <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/024 - Ancient Mathom.jpg

cards.name: Cram
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Action: Discard Cram to ready attached hero.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/025 - Cram.jpg

cards.name: Grim Resolve
cards.text: Action: Ready all character cards in play.
cards.flavor: "If there is only one way, then I must take it. What comes after must come." <cite>Frodo Baggins, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/026 - Grim Resolve.jpg

cards.name: Sneak Attack
cards.text: Action: Put 1 ally card into play from your hand. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play, return it to your hand.
cards.flavor:
There is a seed of courage hidden (often deeply, it is true) in the heart of the fattest and most timid hobbit, waiting for some final and desperate danger to make it grow.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/027 - Sneak Attack.jpg

cards.name: A Test of Will
cards.text: Response: Cancel the "when revealed" effects of a card that was just revealed from the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
"There is naught that you can do, other than to resist, with hope or without it"
<cite>Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/028 - A Test of Will.jpg

cards.name: Ever Vigilant
cards.text: Action: Choose and ready 1 ally card.
cards.flavor:
"...no road looks toward safety any longer. Be vigilant!"
<cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/029 - Ever Vigilant.jpg

cards.name: Hasty Stroke
cards.text: Response: Cancel a shadow effect just triggered during combat.
cards.flavor:
'The hasy stroke goes oft astray,' said Aragorn. 'We must press our Enemy, and no longer wait on him for the next move.'
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/030 - Hasty Stroke.jpg

cards.name: Desperate Defense
cards.text: Response: After a sentinel character is declared as a defender, it gets +2 [defense] for this attack. If this attack deals no damage, ready the defending character.
cards.flavor: ...but alone in the porch upon the topmost step stood Beregond, clad in the black and silver of the Guard; and he held the door against them. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/031 - Desperate Defense.jpg

cards.name: Dwarven Tomb
cards.text: Action: Return 1 [spirit] card from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor:
The dwarves no more shall suffer wrong,
The dwarves of yore made mighty spells,
While hammers  v  fell like ringing bells
In places deep, where dark things sleep,
In hollow halls beneath the fells.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/032 - Dwarven Tomb.jpg

cards.name: Feigned Voices
cards.text: Combat Action: Return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to choose an enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase.
cards.flavor: "The three of us could not challenge a hundred, so we went ahead and spoke with feigned voices, leading them on into the wood." <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/033 - Feigned Voices.jpg

cards.name: Glorfindel
cards.text: Action: Pay 1 resource from Glorfindel's pool to heal 1 damage on any character. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
"You saw him for a moment as he is upon the other side: one of the mighty of the firstborn."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/034 - Glorfindel.jpg

cards.name: Bifur
cards.text: Action: Pay 1 resource from a hero's resource pool to add 1 resource to Bifur's resource pool. Any player may trigger this ability. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "And winter comes after autumn." <cite>Bifur, The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/035 - Bifur.jpg

cards.name: Thorin Stonehelm
cards.text: Response: After Thorin Stonehelm is declared as an attacker, discard the top card of your deck to deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you.
cards.flavor:
Thorin III Stonehelm, Dain"s son, became King under the mountain.
-The Return of the King

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/036 - Thorin Stonehelm.jpg

cards.name: Gandalf
cards.text: At the end of the round, discard Gandalf from play. Response: After Gandalf enters play, (choose 1): draw 3 cards, deal 4 damage to 1 enemy in play, or reduce your threat by 5.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/037 - Gandalf.jpg

cards.name: Legolas
cards.text: Ranged. Response: After Legolas participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "He stands not alone," said Legolas, bending his bow and fitting an arrow with hands that moved quicker than sight. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/038 - Legolas.jpg

cards.name: Haldir of Lorien
cards.text: Ranged. Sentinel.
cards.flavor: "But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies, and they speak the languages of other lands." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/039 - Haldir of Lorien.jpg

cards.name: Elrond
cards.text: At the end of the round, discard Elrond from play. Response: After Elrond enters play, choose one: heal all damage on a hero, discard a Condition attachment, or each player draws 1 card.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/040 - Elrond.jpg

cards.name: Azain Silverbeard
cards.text: Response: After Azain Silverbeard participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, spend 1 [tactics] resource to deal 2 damage to another enemy that shares a Trait with the destroyed enemy. Any player may trigger this response.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/041 - Azain Silverbeard.jpg

cards.name: Mablung
cards.text: Response: After Mablung enters play, choose an enemy to get +5 engagement cost until the end of the round. Then, you may engage that enemy, or return it to the staging area.
cards.flavor: "But still we will not sit idle and let Him do all as He would." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/042 - Mablung.jpg

cards.name: Henamarth Riversong
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Henamarth Riversong to look at the top card of the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
"And I reckon there's Elves and Elves. They're all elvish enough, but they're not all the same."
<cite>Sam Gamgee,
The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/043 - Henamarth Riversong.jpg

cards.name: Ioreth
cards.text: Cannot attack or defend. Action: Spend 1 [lore] resource and exhaust Ioreth. Then, heal 3 points of damage on a character. Any player may trigger this action.
cards.flavor: Thus spake Ioreth, wise-woman of Gondor: The hands of the king are the hands of a healer, and so shall the rightful king be known. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/044 - Ioreth.jpg

cards.name: Sarn Ford Sentry
cards.text: Response: After Sarn Ford Sentry enters play, draw 1 card for each enemy engaged with you.
cards.flavor: "Lonely men are we, Rangers of the wild, hunters but hunters ever of the servants of the Enemy..." <cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/045 - Sarn Ford Sentry.jpg

cards.name: Erebor Hammersmith
cards.text: Response: After you play Erebor Hammersmith, return the topmost attachment in any player's discard pile to his hand.
cards.flavor: "In Erebor in the Kingdom of Dain there is such skill..." <cite>Aragorn, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/046 - Erebor Hammersmith.jpg

cards.name: Galadhon Archer
cards.text: Ranged. Response: After Galadhon Archer enters play, deal 1 damage to an enemy not engaged with you.
cards.flavor: "...they say that you breathe so loud that they could shoot you in the dark." <cite>Legolas, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/047 - Galadhon Archer.jpg

cards.name: Galadhrim Minstrel
cards.text: Response: After Galadhrim Minstrel enters play, search the top five cards of your deck for an event card and add it to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.flavor: ...the language was that of Elven-song and spoke of things little known on Middle-earth. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/048 - Galadhrim Minstrel.jpg

cards.name: Defender of Rammas
cards.flavor: "And the Enemy must pay dearly for the crossing of the River." <cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/049 - Defender of Rammas.jpg

cards.name: Dunedain Lookout
cards.text: Response: Discard Dúnedain Lookout to cancel the 'When Revealed' effects of an enemy just revealed from the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: "Travellers scowl at us, and countrymen gives us scornful names." -Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/050 - Dunedain Lookout.jpg

cards.name: Envoy of Pelargir
cards.text: Response: After Envoy of Pelargir enters play, add 1 resource to a Gondor or Noble hero's resource pool.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/051 - Envoy of Pelargir.jpg

cards.name: Horn of Gondor
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Response: After a character is destroyed, add 1 resource to attached hero's pool.
cards.flavor:
'Slow should you be to wind that horn again, Boromir,' said Elrond, 'until you stand once more on the borders of your land, and dire need is on you.'
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/052 - Horn of Gondor.jpg

cards.name: Elf-stone
cards.text: Attach to the active location. Attached location gets +1 quest point. Response: After attached location leaves play as an explored location, the first player puts 1 ally into play from his hand.
cards.flavor:
"It is a beryl, an elf-stone. Whether it was set there, or let fall by chance, I cannot say, but it brings hope to me"
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/053 - Elf-stone.jpg

cards.name: Dwarrowdelf Axe
cards.text: Restricted. Attach to a Dwarf character. Attached character gets +1 [attack] Response: After attached character attacks, deal 1 damage to the defending enemy.
cards.flavor: "We make good armour and keen swords, but we cannot again make mail or blade to match those that were made before the dragon came." <cite>Gloin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/054 - Dwarrowdelf Axe.jpg

cards.name: Blade of Gondolin
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] when attacking an Orc. Response: After attached hero attacks and destroys an enemy, place 1 progress token on the current quest.
cards.flavor:
It was rather splendid to be wearing a blade made in Gondolin for the goblin-wars of which so many songs had sung...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/055 - Blade of Gondolin.jpg

cards.name: Lembas
cards.text: Play only if you control a Noldor or Silvan hero. Attach to a hero. Action: Discard Lembas to ready attached hero and heal 3 damage from it.
cards.flavor: "...it is more strengthing than any food made by Men, and it is more pleasant than cram, by all accounts. <cite>Lórien Elf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/056 - Lembas.jpg

cards.name: The Long Defeat
cards.text: Attach to a quest card in play. Limit 1 per quest. Response: After attached quest card is defeated, each player either draws 2 cards or heals up to 5 damage from among characters he controls.
cards.flavor:
"...for ere the fall of Nargothrond or Gondolin I passed over the mountains, and together through ages of the world we have fought the long defeat."
<cite>Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/057 - The Long Defeat.jpg

cards.name: Gildor's Counsel
cards.text: Play during the Quest phase, before characters are committed to the Quest. Action: Reveal 1 less card from the encounter deck this phase. (To a minimum of 1.)
cards.flavor:
"The wide world is all about you: you can fence yourselves in, but you cannot for ever fence it out."
<cite>Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/058 - Gildor_s Counsel.jpg

cards.name: Feint
cards.text: Combat Action: Choose an enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase.
cards.flavor: A few brave men were strung before them to make a feint of resistance, and many there fell before the rest drew back and fled to either side. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/059 - Feint.jpg

cards.name: Secret Paths
cards.text: Quest Action: Choose a location in the staging area. Until the end of the phase, that location does not contribute its [threat]
cards.flavor: ...Beorn advised them to take this way; for at a place a few days' ride due north of the Carrock was the gate of a little-known pathway through Mirkwood... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/060 - Secret Paths.jpg

cards.name: Quick Strike
cards.text: Action: Exhaust a character you control to immediately declare it as an attacker (and resolve its attack) against any eligible enemy target.
cards.flavor: "...for he that strikes the first blow, if he strikes it hard enough, may need to strike no more." <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/061 - Quick Strike.jpg

cards.name: Ancestral Knowledge
cards.text: Action: Exhaust a Dwarf character to place 2 progress tokens on the active location. (4 progress tokens instead if it is an Underground or Mountain location.)

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/062 - Ancestral Knowledge.jpg

cards.name: Khazad! Khazad!
cards.text: Action: Choose a Dwarf character. Until the end of the phase, that character gets +3 [attack].

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/063 - Khazad! Khazad!.jpg

cards.name: Daeron's Runes
cards.text: Action: Draw 2 cards. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.
cards.flavor:
"These are Daeron's Runes, such as were used of old in Moria..."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/064 - Daeron_s Runes.jpg

cards.name: Pursuing the Enemy
cards.text: Action: Return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to choose a player. Deal 1 damage to each enemy engaged with that player.
cards.flavor: The marauding orcs had been waylaid and almost all destroyed; the remnant had fled westward towards the mountains, and were being pursued. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Player/065 - Pursuing the Enemy.jpg

cards.name: Spiders of Mirkwood
cards.text: While it is engaged with you, Spiders of Mirkwood gets +1 Û for each exhausted character you control.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Oath/066 - Spiders of Mirkwood.jpg

cards.text: Forced: After Gret Spider engages you, exhaust a character you control.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Oath/067 - Great Spider.jpg

cards.name: The Eaves of Mirkwood
cards.text: While The Eaves of Mirkwood is the active location, encounter card effects cannot be canceled.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Oath/068 - The Eaves of Mirkwood.jpg

cards.text: X is the number of locations in the staging area.Travel: Each player must discard 1 random card from his hand to travel here.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Oath/069 - Tangled Grove.jpg

cards.name: Forest Gate
cards.text: Response: After you travel to Forest Gate, the first player draws 2 cards.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Oath/070 - Forest Gate.jpg

cards.name: Spider Den
cards.text: Quest Action: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Spider enemy and put it into play engaged with you to discard Spider Den. (Any player may trigger this effect.)

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Oath/071 - Spider Den.jpg

cards.name: Goblin Trail
cards.text: Travel: Reveal the top card of the encounter deck to travel here.Response: When Goblin Trail leaves play as an explored location, place 6 progress on the current quest.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Oath/072 - Goblin Trail.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: Each enemy and each location currently in the staging area gets +1 $ until the end of the phase. If there are no cards in the staging area, Driven by Shadow gains surge.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Oath/073 - Driven by Shadow.jpg

cards.name: Surprising Speed
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player returns 1 enemy engaged with him to the staging area. If no enemy was returned to the staging area this way, Surprising Speed gains surge and doomed 1.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Oath/074 - Surprising Speed.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: The player with the highest threat level attached this card to one of his heroes. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: `Attached hero does not ready during the refresh phase unless you pay 2 resources from that hero`s pool.`)

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Oath/075 - Caught in a Web.jpg

cards.text: Cannot have attachments.While Goblin Troop is engaged with you, each other Goblin enemy engaged with you gets +1 Û and +1 Ú.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Goblins/076 - Goblin Troop.jpg

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Goblins/077 - Goblin Sniper.jpg
22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Goblins/078 - Goblin Runners.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: Discard the top card of each player`s deck. Until the end of the phase, increase Goblintown Savengers` $ by the total printed cost of all cards discarded in this way.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Goblins/079 - Goblintown Scavengers.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Goblin enemy and put it into play, engaged with him. Then, shuffle the encounter deck. (This effect cannot be canceled.)

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Goblins/080 - Goblins are Upon You!.jpg

cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must choose: Either raise your threat by 1 for each questing character you control, or discard a questing character you control.

images.source: 22 - Two-Player Limited Edition Starter/Encounter/The Goblins/081 - Eyes in the Dark.jpg

cards.text: X is the stage number of the quest.Cannot take damage. Cannot have attachments.Forced: After Goblin Chieftain attacks, either remove X progress from the quest, or return it to the staging area.

Celeborn came forth and led the host of Lórien...
-The Return of the King

images.source: Promos/Host of Galadhrim.jpg

cards.name: Lothiriel
cards.text: If Éomer is in play, Lothíriel gains the Rohan trait. Response: After Lothíriel commits to a quest, choose an ally in your hand. If that ally shares a Trait with her, put that ally into play exhausted and committed to the quest. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play, shuffle it into your deck.

images.source: Promos/Lothiriel.jpg

cards.name: Northern Bowmaster
cards.text:
Ranged.
You cannot play Northern Bowmaster from your hand unless you are engaged with an enemy.

images.source: Promos/Northern Bowmaster.jpg

cards.name: Power of Command
cards.text: Attach to the hero with The One Ring. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower]. Response: After attached hero commits to the quest, exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to give each other unique character you control +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

images.source: Promos/Power of Command.jpg

cards.name: Saruman
cards.text: Doomed 3. At the end of the round, discard Saruman from play. Response: After Saruman enters play, choose a non-unique enemy or location in the staging area. While Saruman is in play, the chosen enemy or location is considered to be out of play.

images.source: Promos/Saruman.jpg

cards.name: Soldier of Gondor
cards.text: Response: After Soldier of Gondor enters play, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Gondor ally and add it to your hand (any number of Gondor allies instead if your threat is 40 or higher). Shuffle your deck.

images.source: Promos/Soldier of Gondor.jpg

cards.name: Song of Healing
cards.text: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Action: Discard 1 card from your hand to heal 1 damage from attached hero. Any player may trigger this effect.
cards.flavor:
...behind him stood Galadriel, tall and white: a circlet of golden flowers was in her hair, and in her hand she held a hard, and she sang.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: Promos/Song of Healing.jpg

cards.name: Thorin Stonehelm
cards.text: Response: After Thorin Stonehelm is declared as an attacker, discard the top card of your deck to deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you.
cards.flavor:
Thorin III Stonehelm, Dain"s son, became King under the mountain.
-The Return of the King

images.source: Promos/Thorin Stonehelm.jpg

cards.name: Tom Bombadil
cards.text: Encounter. When Revealed: Choose a player. That player gains control of Tom Bombadil, ready and committed to the quest. At the end of the round, remove Tom Bombadil and a copy of Tom Bombadillo! in the victory display from the game. This effect cannot be cancelled.

images.source: Promos/Tom Bombadil.jpg

cards.name: Wandering Exile
cards.text: Response: After Wandering Exile commits to a quest, discard a card from your hand to ready Wandering Exile.
cards.flavor:
"The Elves have their own labours and their own sorrows...
-Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring

images.source: Promos/Wandering Exile.jpg
